jobs.title: DIAS Professor in Clinical Translational Psychiatry and Centre Leader for the Elite Centre for Clinical and Translational Psychiatry at Odense University Hospital and the University of Southern Denmark
jobs.description:
The Danish Institute for Advanced Study (DIAS), the Department of Clinical Research at the University of Southern Denmark (SDU), and the Region of Southern Denmark seek an outstanding candidate to fill a fully tenured Professor position in the field of clinical translational psychiatry. The candidate is expected to start by agreement.

The candidate is expected to start by agreement.

We seek an exceptional researcher with demonstrated excellence in their discipline and a proven ability to push boundaries, challenge conventions, and engage in groundbreaking interdisciplinary research. The successful candidate will be expected to contribute to cutting-edge advancements in their field while fostering collaboration across disciplines, embracing DIAS’s mission of curiosity-driven research. The ideal candidate will have a strong international research profile, an outstanding record of attracting competitive research funding, and a demonstrated ability to conduct interdisciplinary research. The successful candidate will be attached to the Department of Clinical Research, DIAS, and the Region, and must be prepared to engage in multiple and diverse research environments at SDU and in the Region of Southern Denmark. 

What we offer

  • The opportunity to lead a new elite centre for clinical and translational psychiatry, with five-year funding of DKK 17 million (equivalent to Euro 2.3 million), with the potential for a five-year extension.

  • A strong interdisciplinary research environment through DIAS, comprising leading academics across medicine, science, and the humanities, with the opportunity to collaborate with outstanding researchers across SDU’s five faculties.

  • Access to state-of-the-art research facilities at the newly built Odense University Hospital (OUH), where psychiatry and somatic care are integrated to foster collaboration between these fields.

  • Comprehensive research support services from DIAS and SDU, targeting prestigious funding such as DNRF, ERC, and grants from Danish private foundations.

  • If recruited from abroad or from industry, the candidate will be eligible for a fast-track DKK 11 million  (equivalent to Euro 1.5 million ) Lundbeck Foundation Start-Up grant.

  • Reduced teaching obligations compared to a standard professorship, allowing the candidate to focus on research and leadership within the elite centre.

Who we are looking for 

We are seeking a highly accomplished researcher with expertise in the field of clinical translational psychiatry, who is eager to engage in collaborative activities within the DIAS framework. 

The ideal candidate should demonstrate:

  • A commitment to engaging in boundary-crossing interdisciplinary research and dialogue. 

  • A record of internationally competitive research activities at the highest level of ambition. 

  • Publications in high-level peer-reviewed academic journals and leading innovative research programmes in clinical psychiatry. 

  • An ability to attract significant external funding to support independent and collaborative research initiatives.

  • Engagement in the international academic society. 

  • Extensive experience in building and leading multidisciplinary research teams that integrate basic and clinical sciences, with an emphasis on translational research spanning from laboratory findings to clinical trials.

  • A research focus in areas such as child and adolescent psychiatry, clinical psychopharmacology, epidemiology, molecular neurobiology, substance use disorders, or serious mental illness.

  • The ability to develop a translational research programme in one or more of the mentioned fields, with a focus on building cooperative, multidisciplinary teams that bridge basic science and the design and execution of early-phase clinical trials.

  • A demonstrated commitment to mentorship, teaching, and leadership, fostering the next generation of researchers in interdisciplinary research environments.

  • Experience at Full or Associate Professor level within relevant fields.

  • Fluency in English

The Danish Institute for Advanced Study (DIAS)

DIAS at SDU is a hub for interdisciplinary excellence at and beyond the frontier of knowledge, bringing together outstanding researchers from various disciplines to foster groundbreaking interdisciplinary research and bold innovation. DIAS nurtures a collaborative and curiosity-driven environment, encouraging scholars to think outside the box and challenge conventional boundaries. The institute values open-minded exploration and an ambitious yet collegial atmosphere with a strong sense of community. Researchers affiliated with DIAS are expected to contribute actively to DIAS activities, mentor DIAS fellows, and engage in interdisciplinary collaborations across faculties and departments, both nationally and internationally.  

The Department of Clinical Research

The Department of Clinical Research does translational research spanning from basic research to patient care, within both somatics and psychiatry. The interdisciplinary research aims to improve patient treatment, health, and well-being. Researchers at the institute often have joint appointments between clinic, research, and education, ensuring a strong academic foundation for the research at Odense University Hospital (OUH) and in psychiatry. The researchers at the Department of Clinical Research primarily consist of doctors, nurses, and other healthcare professionals with main employment at OUH.

The Centre for Clinical and Translational PsychiatryThe centre will be based at the new Odense University Hospital, which integrates psychiatric and somatic care to promote close collaboration between the fields. The hospital includes a state-of-the-art adult psychiatric department with around 600 employees, 142 single rooms, and specialized sections for joint somatic-psychiatric care, rehabilitation, telepsychiatry, and more. The child and adolescent psychiatric department cover the entire region with about 600 employees, two inpatient wards with a total of 34 beds, and outpatient clinics at four geographical sites.The centre’s aim is to advance novel psychiatric research through innovative approaches that will significantly impact future patient care. This includes translating discoveries from the laboratory to clinical settings, whether within narrow clinical fields or through broader cross-disciplinary collaborations that involve various clinical functions, professions, and institutions.

Additional informationFor further information about being a professor at DIAS, please contact DIAS director Sten Rynning at +45 6550 2193 or via email at director-dias@sdu.dk For further information and questions about the position, please contact the Head of the Department of Clinical Research Rikke Leth-Larsen at +456550 3477 or via email at rllarsen@health.sdu.dk or Medical Director Bjarne Dahler-Eriksen, Odense University Hospital, at +4523284068 or via email at bde@rsyd.dk. You may also contact the Vice Dean for Research and Innovation at the Faculty of Health Sciences, SDU, Uffe Holmskov at +45 6550 3775 or via email at uholmskov@health.sdu.dk regarding the position.

Application, salary, and employment terms

This position will be attached to the Department of Clinical Research in Odense. The successful candidate will be expected to regularly engage in DIAS activities and interdisciplinary cooperation in Odense. 

The successful applicant will be employed in accordance with the agreement between the Ministry of Finance and the Danish Confederation of Professional Associations (AC). 

For more details on salary and taxation, please refer to the provided links about salary and taxation.

Teaching obligations will be reduced compared to a standard professorship at SDU, allowing more time for research and leadership activities.

Application requirements

Applications must be submitted electronically via the "Apply now" link provided below.

If you experience technical problems, please contact hcm-support@sdu.dk. 

The application must include the following:

  • A motivation letter.

  • A detailed Curriculum Vitae (CV), including contacts for possible references.

  • Copies of relevant certificates/diplomas.

  • A teaching portfolio detailing previous teaching experience.

  • A complete list of publications, highlighting those most relevant to the position.

  • Up to ten of the most relevant publications

  • A research and publication plan for the next five years, including a description of synergy with the department's activities and the potential to benefit from DIAS’s interdisciplinary environment.

All application materials must be submitted in English, and only applications written in English will be considered.

Submission guidelines

  • Files must be submitted in PDF format, with each file no larger than 10 MB.

  • If multiple files are needed for a single section, combine them into one PDF file.

  • Zip files, image files (jpg, png, etc.), and password-protected PDF files will not be accepted. All PDF files must be unlocked to allow binding.

  • The application deadline is February 7, 2027, at 23:59 CET. Applications received after the deadline will not be considered.

Applications that are incomplete with regards to the above-mentioned requirements will not be assessed by the committee. Shortlisting and tests may be used in the recruitment process and references may be obtained.  

We recommend that international applicants take the time to visit the websites of Work in Denmark and the International Staff Office at SDU. Here you will find information and facts about moving to, working, and living in Denmark.

Assessment

Shortlisting may be used as part of the recruitment process. Read about shortlisting at SDU. 

Assessment of shortlisted applications will be done under the existing Appointment Order for universities. Shortlisted applications will be assessed by an assessment committee. The committee may request additional information, and, if so, it is the responsibility of the applicant to provide the necessary material.  

When the assessment committee has submitted its report, the applicants will receive the part of the evaluation that concerns themselves.

About SDU

SDU is committed to fostering a diverse staff that reflects society’s diversity. We welcome applications from all qualified candidates, regardless of personal background.

SDU was founded in 1966 and now has over 27,000 students, nearly 20% of whom are international. SDU employs more than 3,800 staff and offers 115 study programmes across disciplines such as the humanities, social sciences, natural sciences, health sciences, and engineering. While SDU’s main campus is in Odense, it also has campuses in other locations.Equal opportunity employment

The University of Southern Denmark is an equal opportunity employer. We consider all qualified applicants without regard to race, colour, sex, gender identity, sexual orientation, religion, national origin, age, disability, pregnancy, or any other protected status.

The University of Southern Denmark wishes our staff to reflect the surrounding community and therefore encourages everyone, regardless of personal background, to apply for the position. 

SDU conducts research in critical technologies, which, due to the risk of unwanted knowledge transfer, are subject to several security measures. Therefore, based on information from open sources, background checks may be conducted on candidates for the position.

jobs.title: VI SØGER EN AUTOMEKANIKER – ER DU VORES NYE KOLLEGA? / WE ARE HIRING AN AUTOMOTIVE MECHANIC – ARE YOU OUR NEW COLLEAGUE?
jobs.employer: Dit Autoværksted v/ Anas El Ouahabi
jobs.description:
VI SØGER EN AUTOMEKANIKER – ER DU VORES NYE KOLLEGA?

Dit Autoværksted | Hvidovre

Er du glad for biler, elsker at skrue og vil gerne arbejde på et værksted, hvor der er styr på tingene, gode kollegaer og ordentlige forhold?

Så er det måske dig, vi leder efter!

Vi søger en dygtig og engageret automekaniker til vores værksted i Hvidovre. Og bare rolig – du behøver ikke nødvendigvis at være udlært mekaniker. Det vigtigste er, at du har hænderne skruet rigtigt på, har erfaring med biler og kan udføre mekanisk arbejde.

Vi tilbyder dig:

- God løn – vi belønner de rigtige kompetencer.

- Gode kollegaer og et godt arbejdsmiljø.

- En varieret arbejdsdag med forskellige bilmærker og opgaver.

- Gode arbejdsforhold og ordentligt værktøj.

- Mulighed for at udvikle dine kompetencer.

- Fast arbejdstid mandag til fredag kl. 08.00-16.00.

- Gode personalegoder og fordele.

- ⚖️ En arbejdsplads med fokus på en god balance mellem arbejde og fritid.

Vi forventer, at du:

- Har erfaring med at skrue i biler.

- Kan arbejde selvstændigt og tage ansvar for dine opgaver.

- Er mødestabil og har en positiv indstilling.

- Har lyst til at være en del af et godt team.

- Gerne har erfaring med fejlfinding og almindelige mekaniske reparationer.

Udlært mekaniker? Ikke et krav!

Vi ved, at man sagtens kan være en dygtig mekaniker uden nødvendigvis at have et svendebrev. Har du erfaringen og de praktiske evner, vil vi meget gerne høre fra dig.

Arbejdssted: Hvidovre

God beliggenhed: Værkstedet ligger tæt på både Hvidovre Station og Friheden Station, og der er gode muligheder for offentlig transport.

Opstart: Hurtigst muligt.

Lyder det som noget for dig?

Så tøv ikke med at kontakte os!

Send en kort besked eller ring til os – du behøver ikke skrive en lang ansøgning. Vi tager gerne en uforpligtende snak over en kop kaffe.

Vi glæder os til at høre fra dig!

Dit Autoværksted | Hvidovre

English:

WE ARE HIRING AN AUTOMOTIVE MECHANIC – ARE YOU OUR NEW COLLEAGUE?

Dit Autoværksted | Hvidovre

Are you passionate about cars, enjoy working with your hands, and want to be part of a workshop where things are well organised, the team is friendly, and working conditions are great?

Then you might be exactly who we are looking for!

We are looking for a skilled and motivated automotive mechanic to join our workshop in Hvidovre.

And don't worry – you don't necessarily need to be a fully qualified mechanic! What matters most is that you have good practical skills, experience working on cars, and know your way around mechanical repairs.

What we offer:

- Competitive salary – we reward the right skills and experience.

- Friendly colleagues and a great working environment.

- A varied working day with different car brands and repair jobs.

- Good working conditions and proper tools and equipment.

- Opportunities to develop your skills and knowledge.

- Fixed working hours, Monday to Friday, 08:00–16:00.

- Great employee benefits and other perks.

- ⚖️ A workplace that values a healthy work-life balance.

What we expect from you:

- Experience working on cars.

- Ability to work independently and take responsibility for your tasks.

- Reliability, punctuality and a positive attitude.

- A willingness to be part of a great team.

- Experience with diagnostics and general mechanical repairs is an advantage.

Fully qualified mechanic? Not a requirement!

We believe that you can be a great mechanic without necessarily having a formal qualification. If you have the experience, practical skills and passion for working on cars, we would love to hear from you!

Work location: Hvidovre, Denmark.

Convenient location: Our workshop is close to both Hvidovre Station and Friheden Station, with excellent public transport connections.

Starting date: As soon as possible.

**Does this sound like the right opportunity for you?**

Don't hesitate to get in touch!

Send us a short message or give us a call – there's no need for a lengthy application. We would be happy to have an informal chat over a cup of coffee.

Ditautovaerksted@hotmail.com

+4528269092

We look forward to hearing from you!

jobs.description: Eltel Networks Oy is a leading provider of critical infrastructure services in the Nordics. Eltel is looking for a hands-on, proactive Commissioning (Cx) Specialist to join our growing Data Center team.The role focuses heavily on the commissioning levels L1 to L5 of data center electrical systems. You have strong attention to detail, particularly in documentation and reporting.You can be based at any of Eltel's 50 offices across Finland. We work in a hybrid model whenever the role allows.Your key responsibilities- Commissioning Execution (Levels L1–L5): Execute data center commissioning phases from factory acceptance testing (FAT) up to integrated systems testing (IST), covering levels L1, L2, L3, L4, and L5.- Test Scripting & Documentation: Develop, review, and execute detailed commissioning test scripts, Method Statements, and inspection checklists for electrical infrastructure.- Electrical System Testing & Energization: Coordinate and execute component and system-level testing for Medium Voltage (MV), Low Voltage (LV), MV & LV Switchgear, Transformers (TX), UPS systems, battery banks, SCADA and BMS/EPMS. Plan and supervise safe live-energization sequences.- Load Bank & Functional Testing (L4): Manage dynamic functional testing, including load bank testing for UPS and generators, steps-load tests, and heat load testing to validate system stability.- Integrated Systems Testing (L5 / IST): Attend to comprehensive blackout tests, failure mode and effects analysis (FMEA) testing, and redundancy validations to ensure the data center achieves full concurrent maintainability.- HSE Leadership & Energy Isolation: Maintain rigid adherence to Health, Safety, and Environment (HSE) protocols. We encourage open-mindedness and curiosity to continuously find better ways to work. A workplace where people care and grow stronger together - Team spirit and peer support consistently receive high marks in Eltels employee surveys. At Eltel, people look out for one another, follow safety protocols, and ensure that everyone gets home safely every day. Together, we create a positive working environment and strive for a healthy work-life balance.Support your professional development - At Eltel we support your professional growth from day one. We are proud of the long careers our employees have built at Eltel, and we are committed to supporting their career development. Employee benefits - Well-being, resilience, and job satisfaction are our key priorities. Eltel offers a wide range of benefits, including ePassi lunch and Flex benefits, a company phone, Auntie mental well-being service, and discounted services such as massage therapy.Sounds interesting?Submit your application through our recruitment system by 30.11. jobs.title: Ravintolatilojen siivooja, Ruka
jobs.description:
Osa-aikainen siivooja ravintolatilojen siivoukseen


Etsimme asiakkaallemme luotettavia siivoajia ravintolatilojen siivoukseen. Työnkuvasi on siivota ravintolatiloja ja työvuorot tulevat painottumaan pe-ma välillä aamu-/päiväajalle klo. 06:00-13:00, mutta on myös arkivuoroja. Osan työstä pystymme myös suorittamaan klo. 13:00 jälkeenkin, joten työajat ovat joustavat oman käytettävyytesi mukaan. Työpäivien kesto vaihtelee riippuen siivottavasta kohteesta 4-6h. 

Kanssamme sinulla on mahdollisuus neuvotella työajoistasi, työpäivien määristä viikoittain sekä työajankohdista riippuen mahdollisista muista töistä, joita teet. Työ sopiikin joustavan luonteensa takia erinomaisesti esimerkiksi henkilöille, jotka haluavat osa-aikaisia töitä tai sitten lisätunteja oman työnsä oheen. 

Jotta olisit sopiva työhön, niin täytyy sinun olla valmis siivoamaan välillä hurjaksikin lipeävien juhlien railakkaita jälkiä. Siivoustekniikat, perusperehdytyksen työhön ja uudet ammattimaiset työvälineet tulet saamaan asiakkaaltamme, joten työhön voit hakea vaikka sinulla ei vielä kokemusta siivousalalta olisikaan. Toivomme kuitenkin, että et ole helposti säikähtävää luonnetta, sillä siivoustyön tiimellyksessä voit törmätä tahraan jos toiseenkin 

Tarjolla ei ole erikseen työn puolesta majoitusta, joten ennenkuin haet työtä, niin on sinulla oltava jo majoitus tai asunto lähialueella sekä tietenkin kulkuväline, jos liikut kauempaa kuin Rukan kylältä töihin. 

Palkkaa työtehtävästä maksetaan sopimuksen mukaisesti 12,59-14€/h + lisät kiinteistöpalvelualan työehtosopimusta noudattaen.

Töitä on tarjolla nopeimmille jo syksystä alkaen ja jatkuen ympäri vuoden sesonkeja kuitenkin mukaillen! 

In english;

Looking for someone living in Ruka or nearby to pick up extra hours in restaurant cleaning!

We are looking for reliable cleaners for our client who are interested in earning extra income through part-time cleaning work. Your job will be to clean restaurant spaces, with shifts primarily scheduled between Friday and Monday in the morning or daytime hours from 6:00AM to 1:00PM. Some tasks can also be completed after 1:00PM, making work hours flexible to fit your availability. The duration of each shift varies depending on the cleaning site, ranging from 4 to 6 hours.

With us, you have the opportunity to negotiate your working hours, the number of workdays per week, and the exact scheduling of shifts based on any other jobs or commitments you may have. Thanks to its flexible nature, this job is perfect for those looking for part-time work or extra hours alongside their primary job. 

To be suitable for this role, you should be prepared to clean up after some wild parties at times! You will receive training on cleaning techniques, a basic introduction to the job, and new professional cleaning equipment from our client, so you can apply even if you have no prior experience in the cleaning industry. However, we do hope youre not easily startled—because in this job, youll encounter all kinds of messes!

Accommodation is not provided as part of the job, so before applying, please make sure you already have a place to stay in the area and a means of transportation if youre commuting from outside Ruka village.

The salary for this role is between €12,26 and €14 per hour, plus additional compensation in accordance with the collective agreement for the real estate services industry.

Work is available for the quickest applicants starting from the Autumn, and can continue year-round, adjusting to seasonal demand!

Lisätietoja, some more details you can ask from: 

Julianna Grönberg
julianna.gronberg@wulff.fi

Wulff Works Etelä Oy

Meidän työntekijämme viihtyvät parhaiten asiakkaillamme! 


Wulff Works on se parempi henkilöstövuokrausyritys. Meillä konkarit etsivät sankareita: tunnistamme hyvät työpaikat ja työnantajat, jotka arvostavat tekijöitä. Palvelemme valtakunnallisesti ja tapaat meitä jo kahdeksalla paikkakunnalla Suomessa.

jobs.title: Operátori zariadení na výrobu potravín a podobných výrobkov
jobs.description:
Stabilná práca v modernom prostredí.

Staň sa súčasťou nášho tímu a pracuj v stabilnej spoločnosti!

Náplň práce:
• balenie hotových výrobkov,
• kontrola kvality výrobkov,
• dodržiavanie hygienických štandardov,
• udržiavanie čistoty na pracovisku.

Pracovný čas:
Dvoj smenná  prevádzka.

Požiadavky uchádzača:
• zodpovedný prístup k práci,
• manuálna zručnosť,
• spoľahlivosť a dochvíľnosť,
• skúsenosti sú výhodou, nie podmienkou.

Čo ponúkame:
• zabezpečené ubytovanie,
• zabezpečenú dopravu,
• stabilnú prácu,
• prácu v potravinárskej výrobe.Výhody:ubytovanie, vlastná doprava zamestnávateľa

jobs.title: Praktické sestry (zdravotnícki asistenti)
jobs.description:
Zdravotnícky asistent v zariadení opatrovateľskej služby vykonáva základné ošetrovateľské, asistentské a administratívne činnosti s uplatňovaním primárnej, sekundárnej a terciálnej prevencii. Pracovné činnosti vykonáva na zverenom úseku práce.
	Zabezpečuje plánované výkony základnej ošetrovateľskej starostlivosti v jednotlivých fázach ošetrovateľského procesu pri uspokojovaní bio - psycho – sociálnych potrieb klienta v spolupráci so sestrou. Pracuje formou pozorovania a zbierania informácií

-	Vykonáva ošetrovateľské úkony v kompetencii praktickej sestry
-	Zodpovedá za objednávanie liekov a zdravotníckych pomôcok
-	Vedie zdravotnú dokumentáciu v systéme Caresse
-	Zastupuje vedúcu zdravotného úseku v čase jej neprítomnosti
-	Zabezpečuje dodržiavanie bezpečného prostredia klienta a ochranu intimity pri poskytovaní základnej starostlivosti
-	Zabezpečuje hygienu prostredia vrátane dezinfekcie zdravotníckych pomôcok,  manipuluje s čistou a znečistenou bielizňou
-	Vykonáva prvú pomoc podľa svojich odborných schopností a zabezpečuje ďalšiu odbornú pomoc
-	Vykonáva hygienickú starostlivosť o pacienta (celkový kúpeľ, starostlivosť o ústnu dutinu, vlasy, nechta) a vykonáva starostlivosť o lôžko
-	Vykonáva činnosti na prevenciu vzniku syndrómu z imobility ( polohovanie, starostlivosť o pohybový režim pacienta) , vykonáva starostlivosť o kožu
-	Aplikuje zábaly, obklady, liečivé kúpele, aplikuje teplé a studené procedúry, lieky na kožu a telových dutín, podáva klystíry, zhotovuje bandáž dolných končatín, pripravuje obväzové materiály
-	Podáva stravu, sleduje príjem potravy a tekutín – zaznamenáva
-	zabezpečuje starostlivosť o vyprázdňovanie hrubého čreva a močového mechúra, stará sa o zavedené permanentné močové katétre, sleduje bilanciu tekutín
-	Vykonáva meranie a záznam fyziologických funkcií pacientov
-	Zaznamenáva zrealizované výkony do dokumentácie klienta
-	Plní pokyny svojho nariadeného 
-	Vykonáva manuálne činnosti v súvislosti s transportom zomretého pacienta
-	Dodržiava pracovnú disciplínu, etický kódex sestry, dôvernosť informácií v súvislosti s pracovným výkonom, hájenie prác klienta v rámci zariadenia

Výhody:príplatky podľa zákonníka práce, stravné

jobs.title: Pracovníci v sklade
jobs.description:
•	Druhové, kvantitatívne preberanie tovaru, jeho uskladnenie a sledovanie podmienok uskladnenia.
•	Samostatné kvalitatívne a kvantitatívne preberanie tovarov, výrobkov, materiálov a surovín, skladovanie podľa osobitných podmienok každého druhu materiálu.
•	Fyzický súpis tovaru a obalov, prepočet a sumarizácia hodnoty zásob  vrátane pokladničnej hotovosti a dokladov.
•	Riadne uskladnenie, ošetrenie a dodržanie záručných lehôt, objednávky potravín a ďalšieho tovaru prevádza podľa pokynov prevádzkarov a nadriadených pracovníkov, pravidelne kontroluje správnosť chladenia nápojov, mraziacich zariadení na potraviny a pod., výdaj potravín zo skladu podľa normovacieho listu a výdajky na potraviny.
•	Zaobstarávanie a nákup tovaru vrátane jeho uskladňovania.
•	Vedie evidenciu obalov a zodpovedá za finančné zúčtovanie, prevádza podľa potreby osobné odbery od dodávateľov, výnimočne aj nákupy za hotovosť, pravidelná účasť pri stanovených inventúrach.
•	Skladová evidencia potravín nápojov a ostatného tovaru. Skladová evidencia čistiacich prostriedkov. 
•	Vykonávanie inventarizácie zásob, vedenie evidencie zásob, podkladov pre mesačné a ročné závierky, vydáva materiál zo skladu.
•	Súčinnosť pri kontrole dodržiavania noriem na výrobu jedál, spôsobu a formy nakladanie s jedlom, potravinami, spôsobu ich ďalšieho uchovávania a skladovania surovín. Súčinnosť pri vykonávaní kontroly zásad správneho stolovania a podávania jedál a nápojov.
•	Súčinnosť pri tvorbe jedálneho lístka, kalkulácií a výpočet cien a cenových lístkov. Pomoc pri nastavovaní kalkulácií, nastavovaní limitov, denný odpočet potravín v programe FOOD.Výhody:Po uplynutí skúšobnej doby nárok zamestnanca na:

- zamestnanecké pobyty v rámci skupiny HOREZZA, a.s.
- poskytnutie zamestnaneckej stravy za symbolickú úhradu.
Doprava z Podsuchej je zabezpečená zamestnávateľom.

jobs.title: Pomocníci v kuchyni
jobs.description: Pomocný pracovník/Pomocná pracovníčka v kuchyni vykonáva predprípravné práce pri príprave potravín na varenie a manipuláciu s nimi. Obsluhuje jednoduché kuchynské stroje a zariadenia. Zabezpečuje udržiavanie čistoty vo všetkých priestoroch prevádzky, suchých skladov, mraziacich boxov a šatne. Zabezpečuje pomocné práce v kuchyni: pomoc pri uskladňovaní potravín do kuchyne pod dohľadom kuchára, pomoc pri vyskladňovaní potravín z kuchyne. Rovnako pomáha pri hrubej príprave potravín pod dohľadom kuchára, za podmienok splnenia prísnych hygienických podmienok (čistá a nečistá práca). Zabezpečuje umývanie riadu ručne alebo pomocou umývacích zariadení a jeho následné triedenie a uskladnenie. Spolupracuje s kuchármi a ostatným personálom. Zabezpečuje obsluhu a umývanie chladiacich zariadení, regálov, pracovných a výdajných stolov i veľkokuchynských zariadení. Zároveň zodpovedá za komplexné upratovanie kuchynskej prevádzky, okolitých priestorov, skladov či miestností súvisiacich s kuchynskou prevádzkou. Pomáha pri triedení odpadu, recykláciu obalov a skladovanie použitého oleja. Dbá na bezpečnosť pri práci, dodržiava zásady osobnej hygieny a hygieny na pracovisku. Nadriadeným pomocného pracovníka/pomocnej pracovníčky v kuchyni je zväčša kuchár/kuchárka, v závislosti od tipu a veľkosti výrobného strediska to môže byť šéf kuchár/kuchárka prípadne aj prevádzkar zodpovedný za úsek stravovania, kde títo zamestnanci preberajú kompetencie vyššieho riadiaceho pracovníka.

jobs.title: Pracovníci v oblasti predaja inde neuvedení
jobs.description:
V zime máme pre vás pripravenú pracovnú pozíciu, pri ktorej sa budete stretávať so zákazníkmi, ktorí si prišli aktívne zašportovať a oddýchnuť si na lyžiach, snowboarde alebo sa vybrať na skialp. Vašou úlohou bude poradiť im s výberom výstroje, ktorá je pre nich vhodná, a správne ju nastaviť. Aj v požičovni u nás vládne skvelá nálada, pretože práve tá je naším hlavným meradlom pri výbere správnych kolegov na všetky pozície v rezorte. Ak teda radi pomáhate ľuďom, máte zmysel pre precíznosť a spĺňate parameter „vždy dobrá nálada", berieme vás medzi nás.

Náplň práce:

požičiavanie a servis lyžiarskej výstroje a športových potrieb,

aktívny predaj a komunikácia s klientmi,

práca s peniazmi a registračnou pokladňou,

kontrola kvality a poškodenia výstroje s následným zabezpečením opravy, servisu, prípadne vyradenia.

Ak chcete stráviť zimu na horách, medzi ľuďmi, ktorí majú lyžovanie v krvi, tešíme sa na Vás.Výhody:ubytovanie

jobs.title: Kuchári (okrem šéfkuchárov)
jobs.description:
Hľadáme šikovného a spoľahlivého kuchára/kuchárku s vášňou pre gastronómiu, ktorý/á by chcel/a pôsobiť v úspešnom tíme reštaurácie Medvedí brloh. Reštaurácia sa nachádza priamo pod svahom Ski Centra Strachan v Ždiari, v malebnom prostredí pod hrebeňom Belianskych Tatier, v celodrevenej stavbe s prvkami pôvodnej goralskej architektúry a s terasou s výhľadom na okolité končiare. Cez deň je Medvedí brloh obľúbeným miestom na dobré jedlo, večer sa však mení na miesto veľkej zábavy, pravidelne tu organizujeme akcie so známymi DJmi.

Čo u nás budete robiť:

Príprava a výdaj jedál podľa jedálneho lístka, ktorý spája tradičné slovenské špeciality (halušky, pirohy) s modernými jedlami ako domáce burgre či pizza

Príprava sezónnych a regionálnych špecialít z kvalitných surovín

Práca v tíme profesionálnych kuchárov pod vedením skúseného šéfkuchára.

Pracovná doba:

Pracovné zmeny: krátky/dlhý týždeň alebo podľa dohody

Ak vás baví varenie, dobrá atmosféra a chcete byť súčasťou tímu obľúbenej reštaurácie priamo pod svahom, kde sa cez deň varí a večer tancuje, tešíme sa na Vás.Výhody:ubytovanie

jobs.title: Inštruktori a cvičitelia športových rekreačných aktivít
jobs.description:
Predstavte si, že nastúpite do tímu 30 mladých ľudí a vašou najťažšou pracovnou úlohou bude... nájsť si medzi nimi nových kamarátov a kolegov. Cez deň budete v Ski school Strachan učiť ľudí prvé (alebo posledné pred pádom) oblúky na lyžiach či snowboarde, a večer, keď sa lekcie skončia, sa z vás aj z celého personálu Strachan Resortu stanú hviezdy parketu, teda skôr stola, v Medveďom brlohu.

Inštruktorom lyžovania alebo snowboardingu sa môžete stať aj bez skúseností, po kurze, na ktorý vám finančne prispejeme, pretože veríme, že najlepšia motivácia je zalyžovať si zadarmo na svahoch Ski centra Strachan aj Ski centra Strednica (a nie len teoreticky vedieť, kde je tá modrá zjazdovka). Máte radi voľnosť a flexibilitu? Do práce vás u nás nikto naháňať nebude, k nám sa chodí s nadšením, a to je presne to, čo na vás naši hostia uvidia už na prvom kruhu.

Zamestnanecké výhody a benefity:

práca v tíme mladých ľudí, s ktorými sa dá prežiť aj lyžovačka, aj afterpárty,

nádherné prostredie Belianskych Tatier, kancelária s výhľadom, o akom sa iným môže len snívať,

flexibilný pracovný čas, žiadne nútené vstávanie, len dobrovoľné,

mzda od 8 €/hod. v čistom

zľavy na služby v Strachan Resorte,

možnosť absolvovať inštruktorský kurz s dotáciou a zvýhodnením, takže sa naučíte lyžovať aj zarábať súčasne.

☎️ „Dobrý deň, máme problém.“

„Aký?“

„Technický.“

„A čo presne nefunguje?“

„No... ono.“

Výborne. Máme prvú stopu. 

Ak dokážeš z takéhoto rozhovoru dostať použiteľné informácie, možno máme prácu presne pre teba.

Prijímanie technických incidentov – „Môžete mi to stručne opísať?“ Nasleduje audiokniha.

Kontrola monitorovacích systémov – sleduješ, čo funguje, čo nefunguje a čo sa len veľmi presvedčivo tvári, že funguje.

Riešenie jednoduchších technických problémov – keď problém vyriešiš za minútu, zvyšných 59 nemusíš predstierať, že to bolo náročné.

Posúvanie zložitejších prípadov na vyššiu podporu – keď problém potrebuje väčšieho odborníka, pošleš ho ďalej. Nie však s popisom „nejde to, veľa šťastia“.

Komunikácia so zákazníkmi a technickými tímami – vieš zostať slušná/ý aj pri vete „Ale susedovi to funguje“.

Práca s Excelom a evidencia incidentov – keď ti Excel napíše #HODNOTA!, neodpovieš mu niečím, čo by HR muselo cenzurovať.

Sledovanie otvorených požiadaviek – nenecháš incident ležať v systéme tak dlho, až dostane nárok na dôchodok.

Dokumentovanie vyriešených problémov – aby sa rovnaká chyba nemusela vyšetrovať každý pondelok ako nový kriminálny prípad.

Kolektív bez povinného firemného úsmevu – môžeš byť normálny človek, nie nadšený komparzista z reklamy na jogurt.  Rodinná atmosféra

jobs.description: Náš marketingový tím má pod palcom pestré portfólio rezortov, služieb a samostatných prevádzok. Každý brand má svoju vlastnú špecifickú komunikáciu na verejnosť (sociálne siete, web, promo):Hlavné rezorty & ubytovacie komplexy:Demänová Rezort – náš najväčší rodinný (family-friendly) komplex.Mara Holiday Resort – celoročné apartmány pri Liptovskej Mare.Mara Camping – obľúbený letný produkt.Ayurvia – špecializované ajurvédske centrum (samostatná časť Demänová Rezortu v spolupráci s partnermi).Všetky naše subbrandy a prevádzky:Gastro: Reštaurácie Pinus a SafranZábava & Šport: SKI centrum, FUN Center, Loď Mária na Liptovskej Mare a Mara FUN (vodné športy)Obchody & Služby: Pekáreň a obchodík Kriváň, Wellness centrum a ďalšie doplňujúce prevádzky.Čo bude Tvojou náplňou práce?Čaká Ťa pestrá exekutíva a operatíva naprieč celým naším portfóliom, pri ktorej sa rozhodne nebudeš nudiť:Tvorba & správa obsahu:Komplexná správa sociálnych sietí (FB, IG, LinkedIn, TikTok) pre naše značky.Zachytávanie denného diania – denné stories, novinky, atmosféra, fotenie a točenie videí priamo v rezorte a na prevádzkach.Odosielanie push notifikácií cez našu aplikáciu FunCard.Príprava a odosielanie newsletterov, pravidelného mailingu a tvorba článkov.Web & Dizajn:Správa, tvorba obsahu a aktualizácia webov (WordPress – hlavné rezortné weby aj jednotlivé jednoduché gastro a produktové weby).Výroba a príprava jednoduchej grafiky, tlačovín, reklamných nosičov a interných materiálov.Eventy & Kampane:Marketingové zastrešenie interných eventov – podklady, grafiky, kampane, tvorba FB udalostí a info na web.Spolupráca na marketingových kampaniach od prvého nápadu až po realizáciu.Zamestnanecké výhody, benefityPrečo sa Ti u nás bude páčiť?Super šanca vyprofilovať sa: Keďže ide o všestrannú juniornú pozíciu, časom zistíš, čo Ťa baví najviac, a môžeš sa smerovať tam, kde sa cítiš najlepšie – či už to bude Content, SEO, Grafika, Social Media alebo Výkonnostný marketing.Dynamická práca: Žiadna nudná, monotónna rutina v kancelárii. Žijeme tým, čo sa v našich prevádzkach reálne deje.Krásne prostredie: Pracujeme v rozprávkovom rezorte ako „dedinka v dedine“ s vlastným jazierkom, wellnessom a skvelými reštauráciami.Skvelé benefity: Zvýhodnený prístup ku všetkým službám rezortu a prevádzkam (obedy, wellness, obchodík, atrakcie na Liptovskej Mare).Priateľská kultúra: Nie sme korporát. Sme otvorený tím, kde máš voľnosť v nápadoch a reálny vplyv na značky, ktoré majú dušu.

jobs.title: Operatieassistent
jobs.description: Als operatieassistent neem je verantwoordelijkheid. Jij zorgt dat alles rondom de ingreep klopt, zodat de chirurg volledig op jou kan vertrouwen. Je denkt vooruit, schakelt snel en blijft rustig als situaties anders lopen dan gepland. Je communiceert duidelijk en prettig met collega's en patiënten. Omdat je werkt in wisselende teams, pas je je makkelijk aan. Verder:- Heb je het diploma Operatieassistent (of rond je de opleiding binnenkort af).- Beheers je de Nederlandse taal goed. Dit is belangrijk voor de communicatie binnen ons team en in het ziekenhuis.- Werk je graag samen, want elke operatie is een teamprestatie.Functie inhoudVraag operatieassistenten in het Erasmus MC waarom dit werk op deze plek zo bijzonder is, en je krijgt verhalen over unieke operaties, intensieve samenwerking met veel verschillende specialismen, volop ruimte om jezelf te ontwikkelen én werken in het leukste team van Rotterdam. Hoe zie je dat terug in je werk: - Je assisteert bij levensreddende ingrepen bij ernstige traumapatiënten uit de hele regio. Maar ook orgaantransplantaties, hartoperaties, kinderhartchirurgie en oncologische chirurgie vinden hier plaats.- Innovatie staat bij ons voorop. Veel nieuwe operaties en technieken worden als eerste in het Erasmus MC uitgevoerd.- Bij ons raak je nooit uitgeleerd. Wil je je op termijn verdiepen in je vak? Dat kan! Wij hebben zoveel specialismen in huis. Verdiep je bijvoorbeeld in neurochirurgie en wordt vakspecialist op dit gebied. In klinische lessen blijf je up-to-date en leer je werken met de nieuwste technieken en instrumenten.- Je wordt goed begeleid en ingewerkt. Zo krijg je alle tijd en ruimte om onze OK en de ingrepen stap voor stap te leren kennen. Nog geen ervaring in een academisch ziekenhuis of net afgestudeerd? Geen probleem! Onze OK is opgedeeld in units. Heb je al een duidelijke interesse in bijvoorbeeld Cardiothoracale Chirurgie, Neurochirurgie of het Sophia Kinderziekenhuis? Of ben je je nog aan het oriënteren? Samen kijken we naar de beste plek. Verdiep je hier alvast in de verschillende units.Onze hoofdlocatie (ook wel centrumlocatie genoemd) heeft 30 operatiekamers. Hier vinden dagelijks de meest complexe en innovatieve operaties plaats. Van orgaantransplantaties en kinderhartchirurgie tot wakkere hersenoperaties en traumachirurgie. Juist die dynamische omgeving maakt jouw werk als operatieassistent én het opleiden van toekomstige operatieassistenten zo uitdagend en interessant. Het Sophia Kinderziekenhuis heeft 9 operatiekamers, 1 interventiekamer, 1 specifieke obstetrie-OK en 1 recovery.

jobs.title: Medior System & Cloud Engineer
jobs.description: Met welke techniek krijg je te maken?Onder andere met Microsoft 365, Azure, Entra ID, Intune, Windows Server, Hyper V, networking, VLANs, routing, switching, WiFi, firewalls, VPN, DNS, back up en recovery, endpoint security, EDR, monitoring, scripting en automatisering. Maar die er ook geen probleem van maakt om bij een nieuwe installatie zelf een kabel te trekken of een access point op te hangen.Kortom: iemand die ICT echt leuk vindt.

jobs.title: Senior Projectmanager
jobs.description:
Jouw Missie bij CCS

Geen dag is hetzelfde in deze rol. Samen met je collega’s zorg je ervoor dat wij succesvol onze softwareoplossingen bij klanten implementeren en dat onze klanten een excellente dienstverlening krijgen! Voor deze complexe systeemimplementaties en integratieprojecten zoeken we een zeer ervaren projectmanager. Je leert de verzekeringsbranche kennen en klanten helpen. Dat doe je niet alleen: je werkt samen met enthousiaste collega’s in een projectteam.

Voordelen voor de sollicitant

Als projectmanager krijg je veel verantwoordelijkheid, help je klanten en samen met je projectteam zet je mooie resultaten neer. Je kunt deels thuiswerken, deels op ons kantoor in Woerden en bij verschillende klanten in Nederland. Tijdelijk werken vanuit het buitenland kan ook dankzij onze workation-regeling (maximaal 30 dagen aaneengesloten per jaar).

Bij ons draait het om klantgericht werken én werkplezier. Daarom is er volop ruimte voor ontspanning en plezier. Denk aan een levend tafelvoetbaltoernooi, pubquiz en een bier- & wijnproeverij. Ons actieve Fun-team zorgt elke maand weer voor iets leuks.

En als je reislust nog niet is gestild met 25 vakantiedagen en een workation, dan kun je zelfs tot 20 extra verlofdagen bijkopen. Genoeg redenen om verder te lezen en te ontdekken of deze functie iets voor jou is, toch?


Een voorbeeld van je werkdag

Opstarten: Aan het begin van je werkdag heb je een dagstart met zowel collega’s als projectteamleden van de klant. Hierin bespreken jullie de voortgang, resultaten en eventuele hulpvragen.

Na de dagstart: Allereerst neem je nog wat tijd met een van de consultants naar aanleiding van de dagstart. Je coacht en begeleidt de consultant en helpt deze met een hulpvraag. Vervolgens ga je aan de slag met het opstellen van de voortgangsrapportage. Hiermee zorg je voor proactieve en transparante rapportage over het project aan de klant. De stuurgroep met de klant is volgende week, vandaag spreek je samen met de delivery manager deze stuurgroep voor. Wat zijn de belangrijkste punten voor de klant en voor CCS en hoe vliegen we die aan.

Na de lunch: Je checkt nog een paar tickets qua voortgang op het planboard, waarbij je de samenhang met de planning checkt. Vervolgens ga je naar de werksessie met het CCS projectmanagement guild. Hier werken jullie aan tickets om de CCS Prince2Agile projectmethodiek verder te verbeteren. Hierna heb je nog een afspraak met je collega van sales voor afstemming over een mogelijk vervolgproject bij de klant.

Wie jij bent

De ideale kandidaat beschikt over daadkracht, doorzettingsvermogen, enthousiasme en drive om projecten succesvol te leiden en verbeteringen door te voeren om te komen tot nog efficiëntere en klantgerichte projecten. Jij herkent jezelf in de volgende punten:

· Je wordt blij van projectmanagement en blijft kalm bij verschuivende prioriteiten;

· Je hebt bewezen ervaring met het succesvol uitvoeren van productsoftware-implementaties in een complexe, maar klantgerichte omgeving, binnen budget, planning en scope;

· Je hebt ruime ervaring met diverse projectmanagement en delivery methodieken, bij voorkeur een Prince2-, Ipma of PMI of Agile / scrum certificaat;

· Je vindt, net als wij, klanttevredenheid het uitgangspunt. Daarbij ben je in staat om de klantverwachtingen helder te analyseren, te managen en actief bij te sturen waar nodig;

· Je beheerst de Nederlandse en Engelse taal uitstekend in woord en geschrift;

· Jouw persoonlijkheid kenmerkt zich door: gestructureerd, motiverend, communicatief sterk, duidelijk, open, tikje eigenwijs, enthousiast, relativerend, creatief en pragmatisch;

· Je haalt energie uit het opstellen en bewaken van planningen, analyseren van gegevens en opstellen van duidelijke, gestructureerde rapportages en presentaties;

· Je hebt minimaal een afgeronde bachelor, bij voorkeur richting bedrijfskunde, bedrijfseconomie en/of informatica.

Wat bieden wij jou?

Naast de genoemde leuke functie binnen een groeiend en innovatief bedrijf bieden wij:

· Salaris: We bieden je een salaris tussen € 5.590 en € 7.958 per maand (o.b.v. 40 uur per week), afhankelijk van je ervaring en kennis;

· Middelen: Leaseauto, laptop, telefoon;

· Werkdagen: Je bent minimaal 4 dagen per week beschikbaar, al heeft 5 dagen onze voorkeur;

· Vergoeding voor thuiswerken: Je kunt gedeeltelijk thuiswerken en krijgt een onkostenvergoeding van € 2,40 per thuiswerkdag. Ook krijg je een budget van € 750,- om thuis een ergonomische werkplek in te richten;

· Workation: Je kunt tot 30 dagen aaneengesloten per jaar vanuit het buitenland werken;

· Leuke teamactiviteiten: Leer je collega’s beter kennen door deel te nemen aan maandelijkse evenementen georganiseerd door ons energieke Fun-team, zoals een pubquiz, Zomer BBQ, wine & beer tastings en movie night;

· Vakantiedagen: Je krijgt 25 vakantiedagen en de mogelijkheid om maximaal 20 extra dagen bij te kopen;

· Groei en ontwikkeling: De mogelijkheid om je vaardigheden en verantwoordelijkheden te ontwikkelen binnen de functie, middels opleidingen en Linkedin learning, of door te stromen naar een van de andere functies binnen CCS;

· Vakantiegeld: Jaarlijks 8,33%;

· Voordelen: Je krijgt een aantrekkelijke pensioenregeling met een lage eigen bijdrage en kunt gebruikmaken van collectieve verzekeringen met korting. Ook is er een bedrijfsfitnessregeling voor een gezonde levensstijl en een fietsregeling voor duurzaam vervoer.

Waarom CCS?

Omdat wij geloven dat werk meer is dan een baan. Het is een plek waar je jezelf kunt zijn, impact kunt maken en kunt groeien. Het is een omgeving waar je wordt geïnspireerd om het beste uit jezelf te halen en samen te werken aan een duurzame toekomst. Kom bij ons en ontdek wat er mogelijk is als je een carrière bouwt vol passie, plezier en betekenis. Jij bent de ontbrekende schakel in ons team. Word onderdeel van ons verhaal. 🚀

jobs.title: Product Engineer, Shop
jobs.description:
ABOUT INSIFY

We sell a mix of insurance products to small businesses (SME's) in the Netherlands, Germany and France, and we are in the process of scaling into more markets. 

Insurance infrastructure is brutal to get right. Every carrier has its own spec, every product its own underwriting rules, every country its own regulatory requirements. Most insurers throw people and process at that complexity - one-off integrations, workarounds on workarounds. We're building it differently: our insurance platform is where we consolidate that complexity, so that launching a new product or market becomes a configuration exercise rather than a rebuild.

Insify is a high-growth scale-up backed by more than €40M from investors like Accel, Munich Re Ventures, and Formula 1 champion Nico Rosberg. In five years we've expanded from the Netherlands into France and Germany. Our mission: become the European leader in AI-powered SME insurance.


About the role

You would join the Shop team, responsible for everything that happens after a small business buys a policy from us. You would help shape how the platform handles the next product and the next country, on a system already carrying live policies and real customers.

The team owns end-to-end policy lifecycle management (mid-term adjustments, automated renewals, cancellations, and payment flows) alongside the backoffice tooling that gives our operations and support teams full visibility and control. We work closely with the Claims Team, and with the Activation Teams that turn a lead into a paying customer. Product and engineering together are 30+ people.

Every country has its own regulatory quirks, and every insurance product has unique data structures, lifecycle rules, and money flows.

As we expand across Europe, our goal isn't to write custom glue code for every new launch. It's to design elegant, reusable platform abstractions. We're building a system where introducing a new country or product feels like snapping modular building blocks together.

You're joining at an exciting inflection point: we have real traction, proven scale, and you get to directly build the foundational platform that powers our next wave of European growth.


What you'll be doing
  • Owning end-to-end the discovery and delivery of crucial platform features that enable our ability to scale as an insurance business

  • Experience building B2B products, especially in insurance & fintech
  • Experience working on a product distributed across different country markets
  • Strong observability instincts. You know where things will break, and can help others learn that too

    • Our stack

    TypeScript across the board, running on AWS (IaaC), in a single monorepo. If you have not worked with all of it, that is fine. We care more about how you reason about systems than about which tools you have used before.

jobs.title: Freelance E-Commerce Operations & AI Manager - Right Hand to the CBO - 25 - 30h/week
jobs.description:
For my client, a DTC jewelry brand I'm looking for the CBO's right hand. You will take a large share of operational and admin work off her plate, keep projects moving and use AI to make the way they work faster.

What you will do

👉Operations: check stock against launches and campaigns, track our manufacturing partner (delays, open orders, quality) and keep new designs on schedule from brief to first order

👉Website & CRO: keep product pages, FAQs and prices up to date, QA before go-live, brief our developers and suggest UX and conversion improvements

👉 Marketing: coordinate with performance marketing and our newsletter agency, support influencer marketing and whitelisting, and bring ideas to our social team (creating content yourself is a plus)

👉Business: understand our product catalogue deeply – what sells and why – and help take customer service to the next level by weighing cost against value

👉Admin: run the CBO's week – agendas, notes, action items and a weekly status update

👉AI: spot recurring tasks and automate them with the best AI tools available

👉You handle follow-ups, QA, reporting and automations independently; decisions on launches, pricing and budgets stay with the CBO, and you prepare them.

The first three months focus on taking work off her plate and learning our processes; after that, automation and wider ownership follow.
Success means the CBO spends noticeably less time on operations and admin.

Must-haves

👉Around 5 years in e-commerce or DTC, ideally fashion, jewelry or beauty
👉Experience in UX and conversion rate optimisation (e.g. A/B tests, product pages, checkout)
👉Daily, hands-on use of AI tools of all kinds, and you keep up with what is new
👉Very structured, proactive and persistent in closing loops
👉Fluent English; German is a strong plus
👉Experienced freelancer, comfortable working remotely in Slack


Nice-to-haves

👉Influencer marketing or whitelisting experience
👉Shopify, Klaviyo, Gorgias, ClickUp or Modash
👉Content creation for Instagram or TikTok
👉Based in Amsterdam

If this sounds like a good fit, send us a short introduction about your background, the e-commerce projects you've worked on, and how you've used AI to improve workflows or automate tasks.

Har du arbejdet med salg, telemarketing eller marketing i mere end et år og er klar til næste skridt i din karriere? Eller brænder du for digital markedsføring, er kreativ og vil gerne certificeres som konsulent, der hjælper virksomheder med at skabe succesfulde digitale kampagner?

Hvis du er teknisk stærk, kreativ og udadvendt — og samtidig trives i et tempofyldt og foranderligt miljø — så har vi måske det perfekte job til dig.

Hvad laver en Google Ads Sales and Onboarding Specialist?

Du arbejder tæt sammen med ambitiøse virksomheder, der skal onboardes til digital vækst. Du rådgiver om Pay-Per-Click-kampagner (PPC), identificerer vækstmuligheder og skaber langsigtet værdi. Med forståelse for markedsdynamik og strategisk tænkning styrker du system integrering og kundeloyalitet — med effekt og relation i centrum.

Skaber vækst og digitale resultater

Du udvikler og optimerer kampagner, opsøger kunder via telefon og video, og identificerer løsninger, der matcher deres unikke behov. Du opbygger tillid og sikrer, at dine kunder får det fulde udbytte af deres digitale investeringer — både på kort og lang sigt.

Styrker kunderejser og partnerskaber

Du håndterer et højt volumen af kunder og rådgiver i komplekse kontekster. Du arbejder med strategier, der øger ROI og kampagnespend, og bistår med integration på tværs af platforme. Du bruger AI-værktøjer i din dagligdag og kommunikerer effektivt med forskellige interessenter — altid med respekt for datasikkerhed og GDPR.

Du bliver en del af et globalt team i hjertet af Barcelona, hvor teknologi og marketing mødes. 

Engelsktalende arbejdsmiljø er standard, og du får fuldt betalt oplæring, personlige coaches og adgang til certificeringer. Stillingen åbner døre til intern karriereudvikling og spændende projekter inden for digital markedsføring.

Dit ansvar:

  • Onboarding af kunder og opbygning af langsigtede relationer over telefon og videomøder

  • Udvikling af performance-drevne PPC-strategier

  • Proaktivt salg og kampagneoptimering

  • Opdatering og vedligeholdelse af kundedata

  • Rådgivning om digital positionering og annoncering

  • Forståelse for ROI og integration med andre platforme

  • Support og strategisk planlægning på nordisk niveau

Dine kvalifikationer:

  • Dansk og engelsk på minimum C1

  • Bachelorgrad eller relevant erfaring i marketing/salg/Telemarketing

  • Kendskab til Google Ads, CRM og datastyring

  • Proaktiv og strategisk tilgang til kundeopgaver

  • Evne til at navigere i komplekse stakeholder-miljøer

  • Passion for digital markedsføring og forretningsudvikling

Du behøver ikke opfylde alle krav — hvis rollen vækker din interesse, opfordrer vi dig stadig til at søge!

Benefits:

  • Fast fuldtidsstilling (39 timer/uge) med hybridmodel i Barcelona

  • Flyttepakke med flybillet og indkvartering i privat studie

  • Privat sygeforsikring og sundhedsfokus

  • Bonus for at anbefale en ven

  • Certificeringer og løbende kompetenceudvikling

  • Arbejdsmiljø med sociale aktiviteter og teambuilding

  • Kontor med havudsigt i World Trade Center, Barcelona

Hvad får du ud af at tage afsted?

Barcelona byder på solrige dage, strandliv og kreativ energi. Her kan du nyde tapas ved havet, arbejde med banebrydende teknologi og udvikle dig både personligt og professionelt i et byliv, der aldrig står stille. Derudover får du:

  • Lavere leveomkostninger end Danmark

  • Kunst, musik, tech og kultur i dynamisk samspil

  • Fokus på trivsel og diversitet

  • Internationale brands og karrieremuligheder

  • Åben og inkluderende atmosfære

Professionel udvikling:

  • Indsigt i digital markedsføring og internationale arbejdskulturer

  • Specialiseret viden om Google Ads og online strategi

  • Fuld oplæring og adgang til certificeringer

  • Karriereveje inden for tech, salg og rådgivning

  • Mulighed for at arbejde med kunder fra hele Europa

Personlig vækst og karriere:

Forestil dig at starte dagen med café con leche, arbejde med digitale strategier under palmerne og slutte af med live-musik ved stranden. Hos TP får du ikke bare et job — du får muligheden for at bygge en karriere, forme fremtiden og leve livet fuldt ud.

Barcelona er stedet, hvor arbejde og livskvalitet går op i en højere enhed.

SeeSicht is a small family office of AI-first companies. We build companies that are profitable today and keep them for the long term — not a venture builder chasing funding rounds. Every project is funded 100% by me or by me and my network. No investor search, no fundraising rounds.

Your first months at SeeSicht Gmbh

You will take on core business development tasks, working alongside experienced team members to support company initiatives. Through daily operations, you will learn how the business scales and manage assigned projects within a hybrid work environment.

What you will do

  • You execute. I bring the ideas, the network and the money — you turn them into real products, pages, campaigns and processes.

  • You build and test the way we always do it: build a sellable prototype (CHF 100–1,000), test it on the market with Facebook ads (CHF 5,000–10,000), build the product fully (CHF 10,000–20,000), then launch with real marketing spend.

  • MyBikePlan is the proof: 2019 idea, one-week website, one week of Facebook marketing, CHF 500 invested → 30 pre-orders. 2020 launch with CHF 1M in the first year, 2021 team, 2025 sold close to CHF 20M. The playbook is set — you run it on new projects.

The timeline — how it works

  • Months 1–12 — the internship: CHF 2,500/month, full-time, paid, and inside that year up to 10% of the profit of the project/company you work on.

What you get from day 1

  • All the AI tools

  • Me, coaching and strategising side by side with you

Who we're looking for (requirements)

  • You're finishing or just finished university.

jobs.description:
Über uns

Parkview Invest AG ist eine inhabergeführte Schweizer Investmentgesellschaft mit einem diversifizierten Portfolio aus privaten Unternehmensbeteiligungen, Immobilien, Fonds und weiteren Vermögenswerten.

Unsere Aktivitäten umfassen mehrere Gesellschaften und Beteiligungen im In- und Ausland. Im Rahmen der strategischen Weiterentwicklung konzentrieren wir uns verstärkt auf die professionelle Verwaltung bestehender Investments, die Vereinfachung unserer Unternehmensstrukturen und die effiziente Steuerung unserer Finanz- und Administrationsprozesse.

Zur Verstärkung unseres schlanken Teams suchen wir eine erfahrene, eigenständig arbeitende Persönlichkeit, die das operative Finanzmanagement unserer Gesellschaften übernimmt und unsere Geschäftsführung sowie externe Dienstleister unterstützt.

Deine Aufgaben

1. Finanzbuchhaltung & Jahresabschlüsse

  • Koordination der laufenden Buchhaltung mehrerer Gesellschaften in der Schweiz und im Ausland in Zusammenarbeit mit externen Treuhändern und Steuerberatern
  • Vorbereitung und Kontrolle von Monats-, Quartals- und Jahresabschlüssen inkl. Abstimmung von Bankkonten, Intercompany-Positionen, Darlehen, Finanzanlagen und digitalen Vermögenswerten
  • Aufbereitung von Unterlagen für Steuererklärungen, Revisionen und regulatorische Anforderungen

2. Zahlungsverkehr & Liquiditätsmanagement

  • Vorbereitung und administrative Abwicklung von Zahlungen über verschiedene Gesellschaften und Bankverbindungen (Freigabe und Zeichnung verbleiben beim Management)
  • Überwachung von Zahlungsfristen, offenen Rechnungen und wiederkehrenden Verpflichtungen inkl. Gesellschafterdarlehen und konzerninternen Finanzierungen
  • Führung von Liquiditätsübersichten und kurzfristigen Cashflow-Planungen sowie Koordination von Bankanfragen und Kontounterlagen

3. Investment Administration & Reporting

  • Pflege der finanziellen Stammdaten sowie administrative Abwicklung von Capital Calls, Ausschüttungen, Zinszahlungen und Rückflüssen
  • Abstimmung von Depot- und Bankauszügen sowie Dokumentation von Bewertungen, Beteiligungsquoten und Investmentbewegungen
  • Datenpflege und Aktualisierung standardisierter Finanz- und Portfolioübersichten als Grundlage für die Berichterstattung an Management und Verwaltungsrat

4. Administration & Prozesse

  • Koordination von KYC-, AML- und weiteren Dokumentationsanforderungen sowie Pflege von Gesellschaftsunterlagen, Verträgen und Fristen
  • Unterstützung bei administrativen Vorgängen rund um Restrukturierungen, Beteiligungsübertragungen oder Gesellschaftsauflösungen
  • Weiterentwicklung und Automatisierung bestehender Finance- und Administrationsprozesse sowie einheitlicher Reportingstandards

Der Schwerpunkt der Rolle liegt auf den Bereichen 1–3.

Fachliche Qualifikationen

  • Kaufmännische oder betriebswirtschaftliche Ausbildung mit Schwerpunkt Finanz- und Rechnungswesen; Weiterbildung als Fachperson Finanz- und Rechnungswesen oder Treuhänder/in von Vorteil
  • Mehrjährige Erfahrung in Finanzbuchhaltung, Controlling, Treasury oder Finance Operations sowie gute Kenntnisse des Schweizer Rechnungswesens
  • Erfahrung mit mehreren Gesellschaften, Beteiligungsstrukturen oder internationalen Sachwerten von Vorteil; Affinität zu digitalen Vermögenswerten ein Plus
  • Sehr gute Excel- und MS-Office-Kenntnisse sowie sicherer Umgang mit digitalen Buchhaltungs- und Dokumentationssystemen
  • Sehr gute Deutsch- und Englischkenntnisse

Persönliche Eigenschaften

  • Selbstständige, strukturierte und sehr genaue Arbeitsweise
  • Diskretion und professioneller Umgang mit vertraulichen Finanzinformationen
  • Unternehmerisches, pragmatisches Denken und Freude daran, in einer schlanken Organisation Verantwortung zu übernehmen

Was wir bieten

  • Eine vielseitige Finance- und Administrationsrolle im Umfeld eines Schweizer Family Offices
  • Einblick in unterschiedliche Anlageklassen, Unternehmensbeteiligungen und internationale Gesellschaftsstrukturen
  • Hohe Eigenständigkeit und direkte Zusammenarbeit mit dem Management
  • Flexible Arbeitszeiten und eine weitgehend ortsunabhängige Arbeitsorganisation
  • Möglichkeit, bestehende Prozesse aktiv mitzugestalten und zu professionalisieren

jobs.title: Revenue Cycle Manager
jobs.description:
About Us

We are fixing US healthcare by building an AI-native physical care platform, starting with home health.

Home health is a $140B industry with less than $10B in EBITDA â 40% of revenue is spent on pure administrative waste. We automate this work with AI, creating a fundamentally different cost structure compared to incumbents. This lets us rapidly take market share by serving the 30% of patients who go untreated today.

By reshaping the cost structure of this industry, we unlock its growth.

We've built one of the best AI teams in the world (from Character AI, Scale, Palantir, Citadel, Jane Street) and paired them with a team of healthcare veterans to build a new type of healthcare company: one that delivers care at the speed of an AI company.

Our physical care platform already operates with 30pp higher gross margins than traditional home health providers. With our AI advantage, we pay nurses more, remove their admin burden, and unlock the scale economics that have been missing from this fragmented industry. If we served this entire $140B market, instead of $10B in EBITDA, we'd drive $60B.

We're starting with home health, then expanding to all delivered care. Our mission is "any care, any where".

Fundamentally, our incentives are aligned with America. Every dollar in revenue we make is two dollars taken out of the healthcare system. If we succeed, so does US healthcare.

Role overview

Weâre seeking a hands-on Revenue Cycle Management (RCM) Manager to lead and support a team of specialists in a home health environment. This manager will stay close to daily operations, monitor team performance, and respond quickly to questions and emerging issues to help the team meet its goals. The role focuses on accounts receivable (AR), helping the team move outstanding claims from follow-up to verified resolution.

What Youâll Do

  • Manage and support RCM specialists working across home health revenue cycle workflows.

  • Track attendance and monitor individual and team performance against established KPIs and daily quotas.

  • Review workflow boards throughout the day to spot backlogs, red flags, and specialists at risk of missing their end-of-day quotas.

  • Respond promptly to specialist questions while balancing real-time workflow monitoring and other team needs.

  • Identify process gaps and work with the team to resolve issues affecting daily performance.

  • Apply your home health and Homecare Homebase (HCHB) knowledge to help specialists navigate workflows and resolve operational questions.

Accounts receivable and collections

  • Guide specialists and team leads in prioritizing assigned commercial, Medicare, and Medicare Advantage receivables, including aged balances, payer responses, rejections, denials, and upcoming filing or appeal deadlines.

  • Oversee claim follow-up through resolution: verify claim status and payment, investigate collection barriers and underpayments, and guide appropriate corrections, reprocessing, reconsiderations, or appeals under payer-specific requirements.

  • Review and respond to escalations when a specialist cannot determine the next action; surface recurring payer, workflow, or system issues to leadership and coordinate their resolution.

  • Ensure claim activity, supporting evidence, next actions, and follow-up dates are documented accurately in the applicable AR workflow and HCHB.

  • Partner with billing, payment posting, prior authorization, clinical, and other teams to resolve discrepancies, obtain documentation, and follow paid-but-not-posted claims through resolution.

  • Review proposed write-offs for documented collection efforts and supporting evidence, and route them through the required approval and posting process.

Quality and team development

  • Review claim work for accurate denial interpretation, appropriate action, complete documentation, timely follow-up, and correct escalation; use findings to coach specialists and strengthen performance.

  • Support onboarding, payer and system cross-training, and regular knowledge sharing. Identify patterns behind collection challenges and update SOPs or workflows to prevent repeat issues.

  • Share frontline feedback on AR dashboards and automation with relevant teams to improve prioritization, visibility, and specialist workflows.

Basic Qualifications

  • Strong experience in home health revenue cycle operations.

  • Familiarity with Homecare Homebase (HCHB).

  • Experience managing RCM specialists, including tracking attendance and performance KPIs.

  • Experience monitoring workflows throughout the day and identifying risks to daily productivity targets.

  • Experience identifying collection challenges and implementing processes to resolve.

  • Working knowledge of AR follow-up, denial investigation, appeals or reprocessing, and payer-specific filing requirements.

  • Experience reviewing claim documentation and quality, escalating unresolved issues, and coordinating with billing or posting teams.

  • Ability to respond promptly to team questions while managing multiple priorities.

  • Ability to identify workflow or process gaps and help the team address them.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience managing distributed or offshore revenue cycle teams.

  • Familiarity with commercial fee-for-service and Medicare or Medicare Advantage home health claims, including episodic/PDGM workflows.

  • Experience with AR dashboards, clearinghouses, and payer portals such as Waystar and Availity.

  • Experience using denial trends, quality reviews, or operational data to improve collections workflows and team training.

What We Offer

  • Competitive salary

  • Comprehensive health insurance, dental, and commuter benefits

  • 401(k) retirement plan with employer contribution

  • Opportunity for growth in a fast-growing company

  • Collaborative team valuing innovation and problem-solving

jobs.title: Senior Product Manager
jobs.description:
About us

At Pencil, we are driving innovation in advertising technology through our state-of-the-art SaaS product, which harnesses Agentic AI to redefine content creation. Our mission is to make AI the default in advertising without replacing creative people. To achieve this, we need to make sure that our technology isn't just in the hands of big brands - we need to try to help small businesses and creative individuals too.

The role

Workflows are how most of the creative on Pencil gets made. A workflow is a visual sequence of steps, covering inputs, generation, brand assets, scoring, branching logic and delivery, that a person builds once and runs again whenever the job repeats, on demand or on a schedule. This role owns that product and the connections that feed it, with one goal: more workflows built and run, by more people, across every customer.

You will own Workflows and Integrations. That covers the workflow builder, templates, scheduling and run management, and the steps that workflows are built from. It also covers the platform's third-party connections outside media: digital asset management systems, file storage such as Google Drive, translation services, data services such as Foreplay, and more than a hundred other business tools. You will make those connections part of the workflow itself, so that a run can start from a client's systems and deliver back into them. You will build them on a common framework, so that each new connection is quicker to ship than the last and client teams can build on it for individual clients.

You will also own how workflows show up inside Scribble, our creative agent. Agents can already run as steps inside a workflow. The next step is for Scribble to find, build, change and run workflows on a person's behalf and report back as they run, and for a workflow to pause for a person's decision and act on it. You will work closely with the team that builds Scribble, and you will own the workflow experience it works through, so that a workflow behaves the same whether a person or an agent is driving it. When that works, building a workflow stops being a specialist job.

Key responsibilities

  • Own the charter for Workflows and Integrations: the durable problem, success metrics, and an explicit in and out scope list.

  • Grow adoption across every customer, measured by the number of workflows built and run and the number of people building them.

  • Make building a workflow simple enough for a marketer or creative to do without help, through templates, guided set-up and defaults that cover the common jobs.

  • Own the workflow experience that Scribble works through, so that an agent can find, build, change and run a workflow with the same tools a person uses.

  • Make human review part of the run: a workflow should pause for a person's decision, record it, and continue down the right path.

  • Make runs dependable at volume, with scheduling, run management, failure handling and clear status, so that a team trusts a workflow to run unattended.

  • Own third-party integrations outside media, from digital asset management and file storage to translation and data services, and make them built-in steps in a workflow, so that a run can start from a client's systems and deliver back into them.

  • Set the integration framework and standards that client teams build on when they connect a system for a single client.

  • Work with customers to find the jobs they repeat every week and turn them into workflows and templates that others can reuse.

  • Run the full lifecycle from discovery to post-launch review, with a written hypothesis before every ship and a review against it afterwards.

  • Use product data and structured customer feedback to set priorities, working backwards from evidenced customer need.

  • Partner closely with design on the builder experience, and with engineering on run reliability and the integration framework. Partner with the PMs who own Scribble, agents and the editor, and with the client teams who build on your framework.

Your background

You will have three to five years of product management experience, and you want to own a key product and take it to the next level. You might be a great fit if you can walk us through:

  • A product you grew from a small group of power users to broad adoption, and what you changed to get there.

  • Shipping a builder, automation or workflow tool, and what you learned about making something powerful easy to start with.

  • Building integrations with third-party platforms or APIs: how you chose which to build, and how you kept them working.

  • A time you built from validated customer need in a domain you had to go and learn. If your instinct is to start with a demo, this is not the role.

  • A decision you changed because the data told you to. Fluent in qual and quant.

  • Experience with AI agents or AI-assisted products is a plus.

You'll Thrive Here If Youâ¦

  • Move Fast. You're comfortable making decisions with imperfect information, iterating quickly, and fixing things before they become fires;

  • Stay Human. You care deeply about users and teammates, and design with empathy for real workflows;

  • Act Like an Owner. You take responsibility for outcomes, not just outputs. You spot problems early and take initiative to fix them.

  • Keep It Simple. You fight unnecessary complexity, design reusable patterns, and make hard things feel intuitive.

  • Love to Surprise. You enjoy finding unexpected ways to delight users, especially in the last mile of polish and usability.

KPIs & Success Measures

We will measure success through outcomes and quality, not just output:

  • Builder share (lead): percentage of monthly active users who build or edit a workflow. Target [TBD]%.

  • Workflow adoption (lead): percentage of monthly active users who run a workflow. Target [TBD]%.

  • Workflow run growth: month-on-month percentage growth in workflow runs. Target [TBD]%.

  • First workflow conversion: percentage of new users who complete a successful run within their first [TBD] days.

  • Share of generations through workflows: percentage of all generations produced by workflow runs.

  • Agent and human collaboration: percentage of workflow runs built or started by Scribble.

  • Connector adoption: percentage of active workspaces that use at least one third-party connection in a workflow each month. Target [TBD]%.

  • Integration usage: percentage of workflow runs that start from, or deliver to, a third-party connection. Target [TBD]%.

  • Reliability (hygiene bar): percentage of runs that complete without manual intervention, held at or above [TBD]%.

  • Learning velocity (supporting): percentage of launches reviewed after release against their stated hypothesis. Target 100%.

Benefits

  • 25 days PTO plus public holidays, although we operate a Flexible Time Off scheme

  • Health insurance / private medical cover

  • Monthly stipend towards wellness, fitness, and learning and development

  • Remote - work from anywhere in your home country

  • Enhanced parental leave policies, whether you become a parent through birth, adoption or surrogacy

  • Access to our Pencil office in The Shard, London for our UK employees

  • Flexible working hours

Deep Dive About Pencil

Pencil uses AI to make ads. Our mission is to make marketing effective and effortless. We want to become the default way ads get made - because AI ads are 10x faster and cheaper to make, and 2x better performing, than making them without AI.

We're called Pencil because we believe AI will be a tool for creative people, not a replacement - it may even be as fundamental a tool in the future as the pencil was in the past.

Pencil was founded in 2018 with a team from Google, Facebook and Uber with backing from Sequoia and Entrepreneur First. We were acquired by The Brandtech Group in 2023 to pursue a shared vision of bringing GenAI to the Fortune 500.

https://www.trypencil.com

About The Brandtech Group

The Brandtech Group's mission is to be the best company in the world at helping leading global brands drive growth by connecting content, data and media using technology.

It was founded in June 2015 (as You & Mr Jones) by former Havas Global CEO David Jones, with a simple mission to help brands do their marketing better, faster and cheaper using technology. It was renamed The Brandtech Group in January 2022.

Today it generates more than $1BN in revenue and is the largest global digital content partner for many of the world's biggest brands and companies, often using its unique in-housing model. It works with eight of the world's top 10 global advertisers and 49 of the world's top 100. Clients include Banco ItaÃº, Danone, Google, Intuit, LVMH, Microsoft, Morgan-Stanley, Netflix, Reckitt, Renault-Nissan, PayPal, TikTok, Uber and Unilever.

In addition, the Group invests in cutting-edge technology companies relevant to and with potential in marketing and has been investing in the AI, AR and the metaverse space since 2015. The Group was the first external investor in Niantic (creators of PokÃ©mon Go), alongside investments in AI Foundation (AI digital twins, personalized AI, and deep-fake detection 2018), Automat (AI chatbots, 2016), Elsy (AI media planning, 2016), Jivox (dynamic automated content, 2016), Crossing Minds (deep learning AI recommendation system, 2017), CreativeX (AI-driven content optimization, 2022), Zappar (AR, 2017), Provenance (blockchain, 2022) and GGP (the world's largest gaming fund).

The Group is one of the most prominent marketing industry voices on the prediction and movement to AI-driven marketing, including Generative AI. It was named one of the World's Most Innovative Companies 2021 by Fast Company, and by CB Insights as one of the World's Most Valuable Private Unicorns.
