jobs.title: Researcher in Biostatistics
jobs.description:
About the position

We are seeking applicants with a strong methodological background in biostatistics and causal inference for a 3-year 20% researcher position in Biostatistics, in a project on causal inference for effects of health related interventions on working life outcomes, at the Oslo Centre for Biostatistics and Epidemiology (OCBE), Department of Biostatistics, University of Oslo (UiO).

OCBE is one of Europe's most active biostatistics groups with currently about 80 researchers. OCBE is internationally recognized, with interests spanning a broad range of areas, including causal inference and time-to-event analysis, clinical trials, epidemiology, high dimensional statistics, infectious disease, machine learning and mathematical modelling. The centre has numerous collaborations with leading biomedical research groups internationally and in Norway.

More about the position

The candidate will be part of the research group on causal inference and survival analysis led by professor Jon Michael Gran, where they will work on causal inference with applications to longitudinal data from large population-wide registries. The position is connected to the project “Improving causal inference for individual working life trajectories from registry data: studying interventions, estimands and heterogeneity”, funded by the Research Council of Norway (RCN). The project is a close collaboration with research groups at the National Institute of Occupational Health (STAMI) and Oslo University Hospital (OUS).

The candidate will pursue research on causal inference for treatment effect estimation from complex longitudinal data, collected from various population wide registries. An emphasis will be made on exposure measurement error, interference, effect heterogeneity and the analysis of individual outcome trajectories. However, other methods may also be relevant. Methods should be motivated in and applied to answering the subject matter research questions of the overall project, such as of the effects of interventions for a more inclusive working life (including rehabilitation measures and work place facilitation) or the effects of sustained medical treatments (including use of opioids and other type of pain treatment for patients after traumatic injury). Outcomes of interest will be related to long term health, sick leave and work participation. 

The candidate’s role in the project will be both to supervise other project members and to conduct own methodological and applied research in biostatistics. We provide an exciting and friendly research environment for the development and application of new methods in a collaborative and interdisciplinary fashion, with various national and international collaborators. The candidate will work closely with other project members at OCBE, STAMI and OUS, other external collaborators, and the causal inference and survival analysis group at OCBE. The candidate will participate in regular project meetings and must have the ability to work well in a multi-disciplinary team.

The candidate’s workplace will be at OCBE’s premises in the UiO building Domus Medica.

Preferred starting date for the position is January 1st, 2027. 

Qualifications requirements

Required quialifications:

  • Applicants must hold a degree corresponding to a Norwegian doctoral degree in biostatistics or statistics. 
  • A broad background from methodological research in causal inference is required. 
  • Strong quantitative and computational skills is required. Applicants should be fluent in R or equivalent software.
  • Experience with interdisciplinary collaborations and student supervision at PhD level is required. 

Desired qualifications:

  • Experience within areas relevant for the project will be an advantage.
  • Experience with analysis of large datasets is an advantage. Experience with biomedical applications is also an advantage.
  • Personal suitability will be emphasized.

Language requirements:

  • Working language in the group and at OCBE is English. Fluent oral and written communication skills in English is required.
Personal skills
  • Ability to work independently and efficiently.
  • Good communication and collaborative skills.

Employment in the position is based on a comprehensive assessment of all qualification requirements applicable to the position, including personal qualifications.

We need different perspectives in our work 

UiO is an open and internationally oriented comprehensive university that strives to be an inclusive and diverse workplace and academic environment. You can read more about UiO’s work on equality, inclusion, and diversity at uio.no.

We fulfill our mission most effectively when we draw upon our variety of experiences, backgrounds, and perspectives. We are looking for great colleagues—could you be the next one?

We will provide appropriate accommodations should you need them. Relevant adjustments may include modifications to working hours, task adaptations, digital, technical, or physical adjustments, or other practical measures.

If you have an immigrant background, a disability, or CV gaps, we encourage you to indicate this in the job application portal. We always invite at least one qualified candidate from each group for an interview. In this context, disability is defined as an applicant who identifies as having a disability that requires workplace or employment-related accommodations. For more details about the requirements, please refer to the Employer portal (Norwegian).

The selections made in the job application portal are used for anonymized statistics that all state employers include in their annual reports.More information about gender equality initiatives at UiO can be found here.

We hope you will apply for the position with us. 

We offer
  • Exciting and meaningful tasks in an organization with an important societal mission, contributing to knowledge development, education, and enlightenment that promote sustainable, fair, and knowledge-based societal development.
  • A friendly, ambitious and international working environment.
  • Attractive welfare benefits and a generous pension agreement, in addition to Oslo’s family-friendly environment with its rich opportunities for culture and outdoor activities.
  • Opportunity of up to 1.5 hours a week of exercise during working hours.
  • A workplace with good development and career opportunities. 
  • Membership in the Statens Pensjonskasse, which is one of Norway's best pension schemes with beneficial mortgages and good insurance schemes.
  • Salary in position as Researcher, position code 1109 in salary range NOK from 670 000 - 775 000, depending on competence and experience. For particularly well-qualified applicants, a higher salary may be considered. From the salary, 2 percent is deducted in statutory contributions to the State Pension Fund.

Read more about the benefits of working in the public sector at Employer Portal.

Application

Your application must include:

  • Application letter with a short statement of motivation and research interests
  • CV (summarizing education and relevant experience).
  • A complete list of publications
  • Transcripts and certificates
  • List of 2-3 references (name, relation to candidate, e-mail and phone number). 

Your CV must be entered in Jobbnorge’s CV form and cannot be submitted only as an attachment. This requirement is intended to ensure correct documentation and record-keeping in accordance with the Public Administration Act, Section 15.

The application with attachments must be delivered in our electronic recruiting system Jobbnorge, please follow the link: “Apply for this job”. Foreign applicants are advised to attach an explanation of their University's grading system. Please note that all documents should be in English (or a Scandinavian language).

When evaluating the application, emphasis will be given to the applicant’s academic and personal prerequisites to carry out the project. Applicants may be called in for an interview.

When applying for the position, we ask you to retrieve your education results from Vitnemålsportalen.no. If your education results are not available through Vitnemålsportalen, we ask you to upload copies of your transcripts or grades. Please note that all documentation must be in English or a Scandinavian language.

General information

Please note that we are unable to add documentation after the application deadline. As the deadline applies equally to all applicants, this policy ensures equal treatment throughout the recruitment process. If you experience difficulties uploading documents in Jobbnorge, please contact their customer service: Phone: +47 75 54 22 20 or Email: support@grade.com The primary method of communication throughout the process will be e-mails and messages through the recruitment system Jobbnorge. When you receive a notification of a message in Jobbnorge, please log in to read it, as it may be important.The best qualified candidates will invited for interviews.

Applicant lists can be published in accordance with Norwegian Freedom of Information Act § 25. When you apply for a position with us, your name will appear on the public applicant list. It is possible to request to be excluded from this list. You must justify why you want an exemption from publication and we will then decide whether we can grant your request. If we cannot, you will hear from us.Please refer to  Regulations for the Act on universities and colleges chapter 3 (Norwegian) and Rules for the use of research posts SKO 1108, 1109, 1110 and 1183 at UiO.

The University of Oslo has a transfer agreement with all employees to secure the rights to all research results and related intellectual property.

Om arbeidsgiveren:

The University of Oslo is Norway’s oldest and highest ranked educational and research institution, with 26 500 students and 7 200 employees. With its broad range of academic disciplines and internationally recognised research communities, UiO is an important contributor to society.

The Institute of Basic Medical Sciences overall objective is to promote basic medical knowledge in order to understand normal processes, provide insight into mechanisms that cause illness, and promote good health. The Institute is responsible for teaching in basic medical sciences for the programmes of professional study in medicine and the Master's programme in clinical nutrition. The Institute has more than 300 employees and is located in Domus Medica.

jobs.title: Fortegaardens private plejecenter søger en fast aftenvagt.
jobs.description:
Er du uddannet social- og sundhedsassistent og funger du arbejdsmæssigt bedst om aftenen?

Vil du være med til at skabe en god hverdag, med hyggelige aftenstunder for vores beboere?

Kan du lide at sætte din faglighed i spil hver dag? Samt være en del af fællesskabet, hvor tværfaglig sparring er en del af hverdagen?

Så er du måske vores nye aftenvagt .

 

Plejecenter Fortegaarden er en selvejende institution, beliggende i Risskov, tæt ved letbanen og busforbindelser og med gratis parkering. Vi har i alt 50 lejligheder, der er fordelt på 5 bo-enheder med 10 boliger i hver, hvor du primært bliver tilknyttet en enkelt bo-enhed, og hvor der også er ansat både sygeplejerske, terapeuter, rengøringspersonale samt andet sosu-uddannet personale. Via det daglige, tværfaglige samarbejde og planlagte borgergennemgange er der derfor rig mulighed for sparring.

 

Som aftenvagt vil du blive en del af et aftenvagtsteam på i alt 8, der er fordelt på de 5 bo-enheder, hvoraf én i teamet er ansvarshavende social-og sundhedsassistent. Dine arbejdsdage vil som udgangspunkt være mandag og tirsdag samt med weekendvagt i ulige uger.

Vi gør opmærksom på, at stillingen ligger inden for det døgndækkede område, og vil fortrinsvis at være i aftenvagt, men der vil på en 12 ugers plan forekomme 2 vagter, der vil ligge i et andet vagtlag efter aftale.

 

Kandidatens profil:

·       Du er autoriseret social-og sundhedsassistent.

·       Du arbejder helhedsorienteret og personcentreret med udgangspunkt i borgernes mål og ressourcer og med rehabilitering for øje.

·       Du er spontan og kreativ i dit arbejde, og har hjertet på rette sted.

·       Du er engageret og brænder du for at gøre en forskel i ældre menneskers hverdag og liv.

·       Du udforsker muligheder, ser ikke begrænsninger i en travl hverdag?

·       Du har et godt overblik og kan håndtere en varieret arbejdsdag.

·       Du kan lide faglige udfordringer, men er samtidig bevidst om egne kompetencer.

·       Du har et anerkendende menneskesyn, og i dit arbejde er du altid den bedste udgave af dig og din faglighed.

·       Du er fleksibel og langtidsfrisk.

·       Du har forståelsen for vigtigheden af den rette dokumentation, så kendskab til og anvendelse af CURA eller anden elektronisk journalføring vil være en fordel

·       Du taler og skriver forståeligt dansk

 

Om Fortegaarden:

Vores kerneopgave er: ”Fortegaarden - et meningsfuldt og attraktivt senior fælleskabe”. Her trives fællesskab og god vilje, vi er klar til udfordringer og vi kan se os selv leve her som ældre.

Hos os er vi alle med til at bidrage til det gode arbejdsmiljø. Vi vil skabe gode relationer med hinanden, både kollegaer imellem, til vores beboere og deres pårørende. Vi passer på hinanden i hverdagen, griner sammen men kan også være alvorlige når det kræves, og tør snakke om det der er svært.

Du skal derfor vælge/gribe muligheden for at arbejde hos os, da vi:

 

·       Kan tilbyde dig et spændende og selvstændigt job, hvor tværfaglig sparring, vidensdeling og nysgerrighed er en naturlig del hverdagen.

·       Har mange forskellige kompetencer, som vi bruger aktivt i hverdag med borgerne.

·       Prioriterer ledelsesmæssig opbakning og nærvær

·       Kan lide vores målgruppe, vi kan lide hinanden, og vi kan lide de udfordringer, der er på et plejecenter, fordi vi står sammen og tager et fælles ansvar for det gode arbejdsmiljø.

 

 

Ved ansættelse på Plejecenter Fortegaarden, får du adgang til fitness/træningsfaciliteter samt tilbudt en sundhedsforsikring, tilbydes flere årlige, sociale arrangementer, er en del af frugt- og kaffe/the ordning samt får rabat i Caféen.

Ansættelse pr. 1/01 2027 eller hurtigst muligt. Vi afholder løbende samtaler og slår til, når den rette kandidat har præsenteret sig.

Løn efter overenskomst og en kommende løntilpasning efter kompetencer.

Vil du høre mere om stillingen og Fortegaarden, kan du kontakte daglig leder Tine de Place, tlf. 5154 0634 eller daglig leder Karin Fenger Ellekrog, tlf. 5114 0810

jobs.title: Assistant(e) administratif des ventes (H/F)
jobs.description: Assistant(e) / Administratif des ventesRésumé du poste :FVS Entertainment, basé près de l'aéroport Paris-CDG, est un fournisseur de contenus audiovisuels et de solutions techniques pour les compagnies aériennes (appelé Content Service Provider). Pour garantir la bonne lecture des contenus à bord (films, séries, musique, etc.), FVS alimente les systèmes embarqués via des fichiers Excel et plateformes spécifiques, propres à chaque compagnie et système. Chaque compagnie renouvelle sa programmation par cycle (mensuel, bimestriel, trimestriel), avec des volumes de contenus variables selon les périodes. Maîtrise avancée des outils bureautiques, notamment Excel.- Aisance informatique générale (manipulation de fichiers, logiciels variés).- Sens de l'organisation et rigueur dans le traitement des données.- Aisance relationnelle, esprit d'équipe, capacité à coordonner les parties prenantes internes et externes.- Autonomie, réactivité et capacité à gérer plusieurs projets en parallèle.- Une appétence pour le cinéma, les séries et/ou l'aviation est un vrai plus !Ce que nous offrons- Une ambiance bienveillante et familiale, au sein d'une PME à taille humaine avec un esprit startup.- L'Excel deviendra ton meilleur allié.- L'anglais sera ton outil quotidien pour communiquer avec nos partenaires à l'international.- Des missions où ta rigueur fera la différence.- Horaires : 9h00 - 12h30 / 13h30 - 17h00FVS s'engage en faveur de l'égalité des chances et de la diversité. jobs.title: Assistant Professor (tenure-track) in Finance / Biträdande professor (nivå 1) i finansiell ekonomi (tenure track)
jobs.description: [Se nedan för svenska]Hanken School of Economics invites applications for an Assistant Professor (tenure-track) in Financebeginning no later than August 2027, or as otherwise agreed. The position is at the Finance Unit at the Department of Finance and Economics in Helsinki. For this position, we will consider candidates in all fields of Finance.The position is part of the Hanken tenure track system. It is open to talented individuals who have potential for an excellent scientific career. Individuals placed on the Hanken tenure track have the possibility to advance in their career through regular performance assessments, which consider their merits in all relevant qualification areas in accordance with [Hankens tenure track guidelines](https://www.hanken.fi/en/faculty-staff/job-opportunities/job-opportunities/hankens-tenure-track-system).Hanken School of Economics is a research-oriented business school offering education in English and Swedish. Hankens Finance unit is committed to high-quality teaching and research. We offer full scale graduate and undergraduate programs.We have a strong research climate, reflected in a growing volume and range of research activities. We value high-quality, practice-oriented research, as evidenced by our publications in top-ranked journals. In addition, Hanken's Finance unit is an active partner in the Graduate School of Finance (GSF), which offers the national doctoral program in finance. GSF also organizes seminars and workshops for faculty members and doctoral students.RequirementsThe applicants will be reviewed based on their research, teaching, institutional service, and societal impact. Applicants should hold a doctoral degree (or be near completion of the doctorate) in Finance (or a related field). When evaluating the applicants qualifications, the main focus will be on the potential to conduct high-quality scientific research and the potential to provide high-quality teaching. A focus on asset pricing is considered a strong merit.Being a stand-alone business school with strong Nordic roots, Hanken offers degree programmes in Swedish and English. For this position, applicants are required to have fluent command of English, knowledge of Swedish is considered a merit. Hanken supports its faculty in learning the Swedish language, which serves as the administrative language of the business school.Academic staff at Hanken are expected to carry out and supervise scientific research, provide academic teaching, closely follow the advances of their field, and contribute service to Hanken, the academic community, and society. Teaching tasks are allocated based on the curriculum needs of the subject and by considering relevant expertise.The full-time position has an annual working time of 1612 hours. During the academic year, it is expected that a minimum average of three days per week is spent at the office in Helsinki to actively contribute to the research and teaching environment. Hanken requires academic employees to reside and work in Finland, and it offers relocation support for applicants coming from outside Finland.SalaryThe salary is based on the university salary system in Finland (includes employee healthcare as well as pension and holiday contributions). The exact salary level depends on the recruited individuals qualifications. Hanken will support the selected employee with a start-up research budget, and additional research, travel and teaching development grants can also be applied for. Hanken rewards excellence in both research and teaching.For more InformationFor additional information, please contact Head of Department Jesper Haga (jesper.haga@hanken.fi) or Head of Subject Karl Felixson (karl.felixson@hanken.fi).General instructions for applicants are provided [here](https://www.hanken.fi/en/faculty-staff/job-opportunities/job-opportunities/hankens-tenure-track-system/research-track-0). Also, read more about Hanken as an employer [here](https://www.hanken.fi/en/node/2413861).Recruitment process and timelineThe application deadline is 22 November 2026. Selected candidates will be interviewed online shortly after the application deadline. Short-listed candidates will be invited to on-site campus visits including an interview and research presentation.How to applyThe application is to be addressed to the Rector and application materials should include:- CV (proposed content [here](https://tenk.fi/en/advice-and-materials/template-researchers-curriculum-vitae)), including list of publications.- Personal statement, which includes a description of past research and its scientific quality, academic impact, plans for future research and a description of the candidates service to the department and university and a description of the candidates societal impact.- Teaching portfolio (proposed content [here](https://www.hanken.fi/en/faculty-staff/job-opportunities/job-opportunities/applications-and-selection-process)).- Copies of no more than five research publications, including a job market paper- Three letters of reference from academic researchers, to be submitted via [Econjobmarket](https://econjobmarket.org/positions?show=all&type=reg&searchType=quick&saved_search_id=0&cutoffDate=2007-01-01&position_type_id=&category_id=&iso2=&oid=1337#ad-11885) or directly to Hanken via humanresources@hanken.fi.Please submit all application materials in English in Hankens recruitment database LAURA. The application deadline is 22 November 2026.Hanken School of Economics is one of the leading business schools in the Nordic countries. It is located in Finland, with campuses in Helsinki and Vaasa. Hanken offers a range of B.Sc., M.Sc., EMBA, PhD, and Executive Development programmes taught mainly in English and Swedish. Hanken has 2 725 Bachelor and Masters students, and 118 Doctoral students. The School has close ties to the business community and an active alumni network with over 13 800 alumni working in more than 70 countries. The School is accredited by AACSB, AMBA, and EQUIS. The Masters programme was ranked 56 in the Masters in Management by Financial Times in 2026. Hanken is also recognized for its research quality, its international orientation, and its focus on sustainability.----------------Svenska handelshögskolan (Hanken) söker en biträdande professor (nivå 1) i

jobs.title: INTERNATIONAL JOURNALISTS & MEDIA PROJECT MANAGERS
jobs.description:
Factspilot.com – European Media Network

MinBy™ | Denmark

Journalism · Fact-checking · Artificial Intelligence · European Cooperation

WORK WITH US FROM YOUR OWN EU COUNTRY

Are you an experienced journalist, freelance journalist or media project manager living in an EU country outside Denmark?Do you have professional knowledge of your national media industry, established contacts and an interest in international journalism?

We would like to hear from you.MinBy™ is seeking experienced and independent media professionals to help establish and develop Factspilot.com, an international media and technology initiative.Our ambition is to build a European network of locally based journalists, media professionals and project coordinators working together across national borders.We are particularly interested in candidates who already understand their own country's media landscape and can contribute from the beginning.You will work from your own country. Relocation to Denmark is not required.

ABOUT FACTSPILOT.COMFactspilot.com is an international initiative developed by MinBy™, a Danish digital media network comprising 1,522 ultra-local media outlets across Denmark's 98 municipalities, alongside a portfolio of specialised digital magazine concepts.

Factspilot aims to develop a scalable European media infrastructure combining:

  • Independent journalism and news production.

  • Fact-checking, source verification and documentation.

  • Artificial intelligence and editorial technology.

  • Automated translation and multilingual publishing.

  • International news collection and distribution.

  • Cooperation between journalists and media organisations across Europe.

Our ambition is to connect national and local journalistic expertise with a shared international platform.

WHO ARE WE LOOKING FOR?

We are recruiting candidates with experience in one or more of the following areas.

1. FREELANCE JOURNALISTS / MEDIA PARTNERS

We are looking for experienced freelance journalists interested in contributing to Factspilot's development in their own countries.

Your potential responsibilities include:

  • Researching and producing journalistic content.

  • Identifying reliable national and regional news sources.

  • Conducting fact-checking and source verification.

  • Establishing relationships with local journalists, editors and newsrooms.

  • Contributing to cross-border journalism and multilingual publishing.

  • Helping develop Factspilot's national media network.

You may already be working independently, seeking new assignments or interested in becoming part of a larger international media initiative.

You do not need to own a company to apply.

2. JOURNALISTS / EDITORS / MEDIA PROFESSIONALS

We are seeking journalists and media professionals with practical experience and strong knowledge of their national media environment.

Relevant backgrounds include:

  • Journalism and editorial production.

  • Investigative journalism and research.

  • Fact-checking and verification.

  • Digital publishing and news distribution.

  • Editorial coordination and media development.

We particularly value candidates who understand their country's media structures, professional standards and relevant sources.

3. MEDIA PROJECT MANAGERS / NATIONAL COORDINATORS

We are also seeking experienced project managers who can contribute to establishing and coordinating Factspilot's activities in their own countries.

Your potential responsibilities include:

  • Identifying relevant journalists and media contacts.

  • Building national professional networks.

  • Developing international cooperation opportunities.

  • Coordinating local project activities.

  • Contributing to project planning, budgets and implementation.

  • Supporting European partnerships and potential funding applications.

Experience with international media projects, European cooperation or EU funding programmes is an advantage.

YOUR LOCAL EXPERIENCE IS OUR PRIORITY

We are particularly interested in applicants who:

  • Live in an EU Member State outside Denmark.

  • Have professional experience in journalism, media or project management.

  • Understand their national media industry.

  • Have relevant professional contacts and relationships.

  • Speak and write the language of their country fluently.

  • Can communicate professionally in English.

  • Work independently and take responsibility for results.

  • Are comfortable using modern digital tools and AI-supported workflows.

  • Are interested in international cooperation and long-term project development.

An established professional network and practical experience may be more important than formal qualifications.

EUROPEAN PROJECT DEVELOPMENT

Factspilot is exploring opportunities for international project financing, including the European Union's Creative Europe – Journalism Partnerships programme.

Selected candidates may contribute to the development of European cooperation projects, including the identification of national partners, editorial activities and project coordination.

Experience with EU programmes or international project funding is particularly relevant for project management candidates, but is not required for journalists.

WHAT WE OFFER

We offer the opportunity to participate in the development of an ambitious international media initiative from an early stage.

Depending on your professional background and the project's development, opportunities may include:

  • Journalism and editorial assignments.

  • Fact-checking and research activities.

  • National media coordination.

  • International project development.

  • Participation in European media cooperation.

  • Longer-term professional collaboration.

You will have the opportunity to contribute your existing expertise while working from your own country.

WORK LOCATION AND EMPLOYMENT CONDITIONS

Location: Your country of residence within the European Union, excluding Denmark.Work arrangement: Remote, with activities carried out locally in your own country.Professional profiles: Journalists, freelance journalists, editors, media professionals and project managers.Employment and cooperation: Depending on the role, opportunities may include employment or paid freelance and project-based assignments.

Working hours, responsibilities, remuneration and contractual terms will be agreed individually before any engagement begins.

Factspilot is currently in a development phase. The availability and commencement of specific assignments depend on project progress and financing.

Applicants may be unemployed, employed or self-employed. A registered company is not required.

APPLICATION AND SELECTION

We are interested in your professional experience, local knowledge, independence and ability to contribute to Factspilot's development.

Please include the following information in your application:

  1. Country of residence – Where do you currently live and work?

  2. Professional profile – Journalist, freelance journalist, media professional or project manager?

  3. Experience – What is your relevant professional background?

  4. Local knowledge – What experience and contacts do you have within your country's media industry?

  5. Contribution – How could you help develop Factspilot in your country?

  6. International experience – Have you previously worked on international or EU-funded projects?

Please include your CV and, where relevant, links to published work, previous projects or professional references.

Selected applicants may be invited to complete a voluntary practical assignment designed to demonstrate relevant skills, independent thinking and professional initiative.

HOW TO APPLY

Applications must be submitted through MinBy™'s digital recruitment system.

Apply here:

https://minbymedie.dk/ansogning-formular/

We welcome applications from qualified candidates throughout the 26 EU Member States outside Denmark.

FACTSPILOT.COM

Local Knowledge. European Cooperation. International Reach.

An international media initiative developed by MinBy™ – Denmark.

Factspilot: https://factspilot.com

MinBy™: https://minbymedie.dk

jobs.title: WE ARE HIRING – CLEANING SUPERVISOR
jobs.description:
WE ARE HIRING – CLEANING SUPERVISOR

Join the REMA GROUP Team!

Location: Copenhagen & Greater Copenhagen

Are you our new Cleaning Supervisor?

At REMA GROUP, we believe that professional cleaning is about much more than just clean surroundings. It's about people, responsibility, trust, and delivering quality that our clients can rely on every single day.

We take pride in our work, our employees, and the long-term relationships we build with our clients.

As we continue to develop our business, we are looking for an experienced, dedicated, and hands-on Cleaning Supervisor who shares our values and wants to become an important part of the REMA GROUP team.

We are looking for someone who doesn't just supervise cleaning operations, but takes ownership, leads by example, and understands that excellent service starts with motivated employees and attention to detail.

Does that sound like you? Then we would love to hear from you!

YOUR ROLE AT REMA GROUP

As our new Cleaning Supervisor, you will have an important role in ensuring that our daily cleaning operations run smoothly and that our clients consistently receive the high standards they expect from REMA GROUP.

You will be the link between our cleaning teams, our clients, and our management.

Your role will involve both practical supervision and daily coordination, and we expect you to be visible, approachable, and actively involved in maintaining our quality standards.

Your main responsibilities will include:

  • Planning, coordinating, and supervising daily cleaning operations across our client locations.

  • Leading, motivating, and supporting our cleaning employees.

  • Training and guiding employees in professional cleaning methods, hygiene, and safe working procedures.

  • Performing regular quality inspections and ensuring that our cleaning standards are consistently maintained.

  • Following up on quality issues and making sure improvements are implemented.

  • Ensuring that cleaning products, equipment, and materials are used correctly and responsibly.

  • Maintaining relevant documentation, quality reports, and operational follow-up.

  • Building positive relationships with clients and ensuring professional communication.

  • Supporting efficient daily operations while maintaining our commitment to quality, service, and sustainability.

WHO ARE WE LOOKING FOR?

At REMA GROUP, we value attitude, responsibility, and professional pride.

We are looking for a supervisor who enjoys working with people, knows how to create structure in a busy working day, and understands the importance of being both a strong team leader and a reliable representative of our company.

We expect you to:

  • Have solid experience within professional or commercial cleaning.

  • Have previous experience as a Cleaning Supervisor, Team Leader, or in a similar position.

  • Be confident in planning, organizing, and supervising cleaning operations.

  • Have a natural ability to motivate, train, and support employees.

  • Be quality-conscious and have a strong eye for detail.

  • Be independent, reliable, flexible, and solution-oriented.

  • Have a positive attitude and take responsibility for your work.

  • Be comfortable communicating with both employees and clients.

  • Be able to communicate professionally in English.

  • Be willing to work flexible hours when required.

Most importantly, we are looking for someone who takes pride in doing things properly and who wants to make a positive difference every day.

WHY JOIN REMA GROUP?

We want our employees to feel that they are part of something meaningful.

At REMA GROUP, we work with a strong focus on quality, responsibility, sustainability, and long-term partnerships.

Our ambition is to deliver professional cleaning solutions while reducing our environmental footprint through responsible product choices, efficient cleaning methods, and environmentally conscious working practices.

We believe that good results come from good people, clear communication, and mutual respect.

What we offer:

  • A full-time position in a professional and growing cleaning company.

  • An important role with real responsibility and influence on daily operations.

  • A varied working day across different client locations in Greater Copenhagen.

  • A supportive working environment where teamwork and mutual respect matter.

  • Opportunities to develop your professional and leadership skills.

  • Long-term career opportunities within REMA GROUP.

  • Salary based on qualifications and experience.

POSITION DETAILS

Position: Cleaning Supervisor – Full-time

Location: Copenhagen & Greater Copenhagen

Working hours: Flexible according to operational requirements. Occasional early morning, evening, night, and weekend work may be required.

Start date: As soon as possible or by agreement.

Salary: Based on qualifications and experience.

READY TO BECOME PART OF REMA GROUP?

Are you ready to take the next step in your career and become part of a company where quality, responsibility, and people come first?

Then we would be happy to receive your application.

Please send your CV and a short personal application to:

info@remagroup.dk

Email subject: Cleaning Supervisor – Copenhagen

We review applications and invite candidates for interviews on an ongoing basis.

We look forward to welcoming the right person to the REMA GROUP team!

REMA GROUP

Green Heart. Green Footprints. Professional Cleaning.

IMPORTANT – APPLICATIONS BY EMAIL ONLY

Please note that we only accept written applications sent by email.

We kindly ask applicants not to contact us by phone regarding this position.

jobs.title: US Remote Patient Care Advocate (Customer Service)
jobs.description:
Job Title: Patient Care Advocate 

Job Location: Remote


About Us: 

We are a dedicated team focused on improving access to affordable prescription medications for patients. By partnering with insurance companies, healthcare providers, and pharmacies, we work to reduce the financial burden of medications, ensuring that patients can access the treatments they need without excessive costs. 


Role Overview: 

As a key member of our team, you will help patients navigate our Prescription Payment Plan. This involves working closely with patients, insurance providers, healthcare professionals, and pharmacies to ensure seamless enrollment, eligibility verification, cost-sharing, and prescription fulfillment. 


What You’ll Do: 

  • Patient Enrollment & Eligibility: Assist patients with enrolling in the program, ensuring all necessary personal and insurance information is provided and verifying eligibility. 
  • Prescription Coverage: Help patients confirm that their prescribed medications are covered under the program, and manage the approval process for eligible medications. 
  • Cost-Sharing & Payment: Reduce patients' out-of-pocket costs by applying the program benefits. Manage copayments, coinsurance, and assist with additional copay assistance when applicable. 
  • Prescription Fulfillment: Coordinate with participating pharmacies to ensure the correct application of benefits during prescription filling, ensuring patients pay the reduced amount. 
  • Refills & Continued Use: Support patients by ensuring they continue receiving medications at reduced costs, monitoring adherence to medication regimens, and ensuring continued eligibility. 
  • Program Renewal & Updates: Guide patients through annual renewals and inform them about any updates to the program or medication formulary. 


What We’re Looking For: 

  • High school diploma or GED required
  • Experience in healthcare, insurance or customer service required (experience with prescription assistance programs is a plus)
  • Strong attention to detail and ability to navigate complex processes
  • Excellent communication skills for working with patients, healthcare providers, and pharmacies
  • A genuine passion for helping others and making a positive impact on their healthcare access
  • The ability to work efficiently and collaboratively within a team environment

Success Factors for Working from Home 

  • Private Workspace: A dedicated, quiet workspace with a door that closes, free from ambient noise. 
  • Ergonomics: A comfortable desk and chair setup that allows for the proper installation of necessary equipment. 
  • Reliable Internet Connection: Stable, high-speed internet with a minimum bandwidth of 10 Mbps downstream and 5 Mbps upstream. 
  • Quiet, Distraction-Free Workspace: A dedicated, quiet area where you can focus on delivering excellent customer service without interruptions. 
  • Tech-Savvy: Comfort with technology and ability to learn new systems quickly. 
  • Self-motivation & Independence: Ability to stay productive and manage your time effectively in a remote environment. 
  • Communication Skills: Strong verbal and written communication skills, especially in a virtual setting. 
  • Adaptability: Ability to adapt to changing technologies and procedures while working remotely. 


Compensation & Perks 

  • Hourly Pay: $16.50 per hour 
  • Company-Provided Equipment: All necessary equipment will be provided. 
  • Comprehensive Benefits: Full health insurance package including medical, dental, and vision coverage. 
  • Cell Phone Benefits: $25/month per line for unlimited phone, text, and data (restrictions may apply). 
  • Generous Referral Program: Earn $50 per paycheck for every person you refer—and your referral earns it too! No limits on payouts. 
  • Comprehensive Training: Paid training to ensure you are fully prepared for success. 
  • Career Growth: Opportunities for career advancement and professional development within a leading healthcare provider. 
  • Work-from-Home Convenience: Save time, and money, and reduce your environmental footprint. 
  • Inclusive Culture: We are an Equal Opportunity Employer, including individuals with disabilities and veterans. 

What Success Looks Like: 

  • Reduced out-of-pocket costs for patients through effective cost-sharing and copay assistance 
  • Timely and accurate processing of prescription claims and approvals 
  • High patient satisfaction with the program’s support and streamlined experience 
  • Compliance with program requirements and monitoring of patient eligibility for ongoing assistance 

Why Join Us? 

  • Be part of a team that makes a real difference in patients' lives by reducing the cost of necessary medications 
  • Opportunity for professional growth in the healthcare and insurance sectors 
  • Competitive compensation and benefits package 
  • A collaborative, supportive, and innovative work culture 

Ready to Make an Impact? 

Join us in making prescription medications more affordable and accessible for those who need them most. If you're ready to help make a difference, we'd love to hear from you! 

If you like wild growth and working with happy, enthusiastic over-achievers, you'll enjoy your career with us!

jobs.title: To konsulenter til politisk og ledelsesmæssig betjening samt til understøttelse af reformimplementering
jobs.description:
Trives du med en hverdag, hvor opgaverne er komplekse, varierede og tempoet er højt? Har du en skarp pen, et godt overblik og flair for politik og offentlig forvaltning? Og har du en god portion holdånd, en positiv grundindstilling og kan du arbejde selvstændigt? Så er du én af de to nye kollegaer, vi søger, til afdelingen Forebyggelse og Tværgående Koordinering i Center for Sundhed og Omsorg. 

Konkret søger vi to konsulenter, som skal indgå i teamet omkring centerledelsen og primært have opgaver indenfor politisk og ledelsesmæssig betjening på ældre- og sundhedsområderne samt opgaver i relation til understøttelse af reformimplementering.

Både sundheds- og omsorgsområdet undergår en rivende udvikling i disse år. Med både en national sundhedsreform og en ældrereform står centeret i en spændende tid, hvor sundheds- og omsorgsområderne skal fremtidssikres, mens der holdes fast i det allervigtigste: Tryghed for borgerne, en høj faglighed og et godt arbejdsmiljø for medarbejderne.

Den ene af de to stillinger, vi søger besat, vil primært løfte opgaver indenfor ældreområdet, som foruden politiske sager og ledelsesbetjening vil indebære opgaver indenfor administrativ understøttelse af en koordineret implementering af ældrereformens tiltag om bl.a. helhedspleje, mere selvbestemmelse, et tættere samspil med civilsamfundet samt generel forebyggelse på ældreområdet. 

Den anden af de to stillinger vil primært omhandle politisk og ledelsesmæssig betjening indenfor sundhedsområdet, herunder i forhold til implementering af sundhedsreformen, det tværsektorielle samarbejde med regionen, udarbejdelsen af en kommende nærsundhedsplan, samt ny folkesundhedslov og generelle kommunale sundhedsopgaver.

Om dig

Det er en væsentlig fordel, hvis du har kendskab til sundheds- og/eller ældreområdet, da det vil give dig et godt afsæt for at forstå og navigere i områdets opgaver, rammer og kompleksitet.

Du har en uddannelsesmæssig og/eller erhvervsmæssig erfaring og kompetencer i forhold til at varetage politisk og administrativ understøttelse.

Din uddannelsesmæssige baggrund eller din erhvervserfaring gør, at du besidder evnen til at gå analytisk til en opgave, sætte dig ind i et større skriftligt materiale, og arbejde selvstændigt med en skriftlig opgave. Tidligere erfaring med betjening af politiske udvalg eller andre lignende beslutningsorganer er ikke et krav men en fordel.  

Hvem du er som person er mindst lige så vigtigt for os som din baggrund og erfaring. Du er udadvendt og formår at bevare overblikket i en travl hverdag – og du trives med at arbejde indenfor til tider korte frister.

Du trives med at veksle mellem de større, komplekse opgaver og de mindre, løbende opgaver i det daglige, såsom at sikre gode Power Point-slides eller dagsordner til interne møder i administrationen.

Endelig har du flair for at arbejde med brug af data og har en grundlæggende forståelse for økonomi.

Hvem er Forebyggelse og Tværgående Koordinering?

Forebyggelse og Tværgående Koordinering udgøres af cirka 35 fagkonsulenter. Medarbejderne arbejder selvstændigt med opgaver indenfor sundhedsfremme og forebyggelse for borgere i alle aldre, udvikling af ældreplejen, herunder ift. frit valg for borgerne, forebyggende hjemmebesøg, demens, hygiejne og kvalitet, uddannelse af elever og studerende, ensomhed, velfærdsteknologi og IT-administration, tilsyn, tværsektorielt samarbejde mm.

Medarbejdere har forskellige faglige baggrunde, men fælles for alle er, at vi samarbejder på tværs af forskellige fagområder og på tværs af sektorer. jobs.title: Experienced Welder / Tack Welder for Weekend Day Shift
jobs.description:
Do you have solid experience in welding and tack welding, and do you thrive in a structured environment with clear expectations and a strong focus on quality and precision? At Give Steel A/S, you will become an important part of our weekend day shift production team, where your contribution helps ensure strong, documented steel structures.

Why Choose Us?

You will become part of a manufacturing engineering and steel construction company with a strong focus on quality, safety, and responsible production. We are committed to employee development and offer a workplace with freedom under responsibility, well-organised working conditions, and opportunities for professional growth.

You will be employed under the Danish Collective Agreement for the Industry Sector (Industriens Overenskomst). In addition, we offer private health insurance and the option to join our canteen scheme.

What Will Your Workday Look Like?

You will join a team manufacturing load-bearing steel structures and steel trusses. The work is carried out on the weekend day shift, where you will follow established work procedures and contribute to ensuring tasks are completed safely, efficiently, and to a high standard of quality.

Your working hours will be from 6:00 AM to 6:00 PM.

Your responsibilities will include:

  • Tack welding and welding steel structures based on technical drawings and work instructions
  • Preparing components and checking measurements, fit, and quality
  • Carrying out tasks with a systematic and thorough approach
  • Contributing to strong teamwork with colleagues in production
  • Complying with all applicable safety, quality, and documentation requirements

What Are We Looking For?

We are looking for an experienced and reliable employee who works in a structured and detail-oriented manner. You thrive in a well-defined environment, can maintain an overview in a busy production setting, and take pride in delivering lasting, high-quality results.

We expect that you:

  • Have solid experience as a welder and/or tack welder
  • Work thoroughly, responsibly, and with a strong focus on quality
  • Can read and understand technical drawings
  • Are reliable and a team player
  • Contribute positively to a professional and safe working environment
  • Speak Danish and/or English
  • Live in Denmark within a reasonable commuting distance of Brande

We can provide certification in various welding methods, so it is not important whether you already hold welding certificates.

Interested?

If you have any questions about the position, please contact our Head of Production, Tomas Slepavicius, at tsl@givesteel.com.

We would like to receive your CV, clearly outlining your relevant experience. We are looking for someone who can start as soon as possible, and we will remove the job advertisement once the position has been filled.

About Give Steel A/S

Give Steel A/S is a manufacturing engineering and steel construction company that develops, designs, manufactures, and erects load-bearing steel structures and steel trusses. Quality, safety, and documentation are an integral part of our daily operations, while we also maintain a strong focus on CO₂ reduction and responsible production.

You will become part of an international company with strong technical expertise and opportunities for professional development. Collaboration, responsibility, and integrity are key values in our daily work.

jobs.title: Vil du være den reparatør, der gør en synlig forskel i produktionen?
jobs.description:
Hos Rul-let handler vedligehold ikke kun om at holde maskinerne i gang – men om at finde de løsninger, der gør hverdagen lettere, driften stærkere og produktionen endnu bedre. Hvis du trives med ansvar, teknik og frihed til at tænke selv, er det måske dig, vi leder efter.

Hos Rul-let producerer vi emballage til fødevarer, som bruges i både supermarkeder og industrikøkkener verden over. Vi er i gang med at opgradere vores tekniske setup og søger én ny kollega til vedligeholdelsesteamet med interesse for el, automatik, mekanik og maskinoptimering.

Uanset om du er mest til strøm eller stål, er det vigtigste, at du brænder for teknik, tager ansvar og har lyst til at se dine idéer blive til virkelighed. Du bliver en del af et lille team, hvor vi har ansvar for hver vores linjer, men aldrig står alene. Vi hjælper hinanden, deler erfaringer og lytter til gode forslag – også når de kommer fra værkstedsgulvet.

Dine opgaver

  • Vedligeholde og fejlfinde på mekanisk, elektrisk og pneumatisk udstyr

  • Skifte mellem produkter og materialer i produktionen

  • Bygge og optimere maskindele – gerne med dine egne løsninger

  • Bidrage med input, når vi investerer i nye maskiner og smartere løsninger

Du arbejder primært på daghold ca. 7.00 – 15.00, men du kan forvente aften- og weekendvagt ca. hver 4. uge, hvor weekendvagter er som tilkald. Til gengæld hjælper vi hinanden med bytning af vagter og fridage, så hverdagen også kan hænge sammen uden for arbejdet.

Hvem er du?Du har hænderne skruet rigtigt på og trives med ansvar. Du er nysgerrig, løsningsorienteret og går op i, at tingene virker – både i dag og i morgen. Måske har du en baggrund som automatiktekniker, elektriker, industritekniker, smed eller lignende, men vigtigst er, at du:

  • Har erfaring med automatiserede anlæg og teknisk vedligehold

  • Kan arbejde selvstændigt og samtidig være en god kollega

  • Taler dansk og forstår engelsk

  • Har lyst til at gøre en forskel – hver dag

Det tilbyder vi

  • En hverdag med variation, ansvar og tekniske udfordringer

  • Gode kolleger, en uformel tone og et team, hvor vi hjælper hinanden

  • Frihed til at tænke nyt – og mulighed for at blive hørt, når du har en god idé

  • Et stærkt team og en chef, der selv har hænderne i maskinerne

  • Kantineordning og gratis adgang til fitnesscenter

  • Mulighed for fleksibel planlægning af ferie og fridage, når driften tillader det

Er du klar til at blive en del af holdet?Så send din ansøgning og CV snarest. Vi holder samtaler løbende og ansætter, når vi har fundet den rette.

Har du spørgsmål til jobbet, er du velkommen til at kontakte vedligeholdelseschef Preben Hansen på 5158 1749.

Vi glæder os til at byde dig velkommen.

jobs.title: Reparatør til teknisk afdeling i ABENA Produktion
jobs.description:
Vil du arbejde med fejlfinding, reparation og vedligehold på højteknologiske produktionsanlæg i en hverdag med faste rammer, dygtige kolleger og stor variation? Så er det måske dig, vi leder efter.

Du bliver en del af vores tekniske afdeling, hvor reparatører, elektrikere, teknikere og lærlinge arbejder tæt sammen om at holde produktionen kørende. Hos os møder du engagerede kolleger, høj faglighed og et stærkt fællesskab, hvor vi hjælper hinanden og tager ansvar for både opgaverne og hinanden.

Hos ABENA producerer vi hver dag over 3 millioner højkvalitets-bleer til både babyer og voksne. Produktionen foregår på avancerede maskinanlæg, der kræver teknisk forståelse, præcision og godt samarbejde på tværs af produktion og teknisk afdeling.

Om jobbet

Din hverdag bliver alsidig og teknisk udfordrende. Du får en vigtig rolle i at sikre stabil drift på vores produktionsanlæg, og du arbejder tæt sammen med både kollegerne i teknisk afdeling og medarbejderne i produktionen.

Dine opgaver vil blandt andet være at:

  • fejlsøge, reparere og vedligeholde maskinanlæg

  • udføre forebyggende vedligehold

  • ombygge og tilpasse maskinanlæg

  • koordinere opgaver ved vedligeholdsstop

  • arbejde i vores IT-baserede vedligeholdssystem

  • deltage i omstillinger og klargøring

Vi er i udvikling og investerer løbende i nye maskiner og ny teknologi. Derfor får du gode muligheder for at udvikle dig fagligt og bringe din viden i spil i en moderne produktion.

Jobbet er primært på daghold. Derudover skal du være indstillet på at arbejde på aftenhold i gennemsnit ca. hver 6. eller 7. uge og have tilkaldevagt ca. hver 12. weekend. Der kan også forekomme perioder, hvor der er brug for din hjælp på natskiftet. 

Vi har stærkt fokus på sikkerhed. Hos os kommer sikkerhed altid først, både i måden vi arbejder på i produktionen, og i den måde vi passer på hinanden i hverdagen. Vi forventer, at du bidrager aktivt til et sikkert arbejdsmiljø.

Dine kvalifikationer

Vi leder efter dig, der er fagligt stærk og trives med at være en del af et team, hvor vi løfter i flok.

Vi forestiller os, at du:

  • har en relevant baggrund som fx smed, landbrugsmekaniker, automekaniker, automatikmekaniker eller lignende

  • har erfaring med vedligehold

  • har kendskab til MAG/TIG svejsning, drejebænk, tegningslæsning, lejemontage, systematisk fejlfinding og pneumatikstyring

  • arbejder selvstændigt og struktureret

  • tager ansvar og hjælper dine kolleger

  • taler og skriver dansk

Hvorfor vælge ABENA?

Hos ABENA Produktion får du et spændende og afvekslende job i en virksomhed, hvor vi prioriterer både faglighed og mennesker. Du bliver en del af en afdeling med godt arbejdsklima, engagerede kolleger og gode muligheder for faglig og personlig udvikling.

Vi lægger vægt på:

  • et stærkt fællesskab med samarbejde og godt humør

  • en moderne produktion med avancerede maskinanlæg

  • gode muligheder for udvikling og efteruddannelse

  • kantineordning, motionsrum og sundhedsordning

  • en arbejdsplads med tillid, retfærdighed og samarbejde

Hos ABENA skal det være trygt, rart og motiverende at gå på arbejde. Vi tror på ordentlighed, godt samarbejde og høj faglighed, og vi sætter en ære i at passe godt på hinanden, vores kunder og vores leverandører.

Er du vores nye kollega?

Send din ansøgning og CV snarest gennem vores ansøgningssystem. Vi behandler ansøgningerne efterhånden, som vi modtager dem, indtil vi har fundet den rette kandidat.

Såfremt der er spørgsmål til stillingen, kan du kontakte vedligeholdelsesleder Bo Amdi Holm på tlf.: 51580560.

Vi glæder os til at høre fra dig!

jobs.title: Rengøringsoperatør - fast aftenhold
jobs.description:
Er du interesseret i at blive en del af en moderne og førende maskinfabrik i vækst?Lige nu søger vi flere rengøringsoperatører til vores faste aftenhold, som vil være med til at sikre rene, ryddelige og sikre rammer på tværs af virksomheden.

Om teamet

Du bliver en del af vores Operations Support-team, som understøtter den daglige drift på tværs af virksomheden. Som rengøringsoperatør samarbejder du med kolleger fra flere afdelinger og bidrager til, at produktionsområder, fællesarealer og faciliteter fremstår rene, ryddelige og sikre.

Om jobbet

Din primære arbejdsfunktion er daglig rengøring af virksomhedens produktions- og industrilokaliteter. Som rengøringsoperatør får du en vigtig rolle i at sikre en høj rengøringsstandard på tværs af vores produktions- og fællesområder. Arbejdet udføres på fast aftenhold, hvor du i høj grad kan planlægge og gennemføre opgaverne uden at forstyrre den daglige produktion.

Dine opgaver vil variere, men vil blandt andet omfatte:

  • Daglig rengøring af produktionsområder, værksteder, fællesarealer og øvrige faciliteter.

  • Rengøring af gulve, overflader, inventar og sanitære områder.

  • Håndtering af affald og opfyldning af rengørings- og forbrugsartikler.

  • Betjening, rengøring og dagligt tilsyn med rengøringsudstyr og -maskiner.

  • Deltagelse i 5S-arbejde og praktiske ad hoc-opgaver med relation til rengøring, orden og affaldshåndtering.

  • Arbejdet er praktisk og fysisk, og udføres både manuelt og ved hjælp af rengøringsmaskiner.

Om dig

Vi forestiller os, at du:

  • Arbejder grundigt, systematisk og med blik for detaljen.

  • Er ansvarsbevidst, stabil og har en høj arbejdsmoral.

  • Kan arbejde selvstændigt og selv tage initiativ til at løse opgaver.

  • Er en hjælpsom kollega og samarbejder godt med andre.

  • Har fokus på kvalitet, hygiejne og sikkerhed.

  • Kan følge rengøringsplaner, instruktioner og gældende sikkerhedsprocedurer.

  • Trives med fysisk arbejde og med at arbejde på aftenhold.

Faglige kvalifikationer

Det vigtigste er, at du har lyst til at levere rengøring af høj kvalitet og er klar til at lære vores områder, udstyr og arbejdsgange at kende. Derudover er det en fordel, hvis du har:

  • Erfaring med erhvervsrengøring, gerne fra en produktionsvirksomhed.

  • Kendskab til rengøringsmidler, dosering og sikker håndtering.

  • Erfaring med rengøringsmaskiner eller lyst til at lære at bruge dem.

  • Evne til at kommunikere på dansk eller engelsk og følge skriftlige instruktioner.

 Vi tilbyder

  • Et fast job på aftenhold i en veletableret produktionsvirksomhed.

  • Grundig oplæring i vores rengøringsrutiner, udstyr og sikkerhedsprocedurer.

Vi tilbyder

Du bliver en del af en veletableret, dansk, familieejet eksportvirksomhed, hvor relationerne vægtes højt. Aasted er i 2026 blevet en del af Piovan Group, hvilket giver nye perspektiver og muligheder som en del af en større international koncern.

Kulturen i Aasted er kendetegnet ved, at vi alle er motiverede og stolte af det, vi laver, hvilket skaber et stærkt sammenhold og engagement. Vi har en åben, ærlig og direkte tone og gør en dyd ud af at opføre os ordentligt i alt, hvad vi foretager os.

Vi arbejder kontinuerligt mod at være en inkluderende arbejdsplads med lige udviklingsmuligheder for alle vores medarbejdere. Vi tilbyder en attraktiv barselsordning, sociale arrangementer og en sund kantine ved Meyers Kantine.

Hos Aasted prioriterer vi et sund arbejdsmiljø og er derfor en røgfri arbejdsplads, hvilket betyder, at der ikke må ryges i arbejdstiden og på virksomhedens område.

 

Vi ser frem til at høre fra dig

Hvis du har spørgsmål eller blot vil høre mere om stillingen, er du velkommen til at række ud til HR@aasted.eu.

Aasted ønsker at skabe en arbejdsplads med plads til alle.  Vi opfordrer derfor alle uanset køn og etnicitet, samt seksuel, politisk og kulturel orientering orientering til at søge job hos os.  

Du kan læse mere om os og vores arbejde her:  AASTED | Welcome to our world  

 

Aasted – en dansk pioner

Aasted har i mere end 100 år været markedsleder inden for udstyr og anlæg til chokoladeproduktion i hele verden. I porteføljen af kunder er både mindre, lokale virksomheder og flere af verdens største globale FMCG-spillere.

Vi er på en konstant rejse motiveret af en nysgerrighed, der har gjort os i stand til at retænke, hvad der hidtil har været kendt inden for chokoladeproduktion. Vi sætter spørgsmålstegn ved det umulige – og gør det muligt. Vi lancerer konstant en lang række banebrydende og patenterede løsninger til vores kunder og bidrager tik, at hver enkelt opnår deres unikke vision.

I Aasted er vi mere end 550 mennesker, der gennem passion, erfaring og ekspertise nytænker status quo.

We're seeking talented individuals to help us shape the maritime future. If you're ready to be part of this exciting journey, your adventure begins here!

The Global HSE Manager – Operational Safety is responsible for developing, maintaining and improving KM’s global approach to operational safety, with emphasis on preventing serious injuries and fatalities, strengthening operational risk management and ensuring effective implementation of operational control requirements across divisions, business units and sites.

The position supports the Global Director HSE in strengthening KM’s operational safety performance, ensuring consistent expectations for high-risk activities, incidents, investigations, learning and corrective actions, and enabling the organisation to manage operational safety risks through clear requirements, practical guidance and effective follow-up.

What you will be doing• Risk Management: Own the HSE Risk Management process, maintain the Global HSE Risk Register, and facilitate risk reviews and assurance activities.• Operational Control: Own the operational control process and coordinate the development, implementation and continuous improvement of global HSE operational controls.• Learning and Improvement: Own the global lessons learned and HSE Subject Matter Expert frameworks and facilitate HSE forums and meetings to strengthen knowledge sharing and continuous improvement.• Safety Culture: Drive Human and Organisational Performance (HOP) initiatives to strengthen KM’s safety culture.• Systems and Tools: Act as system owner, where assigned, for HSE tools and applications, including governance, development, supplier management, budgets and improvement roadmaps.• HSE Assurance and Support: Conduct audits and inspections, lead or support incident investigations, provide subject matter expertise, and deliver HSE training, advice and professional support.

We think you should have• Bachelor’s or master’s degree in a relevant field, or equivalent relevant experience.• Solid experience with HSE risk management, operational controls and high-risk work activities.• Experience with incident reporting, serious incident investigations, corrective actions and sharing of lessons learned• Good knowledge of ISO 45001 and practical application of HSE management system requirements. Knowledge of ISO 14001 is an advantage• Good business understanding and ability to translate operational safety requirements into practical and effective ways of working• Experience from an operational HSE role is an advantage

This employment may require a pre-employment check procedure in accordance with company security standards, role or site requirements. Please note that this might affect the offer process or employment.

Kongsberg Maritime’s strength lies in unity. Diverse minds, developing technologies for sustainable oceans, drive innovation worldwide

jobs.description: _Asiakkaamme on suomalainen Turussa sijaitseva teollisuuden kunnossapidon vahva ammattilainen ja yritys on perustettu vuonna 1995. Yritys tarjoaa asiakkailleen muun muassa tuotantokoneiden- ja laitteiden asennukset, korjaukset sekä huollot. Yritys tarjoaa myös kiinteistöjen LVIS-palveluita._Nyt heidän riveissään on paikka automaatioasentajalle. Työnkuva koostuu teollisuuden sähköautomaatiolaitteiden asennus-, kytkentä- ja huoltotöistä. Työ on osaltaan liikkuvaa, joten valittavan henkilön tulee olla valmis liikkumaan myös eri asiakkaiden toimipisteisiin. Tulevan sähköautomaatioasentajan tulee olla oma-aloitteinen, itseohjautuva sekä motivoitunut ja aidosti kiinnostunut alasta. Työntekijältä vaaditaan voimassa olevia tulityö-, työturvallisuus- ja EA-kortteja.Työt alkavat mahdollisimman pian heti sopivan henkilön löydyttyä. Työtä tehdään arkisin päivävuorossa, työaikojen kuitenkin ollessa työskentelykohteista riippuen joustavia. Työkielenä käytetään suomea, joten suomen kielen taito on ehdoton.

jobs.title: PhD Candidate - Hydrogen and Industrial Decarbonization Pathways
jobs.description:
This is NTNU

NTNU is a broad-based university with a technical-scientific profile and a focus in professional education. The university is located in three cities with headquarters in Trondheim.

At NTNU, 8,6000 employees and 44,000 students work to create knowledge for a better world.

You will find more information about working at NTNU and the application process here.   

Video: https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=_KHQjc4ndas&t=41sAbout the position

We invite applications for a 3-year PhD Candidate position on the future role of hydrogen and hydrogen products in industrial decarbonization. The position is based at the Department of Industrial Economics and Technology Management, located at NTNU’s campus in Trondheim.

The mission of Department of Industrial Economics and Technology Management (IØT) is to carry out education, research, and innovation activities at an international level at the intersection between technology/natural sciences and business economics, management, and HSE. The department’s activities aim to contribute to sustainable value creation within technology-based areas in industry, business, and the public sector in Norway

 

About the position

Electrification is widely promoted as a key pathway to industrial decarbonization. At the same time, hydrogen and carbon capture and storage (CCS) are increasingly recognized as important solutions for sectors where direct electrification may be difficult or uneconomic. This has led to a growing debate about the future role of "electrons versus molecules" in a net-zero economy.

Most existing studies assume that today's industrial structure remains largely unchanged and focus on how current industries can reduce emissions. However, deep decarbonization may fundamentally reshape industrial production, value chains, competitiveness, and the location of energy-intensive activities. As a result, future hydrogen demand may depend as much on industrial transformation as on technological choices.

This PhD project will investigate how alternative pathways toward a zero-emission industrial sector affect the future demand for hydrogen and the development of hydrogen value chains. The research will analyze the interplay between electrification, hydrogen, and CCS, while explicitly accounting for potential changes in industrial structures and production systems.

 

The project addresses research questions like:

  • How will future hydrogen demand vary across alternative industrial decarbonization pathways?
  • Which industrial sectors are likely to rely on electrification, hydrogen, or CCS to achieve net-zero emissions?
  • How might industrial transformation affect hydrogen production, transport, storage, and trade?
  • What level of hydrogen deployment is required to justify dedicated hydrogen infrastructure and markets?
  • How can Europe and Norway prepare for different industrial and energy-system transition pathways?

 

The successful candidate will develop and analyze future scenarios for industrial transformation, hydrogen demand, and infrastructure development. The project will contribute to the scientific and policy debate on how competitive zero-emission industries can emerge under different transition strategies.

Research environment

The PhD candidate will join a multidisciplinary research environment at the intersection of energy economics, industrial economics, operations research, and energy systems analysis.

The position is affiliated with FME HYDROGENi, the Norwegian Research and Innovation Centre for Hydrogen and Ammonia. The centre brings together 46 research and industry partners to develop the knowledge, technologies, and solutions needed to support a sustainable hydrogen economy and contribute to Norway's ambitions for climate neutrality and industrial transformation. FME HYDROGENi conducts research across the hydrogen value chain, including hydrogen production, transport and storage, industrial and maritime applications, safety, and the broader role of hydrogen in future energy systems. The centre is funded by the Research Council of Norway through the Centres for Environment-friendly Energy Research (FME) programme and operates during the period 2022-2030

The PhD candidate will be hosted at the Managerial Economics, Finance and Operations Research (BEDØK) group at the Department of Industrial Economics and Technology Management. The group is one of Norway’s leading academic environments in operations research, logistics, optimization, and quantitative decision support. The candidate will work in close collaboration with researchers from NTNU’s Department of Computer Science and Department of Civil and Environmental Engineering.

Your role in the project

The PhD candidate will:

  • Conduct original scientific research on hydrogen and industrial decarbonization pathways.
  • Develop and analyze scenarios for industrial transformation and climate neutrality.
  • Assess the future role of electrification, hydrogen, and CCS across industrial sectors.
  • Quantify hydrogen demand and infrastructure requirements under alternative transition pathways.
  • Publish research results in leading international journals and conferences.
  • Collaborate with academic, industry, and public-sector partners.
  • Complete the required coursework as part of the PhD programme.
  • Contribute to dissemination and communication of research findings.

 

Be prepared for changes to your work duties after employment.

Qualification requirements

Applicants must hold a master’s degree in a relevant field with strong academic results (B or better according to NTNU’s grading scale). Relevant academic backgrounds include:

  • Operations research or optimization
  • Energy systems
  • Energy Economics
  • Engineering disciplines with strong quantitative and analytical content
  • Or other closely related disciplines.

Applicants must demonstrate strong analytical and quantitative skills.

The appointment is to be made in accordance with NTNUs guidelines for recruitment positions for general criteria for the position.

Desired qualifications

The following qualifications will be considered an advantage:

  • Experience with energy system modelling, scenario analysis, or techno-economic analysis.
  • Knowledge of hydrogen technologies, industrial decarbonization, or climate policy.
  • Experience with quantitative modelling and data analysis.
  • Programming skills in Python, Julia, R, GAMS, or similar tools.
  • Interest in interdisciplinary research at the interface of technology, economics, and policy.

Applicants in the final phase of their master’s studies are encouraged to apply.

Personal characteristics

We are looking for a candidate who:

  • Is intellectually curious and motivated to conduct high-quality research
  • Has strong analytical and problem-solving skills
  • Works independently and in a structured manner
  • Has excellent communication and collaboration skills
  • Thrives in an interdisciplinary research environment. 
  • Is interested in research with relevance for industry, policy, and society.

Emphasis will be placed on scientific quality, research potential, and personal suitability.

We offer
  • An exciting and international academic environment with opportunities for competence development 
  • Close collaboration with leading researchers in energy systems modelling, optimization, and something else 
  • Opportunities to engage with industry partners and public sector stakeholders
  • Participation in research addressing key challenges of the green transition.
  • Opportunities for international research stays and conference participation.
  • An open and inclusive workplace  with engaged colleagues 
  • Favorable terms in the Norwegian Public Service Pension Fund
  • Employee benefits
  • Good loan, insurance, and pension schemes in the Norwegian Public Service Pension Fund 
  • Norwegian language training at a basic level (A2)
  • Working at NTNU 

Information about working and living in Norway can be found at the following link: https://www.workinnorway.no/en/Home

Diversity

Diversity is a strength, and at NTNU we aim to be an employer that reflects the diversity in society and that makes use of the potential of the population's collective skills. Our vision is Knowledge for a better world and our values ​​are creative, critical, constructive and respectful. We believe that an organization that is equal, diverse and gender-balanced is essential for us to achieve our goals. 

We strive to attract employees with different skills, life experiences and perspectives to contribute to even better problem solving of our societal mission in research and education. 

If you think this position is relevant and interesting, we encourage you to apply, regardless of gender, functional ability and cultural background, or whether you have been out of work for a period of time.

At NTNU we want to increase the proportion of women in scientific positions. We have a number of measures to promote equality. 

Salary and conditions

In the position of PhD Candidate, code 1017, your gross salary will normally be NOK 580 000,-per annum depending on qualifications and seniority. A 2% statutory contribution to the State Pension Fund is deducted from the salary. 

The period of employment is 3 years. The position is connected to the PhD program at the Faculty of Economics and Management, and the faculty will be your employer. Appointment to a PhD position requires that you are admitted to the PhD programme in Industrial Economics and Technology Management within three months of employment, and that you participate in an organized PhD programme during the employment period.

Trondheim is the workplace. For necessary professional and social interaction, it is a prerequisite that you are physically present and available to the institution on a daily basis.

The appointment is carried out in accordance with the principles of the State Employees Act, and Export control (legislation that regulates the export of knowledge, technology and services). Candidates who, after assessment of the application and attachments, are considered to be in conflict with the criteria in the latter act, will not be able to be employed.Any statutory leave will be added to the employment period.

As an employee at NTNU, it is important to stay updated on professional and organizational changes and adapt to these.

 

About the application

Please note that the application will only be assessed based on the information we have at the application deadline. Therefore, ensure that your application clearly demonstrates how your skills and experiences meet the criteria described above.

The application must contain the following: 

  • Motivation letter – The motivation letter must clearly state how the candidate meets the qualification requirements.
  • Research plan (maximum one page) – Applicants should provide a brief research plan describing how they would approach one or more of the research questions outlined in the description of the position. The plan should reflect the applicant’s research interests and provide an outline of how they envision contributing to the project objectives.
  • CV, diplomas, and certificates 
  • Scientific works, including the master thesis. 
  • Names and contact information of at least two potential references

If all, or parts, of your education has been taken abroad, we also ask you to attach documentation of the scope and quality of your entire education, both bachelor's and master's education, in addition to other higher education. Description of the documentation required can be found here. Please note that diploma Supplement is required to attach for European Master Diplomas outside Norway. Chinese applicants are required to provide confirmation of Master Diploma from China Credentials Verification (CHSI).

In the evaluation of which candidate is best qualified, emphasis will be placed on education, experience and personal and interpersonal qualities. Motivation, ambitions, and potential for research will also count in the assessment of the candidates.  

NTNU is committed to following the evaluation criteria for research quality according to The San Francisco Declaration on Research Assessment – DORA and the commitments in CoARA (responsible research assessment and recognition of a broader range of academic contributions in line with NTNU's societal mission).

Incomplete applications will not be considered.

General information

A public applicant list with names, ages, job titles, and municipalities of residence will be prepared after the application deadline. If you wish to reserve yourself from being included on the public applicant list, this must be justified. The assessment will be made in accordance with applicable laws. You will be notified if the reservation is not accepted.

Furthermore, Trondheim offers excellent educational opportunities (including international schools) and opportunities to enjoy nature, culture, and family life, with low crime rates and clean air quality.

Questions about the position can be directed to Professor Asgeir Tomasgard (asgeir.tomasgard @ntnu.no) or Professor Anne Neumann (anne.neumann@ntnu.no).

If you have any questions regarding the employment process, please contact HR Advisor Oddny Lyngvær at oddny.lyngvar@ntnu.no.

jobs.description:
