The Serve fleet has been delighting merchants, customers, and pedestrians along the way in Los Angeles, Miami, Dallas, Atlanta and Chicago while doing commercial deliveries. Weâre looking for talented individuals who will grow robotic deliveries from surprising novelty to efficient ubiquity.

Who We Are

We are tech industry veterans in software, hardware, and design who are pooling our skills to build the future we want to live in. We are solving real-world problems leveraging robotics, machine learning and computer vision, among other disciplines, with a mindful eye towards the end-to-end user experience. Our team is agile, diverse, and driven. We believe that the best way to solve complicated dynamic problems is collaboratively and respectfully.

JOB OVERVIEW

The Accountant supports the company's accounting operations by maintaining accurate financial records, performing assigned close activities, and preparing financial reports. The role executes and monitors key accounting processes, partners with cross-functional stakeholders to resolve discrepancies, supports audits, and helps maintain compliance with GAAP, SOX requirements, internal controls, and company policies.

JOB DUTIES

  • Oversee the preparation of monthly, quarterly, and annual financial statements and reports, ensuring completeness and accuracy.

  • Perform account reconciliations, including bank, accounts payable, and accounts receivable reconciliations, and resolve identified discrepancies.

  • Prepare and post journal entries and maintain an accurate and current general ledger.

  • Review, classify, and record expenses in accordance with company policies and applicable budget guidelines.

  • Oversee key accounting processes, including accounts payable, accounts receivable, fixed assets, inventory, accruals, and prepaid expenses.

  • Support internal and external audits by preparing documentation and providing timely, accurate responses to requests.

  • Monitor accounting activities for compliance with GAAP, SOX requirements, internal controls, and established company procedures.

  • Identify and recommend process improvements that strengthen controls and increase the efficiency and accuracy of accounting operations.

EXPERIENCE, QUALIFICATIONS, & SKILLS

Required Experience, Qualifications, and Skills

  • Bachelorâs degree in Accounting, Finance, or a related field, or equivalent practical accounting experience.

  • 5+ years of full accounting experience

  • Proficiency with accounting software such as Xero or NetSuite and intermediate to advanced Microsoft Excel skills.

  • Working knowledge of Generally Accepted Accounting Principles, or GAAP, and a strong understanding of Sarbanes Oxley compliance processes, internal controls, and financial reporting requirements.

  • Strong organizational, time management, communication, and collaboration skills, with the ability to prioritize work, meet deadlines, and partner effectively across teams.

  • High degree of accuracy and analytical ability, including the ability to identify, troubleshoot, and resolve accounting discrepancies and process inefficiencies.

Preferred Experience, Qualifications, and Skills

  • Progress toward CPA certification.

  • Experience with a publicly traded company or public accounting firm.

  • Experience in a startup or other fast paced environment.

  • Experience with robotics, manufacturing, or technology companies, including exposure to inventory management or cost accounting processes.

  • Demonstrated ability to adapt and operate effectively in a dynamic, collaborative environment.

jobs.title: RESEARCHER ECO-HYDROLOGIST - CRITICAL ZONE (m/f)
jobs.employer: Luxembourg Institute of Science and Technology - LIST
jobs.description: Permanent contract | BelvauxAre you passionate about research? So are we! Come and join us The Luxembourg Institute of Science and Technology (LIST) is a leading Research and Technology Organisation (RTO) that drives innovation for the economy and society in Luxembourg and beyond. With cutting-edge expertise in Natural, Built, Industrial environments, Space, AI, Security and defence technologies. LIST bridges scientific excellence and applied research to design solutions that address real-world challenges and create positive impact. Do you want to know more about LIST? Check our website: https://www.list.lu/ How will you contribute?This position is for a scientist to contribute to the core mission of the Catchment and Eco-hydrology group within the Environmental Modelling and Sensing unit. Research will investigate processes controlling behavior of Earth's Critical Zone, with an emphasis on understanding dependencies and feedbacks between the hydrologic cycle and ecosystems. We seek a scientist dedicated to integrating novel empirical observations and theory to answer questions motivated by pressing societal needs related to natural resources, and relevant to both the global scientific community and applied practitioners who manage those natural resources. The successful candidate will be a key member of an interdisciplinary and collaborative research group. The successful candidate is expected to develop an internationally recognized research program in ecohydrology, specifically in one of the following research areas:1. Tracers of eco-hydrologic processes. Research developing and applying innovative tracer approaches to understand water dynamics and associated biogeochemical processes across the soil–plant–atmosphere continuum. Building on existing strengths and infrastructure in the group, particular interest lies in stable isotope approaches that integrate environmental and eco-hydrological information using hydrological, plant physiological, or biogeochemical measurements.2. Small-catchment eco-hydrology. Research investigating interactions among vegetation, water dynamics, and biogeochemical processes, especially in forested headwater catchments. Particular interests include plant and ecosystem responses to hydrological extremes such as droughts and floods; thresholds and tipping points in vegetation and catchment functioning; and ecohydrological controls on the cycling and transport of carbon, plant nutrients, and pollutants.  Is Your profile described below? Are you our future colleague? Apply now!Experience and kills• PhD in Hydrology, Eco-hydrology, Isotope Biogeochemistry, Earth System Science, Environmental Science, or a related discipline• Post-doctoral research experience commensurate with an established researcher• Demonstrated ability to connect a research program with external funding sources, including competitive grants and public and private partnerships• Skill in both basic and applied science, interdisciplinary teams, and entrepreneurial development of research programs Language skills• Fluency in English, both oral and written. Skills in French, German, or Luxembourgish are assets. Your LIST benefits• An organization with a passion for impact and strong RDI partnerships in Luxembourg and Europe that works on responsible and independent research projects• Sustainable by design, empowering our belief that we play an essential role in paving the way to a green society• Innovative infrastructures and exceptional labs occupying more than 5,000 square metres, including innovations in all that we do• An environment encouraging curiosity, innovation and entrepreneurship in all areas• Personalized learning programme to foster our staff's soft and technical skills• Multicultural and international work environment with more than 60 nationalities represented in our workforce• Diverse and inclusive work environment empowering our people to fulfil their personal and professional ambitions• Gender-friendly environment with multiple actions to attract, develop and retain women in science• 32 days' paid annual leave, 11 public holidays, 13-month salary, statutory health insurance• Flexible working hours, home working policy (not remote) and access to Digital lunch vouchersApply onlineYour application must include:• A motivation letter oriented towards the position and detailing your experience• A scientific CV with contact details• List of publications (and patents, if applicable)• Contact details of 2 referencesPlease apply ONLINE formally through the HR system. Applications by email will not be considered.Application procedure and conditionsWe kindly request applicants to provide their nationality for statistical purposes only, as part of our commitment to promoting diversity and ensuring equal opportunities in our workforce. This information will be kept confidential and will not be used for any discriminatory purposes.LIST is dedicated to maintaining an inclusive work environment and is an equal opportunity employer. We are committed to attracting, hiring, and retaining a diverse workforce. All applicants will be considered for employment without discrimination based on national origin, race, ethnicity, gender, sexual orientation, gender identity, marital status, religion, age, or disability.Applications will be continuously reviewed until the position is filled. An assessment committee will thoroughly evaluate applications, adhering to guidelines designed to ensure equal opportunities. The primary criteria for selection will be the alignment of the applicant's existing skills and expertise with the requirements mentioned above.As part of our recruitment process, the selected candidate might be subject to a background check in accordance with applicable laws and institutional policies. Further checks and restrictions might apply to candidates in compliance with export controls requirementsFor the purposes of the position and in accordance with applicable legislation, the successful candidate may be requested to provide a recent criminal record certificate.This position offers a gross monthly salary between €7'460 and €9'742, paid over 13 months (€96'980–€126'646 annually) based on full time employment. jobs.title: Agile Program Manager
jobs.description:
We're looking for an experienced Agile Program Manager to lead delivery across multiple cross-functional teams working toward a shared set of business outcomes. You'll sit at the intersection of strategy and execution: translating roadmap priorities into coordinated, predictable delivery, keeping dependencies visible, and making sure the right people are making the right decisions at the right time.

This is a hands-on program role, not a status-reporting one. You'll own the cadence, the plan, and the risks across several Agile teams, and you'll be the person stakeholders trust to tell them where things really stand.

What You'll Do

  • Lead end-to-end delivery of a multi-team program, coordinating three or more Agile teams (Scrum, Kanban, or hybrid) toward shared quarterly objectives.
  • Run program-level planning, including quarterly/PI planning, roadmap alignment, capacity planning, and release planning.
  • Identify, map, and actively manage cross-team dependencies, risks, and blockers, escalating early and with clear options.
  • Facilitate program ceremonies such as Scrum of Scrums, program syncs, system demos, and retrospectives, and make sure they produce decisions, not just updates.
  • Partner with Product Owners and Product Managers to keep backlogs prioritized, refined, and aligned to business value.
  • Build and maintain program-level reporting: delivery health, burn-up/velocity trends, OKR or objective progress, and RAID logs, tailored for both team-level and executive audiences.
  • Drive continuous improvement in delivery practices, tooling, and team workflows, coaching teams and leaders on Agile principles where needed.
  • Manage stakeholder communication across engineering, product, design, business, and leadership, keeping expectations aligned as scope and priorities shift.
  • Track program budget, resourcing, and vendor or third-party deliverables where applicable.

What You Bring

  • 8+ years of experience in program or project management, with at least 5 years leading delivery in Agile environments.
  • Proven track record managing multi-team programs (not just single-team Scrum) from planning through release.
  • Deep, practical knowledge of Scrum and Kanban, plus experience with at least one scaling framework (SAFe, LeSS, Scrum@Scale, or similar).
  • Strong command of Agile tooling such as Jira, Jira Align, Azure DevOps, Rally, or equivalent, including building dashboards and program-level reporting.
  • Excellent facilitation skills: you can run a 50-person planning event as comfortably as a tense 1:1 escalation.
  • Clear, concise written and verbal communication in English, with the ability to tailor the message for engineers and executives alike.
  • Experience working with distributed or remote teams across time zones.
  • Comfort operating with ambiguity: you can stand up structure where there is none and adapt it as the program evolves.

Nice to Have

  • Agile or program management certifications such as SAFe RTE, SAFe SPC, PMI-ACP, PgMP, PMP, CSM/CSP, or ICAgile.
  • Experience with Agile transformations or introducing scaled frameworks into an organization.
  • Background in software, SaaS, data, or digital product delivery.
  • Familiarity with OKRs and value-stream or portfolio management.
  • Experience in regulated industries (financial services, healthcare, insurance, public sector) where Agile delivery coexists with compliance requirements.
  • Budget and vendor management experience on programs with multiple delivery partners.

jobs.title: Italian-speaking Sales Executive - Industrial Automation
jobs.description:
Native Italian speaker, fully remote

Work tasks: Condor Automation is a growing company selling to industrial customers all over Europe. We help factories keep their machines running by finding the automation parts they urgently need: PLCs, HMIs, drives, servo drives, motors, electronic boards and sensors from brands such as Siemens, Omron, Allen Bradley, Fanuc, Mitsubishi, Yaskawa, Schneider and ABB. Our speciality is the obsolete and hard-to-find parts that local distributors can't supply. We are looking for an ambitious Italian-speaking Sales Executive to help us grow in Italy. This is a real chance to grow with the company: your results will be seen, valued and rewarded. You will: - Find and contact new B2B customers (factories, maintenance teams, OEMs and integrators) by phone and email - Follow up enquiries and quotes and close sales - Build long-term relationships with existing customers - Work closely with the purchasing team to offer fast and competitive quotes - Keep customer and sales activity up to date in our CRM (Odoo)

We offer: - EUR 2,500 gross monthly salary + uncapped commission - there is no limit to what you can earn - Flexible hours: organise your day around your life, while covering our customers' needs - A real work-family balance, with a team that supports you when life happens - Work from home, anywhere in Estonia - 100% remote - Full training on our products, sales techniques and tools - A stable, long-term role with real room to grow as the company grows We are a small, international team spread across the UK, Italy and Spain. We believe people do their best work when their life outside work is looked after too. If you are a parent, you can give your best at work knowing the team has your back when something comes up at home.

Other requirements: The team works in English; you will speak to customers in Italian. - Native Italian (essential) - Good working English to communicate with the team - Proven experience in B2B sales of industrial, electrical or automation products - An existing network of industrial customers in Italy is a strong advantage - Confident on the phone and good at following up - Organised, proactive and comfortable working remotely and independently - Technical knowledge of industrial automation is a plus - we will train you on our products - Resident in Estonia

Option to work from home: Yes

jobs.title: Administrationskoordinator med ansvar for miljøledelse søges til BOFA
jobs.description:
Vil du være med til at skabe struktur, overblik og fremdrift i en travl hverdag?

BOFA søger en selvstændig og initiativrig medarbejder til BOFAs administration. Den primære opgave vil være at understøtte BOFAs driftschef og miljøchef i den daglige koordinering af opgaver, projekter, skabe overblik, sikre opfølgning, samt understøtte at aftaler og opgaver bliver ført frem til afslutning.

Stillingen omfatter desuden ansvaret for BOFAs miljøledelsessystem efter ISO 14001, herunder koordinering og udvikling af miljøledelsesarbejdet, samt opfølgning på systemets krav og aktiviteter.

Bornholm har en vision om at blive verdens første affaldsfrie samfund, hvor alt affald skal bruges igen.  BOFA søger en administrations koordinater der i ord og handling, vil være med på holdet og være en del af ”BORNHOLM VISER VEJ – uden affald 2032”.

 Stillingen er ny, og du får derfor mulighed for at præge både funktionens indhold og arbejdsgange i tæt samarbejde med de to chefer.

Dine opgaver vil blandt andet være at:

  • Koordinere deadlines, aftaler og opfølgning på igangværende opgaver.

  • Koordinere samarbejder med myndigheder og rådgivere.

  • Understøtte planlægning og prioritering af møder, aktiviteter og opgaver.

  • Følge op på entreprenørers leverancer og kontraktmæssige forpligtelser.

  • Deltage i udvalgte møder, udarbejde referater og sikre opfølgning på beslutninger.

  • Varetage mindre projekter og opgaver selvstændigt fra planlægning til afslutning.

  • Bidrage til at udvikle gode arbejdsgange, skabe struktur og sikre fremdrift på tværs af opgaver og samarbejdsflader.

Opgaverne vil udvikle sig i takt med, at rollen tager form, og du får mulighed for at bringe dine kompetencer og idéer i spil.

Du får dermed en alsidig funktion, hvor ledelsesunderstøttelse, koordinering og selvstændigt fagligt ansvar går hånd i hånd.

 Vi forestiller os, at du arbejder struktureret, har blik for detaljen og samtidig kan bevare overblikket over den samlede opgave. Du er god til at prioritere, følger op på aftaler og tager initiativ, når du ser behov for handling.

Vi lægger især vægt på, at du:

  • Arbejder selvstændigt og tager ansvar for at drive opgaver fremad.

  • Er god til koordinering, planlægning og opfølgning.

  • Kommunikerer klart og samarbejder konstruktivt med forskellige faggrupper.

  • Har en løsningsorienteret tilgang og ser muligheder for at forbedre arbejdsgange.

  • Trives i en hverdag med mange forskellige opgaver og skiftende prioriteringer.

  • Har mod på at bidrage med egne idéer og være med til at udvikle en ny funktion.

Erfaring med projektkoordinering, ledelsesunderstøttelse, kontraktopfølgning, miljøledelse eller lignende opgaver er en fordel. Det vigtigste er dog, at du har de rette kompetencer, tager ansvar og har lyst til at skabe værdi i hverdagen.

 BOFA kan tilbyde:

  • En arbejdsdag med mange forskellige og spændende opgaver

  • Et stærkt team af dygtige og hjælpsomme kollegaer

  • Et godt arbejdsmiljø – både fagligt og socialt med en aktiv personaleforening

Hos BOFA bliver du en del af en organisation, der arbejder med affald, ressourcer og udvikling af løsninger til gavn for Bornholm. Du får en varieret hverdag, tæt samarbejde med ledelsen og mulighed for at præge en ny funktion, hvor dine kompetencer og initiativer kan gøre en konkret forskel.

Ansættelse 1. januar 2027 eller efter aftale

Arbejdstiden er gennemsnitlig 37 timer pr. uge.

 Hvad er BOFA?

BOFA er Bornholms affaldsselskab, ejet af Bornholms Regionskommune. Vi håndterer det bornholmske husholdningsaffald, samt en del erhvervsaffald. Derudover driver BOFA øens seks genbrugspladser, deponi og forbrændingsanlægget i Rønne, samt genbrugscentret i Vestermarie. BOFA beskæftiger omtrent 60 medarbejdere. Du kan læse mere om BOFA og Vision 2032 på www.bofa.dk.

BOFA ønsker at medarbejdersammensætningen afspejler samfundets, og vi ser frem til din ansøgning uanset personlig baggrund – vi ser kun på kvalifikationer og kompetencer.

Det praktiske

Du søger stillingen ved at sende din ansøgning og CV samt dokumentation for uddannelse, via "Søg Jobbet" knappen. Ansøgningsfristen er 17. november 2026.

Har du spørgsmål til stillingen, er du velkommen til at kontakte Chefkonsulent Pieter Jacobus Theron på 2122 7445e eller mail pjt@0000@bofa.dk.

Samtaler vil foregå løbende i uge 47 & 48.

Her understøtter vi beboernes ret til at leve det liv, de ønsker – "længst muligt i eget liv".Afdelingen består af 20 boliger i afdeling E/F, som er indrettet som leve-bo-miljøer, hvor maden laves i huset, og pleje og omsorg tilpasses den enkelte beboers behov. Vi arbejder rehabiliterende og tæt sammen med både beboere og deres pårørende for at sikre en meningsfuld hverdag.

Beboerne i afdeling EFVores beboere har vidt forskellige behov, og du vil arbejde med både demente og psykiatriske beboere. Vi tilpasser plejen til den enkeltes livssituation og sørger for, at alle beboere får mulighed for at leve et liv med højeste mulige livskvalitet, selv i mødet med sygdom og udfordringer. Det er derfor afgørende, at du er indstillet på at arbejde med forskellige diagnoser og er klar til at give den rette støtte og pleje.

jobs.title: Feltsense AI Engineer
jobs.description:
About the company

We raised $5.1M to build agents that operate as fully autonomous founders. Our backers include Matt Schlicht (founder of Moltbook), the founders of Crunchbase and Republic, and VCs including Draper, Precursor, and Liquid2.

We're working at the frontier of autonomous systems, building agents that don't just chat, but run entire businesses.

Our system identifies business opportunities through market signals, validates ideas with live ad tests, builds and launches software products, and brings in human experts wherever agents fall short. That loop already runs end to end: from idea to launched product to first revenue.

Over the next 12 months, our focus is on reliability, throughput, and self-improvement, making every launch better than the last.

About the role

We're looking for a hands-on AI Engineer to take ownership of the architecture and development of our autonomous agent system.

You'll lead the technical direction of the platform, building multi-agent orchestration systems, self-improving agent harnesses, and AI-powered backend services. This is a highly technical leadership role that combines architectural decision-making with hands-on engineering.

You'll be expected to ship production code, make key technical decisions, improve agent behavior in production, and help establish the engineering standards as the company scales.

Responsibilities

  • Own the system architecture and make key technical decisions across the platform.

  • Design and build multi-agent systems and orchestration infrastructure that take products from idea to launch.

  • Develop self-improving agent harnesses, including feedback loops, evaluation systems, and memory.

  • Build and maintain AI-powered backend services on top of LLM APIs such as Anthropic, OpenAI, and Gemini.

  • Write production code, particularly around agent runtime and orchestration.

  • Debug and improve AI behavior in production through prompt engineering, structured outputs, retries, and fallbacks.

  • Break down complex technical challenges into actionable milestones and prioritize the engineering roadmap.

  • Establish engineering standards around code reviews, testing, observability, and release processes.

  • Lead and support the engineering team while remaining deeply involved in implementation.

Requirements

  • 4+ years of professional software engineering experience.

  • Previous technical leadership experience at an early-stage company (Founding Engineer, Tech Lead, Head of Engineering, or similar).

  • Hands-on experience building and shipping multi-agent systems and orchestration frameworks to production.

  • Experience developing self-improving or self-evolving agent harnesses.

  • Strong backend engineering skills, including designing and maintaining APIs, services, and data flows.

  • Experience working with LLM-based systems, including prompt engineering, model configuration, structured outputs, embeddings, retrieval, and evaluation.

  • Daily hands-on experience with AI coding agents such as Claude Code, Cursor, OpenAI Codex, or similar tools. You should know how to delegate work to agents, review their output, and verify what they build.

Nice to have

  • Strong TypeScript and Node.js experience.

  • Experience with Vercel AI SDK, Claude Agent SDK, or building custom agent runtimes.

  • Experience with PostgreSQL, Supabase, and pgvector.

  • Familiarity with background job systems such as Inngest or Pub/Sub.

  • Experience with Zod, Vitest, and GCP Cloud Run.

  • Experience growing or restructuring distributed engineering teams.

  • Interest in AI evaluation, safety, and observability.

jobs.title: Solutions Consultant, Mid-Market, DACH
jobs.description:
WHO WE ARE

Notion is the collaborative AI workspace where teams and agents think together https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=vkpYpWfEK5s. We're building one place where your knowledge, projects, meetings, and AI tools live side by side, so work is faster, clearer, and less fragmented. Millions of individuals, small teams, and large companies run their work on Notion.



Notinos (our employees) are customer zero in bringing this future of work to life. We care about craft, building things that last, and the belief that great work is still fundamentally human. Our goal isn’t to ship the next feature. Each and every team of Notinos is working to set the standard for how humans work together in the AI era. From building a business’s system of record to making and managing AI agents to automating away the busy work, we care deeply about giving our customers more time for their life’s work.




ABOUT THE ROLE:



Notion is shaping the future of Go-To-Market, and as a Solutions Consultant (SC), you’ll bring that future to life by building alongside customers and turning their biggest challenges into measurable outcomes. As a customer-facing, quota-carrying SC, you’ll bring together technical fluency and commercial ownership to grow your book of business. You’ll build pipeline with BDRs, engage key stakeholders, lead discovery, co-build workflow solutions live with customers, and guide opportunities through close. You’ll connect each solution to a clear business case and stay engaged through adoption, expansion, and renewal so customers realize the value of what they buy.

You’ll partner with BDRs, Outcomes Architects, and technical or product specialists while maintaining clear ownership of customer relationships, opportunity momentum, and next steps. If you’re a builder who loves to sell—and want to work at the intersection of AI, productivity, and enterprise—this is the role.

This role will be based in Dublin. We work from our offices on Mondays, Tuesdays and Thursdays (our Anchor Days) because we do our best thinking and building together in person. We’re looking for someone who’s excited to work alongside the team during those days.




WHAT YOU'LL ACHIEVE:

 - Create pipeline across your book of business. Build target-account plans with BDRs and initiate outreach to priority stakeholders to generate qualified opportunities, alongside BDR-sourced pipeline.

 - Own opportunities from first conversation through close. Lead discovery, qualify business needs and urgency, align stakeholders, shape the solution and business case, and drive the evaluation and commercial decision. Navigate commercial sizing, proposal construction, procurement, legal, and security review to close deals with the right scope, credits, and implementation path.

 - Design and validate workflow solutions that deliver measurable value. Map current- and future-state workflows, co-build solutions live in Notion, and define realistic scope, success criteria, and an implementation path. Translate customer needs and validated outcomes into a clear business case, commercial recommendation, and decision path. Treat discovery as an opportunity to build and validate.

 - Orchestrate the right partners while maintaining ownership. Engage BDRs, Outcomes Architects, and technical or product specialists at the right moments, with clear context and asks, while owning opportunity momentum, customer communication, and next steps.

 - Drive customer value and commercial growth after signature. Partner with Outcomes Architects, guide the initial path to value with a clear adoption plan, on onboarding and ongoing multi-workflow adoption, and own expansion strategy and renewal planning. Stay accountable for translating credits sold into credits consumed, and surface risks or expansion opportunities as customer workflows mature.




SKILLS YOU'LL NEED TO BRING: 

 - Commercial ownership and pipeline generation. You can demonstrate how you created or advanced business, influenced customer decisions, and owned measurable outcomes. Relevant experience may come from quota-carrying sales or adjacent customer-facing roles.

 - Technical fluency and builder mindset. You are comfortable building live in software and can demo, co-design, and troubleshoot with a customer without needing a specialist in the room.

 - AI fluency. You are excited about AI, build with new tools, and continually learn new ways of working.

 - Discovery, qualification, and value articulation. You can uncover customer needs, map workflows, qualify business impact and urgency, and translate what you learn into commercial outcomes, adoption plans, and clear success criteria.

 - Agency, urgency, and learning velocity. You set clear goals, take initiative, learn from customer interactions, and apply those learnings to improve outcomes. You bring new ideas and workflows to customers and make complex problems easier to solve.

 - Complex customer engagement. You can lead multi-stakeholder interactions and navigate procurement, legal, and security review cycles.

 - Fluency in German.




NICE TO HAVES:

 - Full-cycle B2B software sales experience or solutions engineering experience, with a consistent track record of exceeding quota across new-logo acquisition and expansion motions.
   
   - Familiarity with usage-based or consumption-based pricing models and the ability to structure credit-based commercial proposals.

 - Prior experience selling to mid-market and enterprise accounts in productivity, collaboration, or workflow software.

 - Experience in a shared account ownership model, partnering with a post-sale or Customer Success team as part of an integrated customer motion.

jobs.description:
WHO WE ARE

Notion is the collaborative AI workspace where teams and agents think together https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=vkpYpWfEK5s. We're building one place where your knowledge, projects, meetings, and AI tools live side by side, so work is faster, clearer, and less fragmented. Millions of individuals, small teams, and large companies run their work on Notion.



Notinos (our employees) are customer zero in bringing this future of work to life. We care about craft, building things that last, and the belief that great work is still fundamentally human. Our goal isn’t to ship the next feature. Each and every team of Notinos is working to set the standard for how humans work together in the AI era. From building a business’s system of record to making and managing AI agents to automating away the busy work, we care deeply about giving our customers more time for their life’s work.




ABOUT THE ROLE:



Notion is shaping the future of Go-To-Market, and as a Solutions Consultant (SC), you’ll bring that future to life by building alongside customers and turning their biggest challenges into measurable outcomes. As a customer-facing, quota-carrying SC, you’ll bring together technical fluency and commercial ownership to grow your book of business. You’ll build pipeline with BDRs, engage key stakeholders, lead discovery, co-build workflow solutions live with customers, and guide opportunities through close. You’ll connect each solution to a clear business case and stay engaged through adoption, expansion, and renewal so customers realize the value of what they buy.

You’ll partner with BDRs, Outcomes Architects, and technical or product specialists while maintaining clear ownership of customer relationships, opportunity momentum, and next steps. If you’re a builder who loves to sell—and want to work at the intersection of AI, productivity, and enterprise—this is the role.

This role will be based in Dublin. We work from our offices on Mondays, Tuesdays and Thursdays (our Anchor Days) because we do our best thinking and building together in person. We’re looking for someone who’s excited to work alongside the team during those days.




WHAT YOU'LL ACHIEVE:

 - Create pipeline across your book of business. Build target-account plans with BDRs and initiate outreach to priority stakeholders to generate qualified opportunities, alongside BDR-sourced pipeline.

 - Own opportunities from first conversation through close. Lead discovery, qualify business needs and urgency, align stakeholders, shape the solution and business case, and drive the evaluation and commercial decision. Navigate commercial sizing, proposal construction, procurement, legal, and security review to close deals with the right scope, credits, and implementation path.

 - Design and validate workflow solutions that deliver measurable value. Map current- and future-state workflows, co-build solutions live in Notion, and define realistic scope, success criteria, and an implementation path. Translate customer needs and validated outcomes into a clear business case, commercial recommendation, and decision path. Treat discovery as an opportunity to build and validate.

 - Orchestrate the right partners while maintaining ownership. Engage BDRs, Outcomes Architects, and technical or product specialists at the right moments, with clear context and asks, while owning opportunity momentum, customer communication, and next steps.

 - Drive customer value and commercial growth after signature. Partner with Outcomes Architects, guide the initial path to value with a clear adoption plan, on onboarding and ongoing multi-workflow adoption, and own expansion strategy and renewal planning. Stay accountable for translating credits sold into credits consumed, and surface risks or expansion opportunities as customer workflows mature.




SKILLS YOU'LL NEED TO BRING: 

 - Commercial ownership and pipeline generation. You can demonstrate how you created or advanced business, influenced customer decisions, and owned measurable outcomes. Relevant experience may come from quota-carrying sales or adjacent customer-facing roles.

 - Technical fluency and builder mindset. You are comfortable building live in software and can demo, co-design, and troubleshoot with a customer without needing a specialist in the room.

 - AI fluency. You are excited about AI, build with new tools, and continually learn new ways of working.

 - Discovery, qualification, and value articulation. You can uncover customer needs, map workflows, qualify business impact and urgency, and translate what you learn into commercial outcomes, adoption plans, and clear success criteria.

 - Agency, urgency, and learning velocity. You set clear goals, take initiative, learn from customer interactions, and apply those learnings to improve outcomes. You bring new ideas and workflows to customers and make complex problems easier to solve.

 - Complex customer engagement. You can lead multi-stakeholder interactions and navigate procurement, legal, and security review cycles.

 - Fluency in German.




NICE TO HAVES:

 - Full-cycle B2B software sales experience or solutions engineering experience, with a consistent track record of exceeding quota across new-logo acquisition and expansion motions.
   
   - Familiarity with usage-based or consumption-based pricing models and the ability to structure credit-based commercial proposals.

 - Prior experience selling to mid-market and enterprise accounts in productivity, collaboration, or workflow software.

 - Experience in a shared account ownership model, partnering with a post-sale or Customer Success team as part of an integrated customer motion.

jobs.title: Etsimme vahvistusta Factoryn HR-tiimiin!
jobs.description: Etsimme vahvistusta Factoryn HR-tiimiin!Oletko ihmisläheinen tekijä, joka viihtyy ravintoloiden arjessa, innostuu asioiden järjestämisestä ja uskaltaa tarttua haastaviinkin tilanteisiin? Meillä voisi olla sinulle paikka!Factorylla on 28 ravintolaa Helsingissä, Espoossa, Vantaalla, Salossa, Hämeenlinnassa ja Lahdessaja kasvumme jatkuu!Meillä työskentelee paljon pitkäaikaisia työntekijöitä, joiden osaaminen ja kokemus ovat tärkeä osa Factorya.Nyt etsimme HR-tiimiimme uutta työkaveria tukemaan henkilöstömme ja ravintoloidemme arkea.Meillä henkilöstötyötä tehdään lähellä ihmisiä: ravintoloissa, esihenkilöiden rinnalla ja yhdessä monikulttuurisen työyhteisömme kanssa.Päiviin mahtuu kohtaamisia, käytännön järjestelyjä, uuden ideointia ja yhdessä onnistumisen iloa.Millaista arkea sinulle olisi luvassa?Olet tärkeä tuki ravintoloidemme esihenkilöille niin päivittäisissä kysymyksissä kuin haastavammissakin henkilöstötilanteissa.Työhösi kuuluu:- Esihenkilöiden ja henkilöstön tukemista arjessa: kuuntelemista, neuvomista ja käytännön ravintolatilanteiden ratkomista yhdessä.- Innostavaa rekrytointia, jossa Factoryn työkulttuuri pääsee näkyviin, sekä perehdyttämistä ja uusien työntekijöiden tukemista, jotta he tuntevat itsensä tervetulleiksi ja pääsevät sujuvasti osaksi työyhteisöä.- Toimipistekierroksia ja henkilöstön kohtaamista ravintoloiden arjessa. Hahmotat toiminnan kokonaisuuden, ymmärrät työhön kohdistuvat odotukset ja asiakkaan polun sekä tartut reippaasti havaittuihin kehityskohteisiin yhdessä henkilöstön ja esihenkilöiden kanssa.- Uusien ravintoloiden avausten valmistelua ja avauksissa mukana olemista, henkilöstön perehdyttämistä sekä päivittäisen työohjelman ja arjen toimintatapojen rakentamista. Luoden hyvää työilmapiiriä ja yhteistä Factoryn toimintakulttuuria.- Esihenkilöiden tukemista henkilöstötarpeiden ennakoinnissa, työntekijöiden koordinoinnissa toimipisteiden välillä sekä lomien ja sijaistusten järjestelyissä.- Työsuhteen eri vaiheisiin liittyvien asioiden hoitamista, työsopimusten huolellista valmistelua sekä henkilöstötietojen tarkkaa ja ajantasaista ylläpitoa eri järjestelmissä.Lisäksi tehtäviin kuuluu työnteko-oikeuden ja oleskelulupien tarkistamista.- Henkilöstöviestintää, aktiivista kommunikointia ja ohjeistusten päivittämistä. Varmistat, että tieto kulkee ja ohjeet ymmärretään huomioimalla ihmisten erilaiset oppimistavat ja tuen tarpeet.- Tiivistä yhteistyötä palkanlaskennan kanssa, palkkoihin liittyvien kysymysten selvittämistä sekä molemminpuolista tukea ja apua arjen työtehtävissä.- Työkyvyn ja työhyvinvoinnin tukemista sekä esihenkilöiden tukemista varhaisen tuen keskusteluissa. Meille välitön välittäminen tarkoittaa huolten huomaamista, kuuntelemista ja tuen tarjoamista ajoissa.- Esihenkilöiden tukemista henkilöstön johtamisessa, nopeaa reagointia arjen tilanteisiin sekä vaikeiden asioiden puheeksi ottamista. Tässä tarvitaan taitoa kuunnella, rohkeutta keskustella ja halua löytää ratkaisuja.- Koulutusten ja harjoittelujen koordinointia sekä henkilöstön osaamisen kehittämistä. Meille on tärkeää, että työntekijämme saavat mahdollisuuksia oppia uutta, kehittyä ja edetä urallaan.- Yhteistyötä kumppaneidemme, kuten oppilaitosten ja työterveyshuollon, kanssa. Huolehdit avoimesta yhteydenpidosta ja sujuvasta yhteistyöstä, jotta asiat etenevät ja tuki tavoittaa oikeat ihmiset.- HR-käytäntöjen ideointia ja kehittämistä, jotta arki pysyy sujuvana ja toimintatapamme kehittyvät yrityksen kasvun mukana.Kaiken keskiössä ovat ihmiset ja arjen sujuminen. Tehtävässä pääset sekä suunnittelemaan että tarttumaan käytännön tekemiseen, oman tiimin tuella.Millainen työkaveri sopisi meidän HR-tiimiin?Toivomme, että olet helposti lähestyttävä, oma-aloitteinen ja luotettava.Pidät monta lankaa käsissäsi ja kohtaat ihmiset lämpimästi myös kiireen keskellä. Innostut uusista asioista ja tuot rohkeasti omia ideoitasi esiin.Teet töitä pilke silmäkulmassa ja tuot huumorillasi hyvää fiilistä arkeen!Kaikkea ei tarvitse osata valmiiksi, sillä saat tiimiltämme tukea työtehtäviisi.Tehtävässä tarvitset:- Hyviä tietoteknisiä taitoja ja valmiutta oppia käyttämään erilaisia HR- ja rekrytointijärjestelmiä.- Erinomaista suomen ja hyvää englannin kielen taitoa, ilmaiset itseäsi sujuvasti sekä kirjallisesti että suullisesti molemmilla kielillä.- Oman auton ja ajokortin, sillä työ sisältää liikkumista toimipisteidemme välillä.- Valmiutta ja joustavuutta työskennellä pääsääntöisesti pääkaupunkiseudulla sekä tehdä käyntejä ja yrityksen laajentuessa työskennellä myös sen ulkopuolella.- Ravintolan toimintatapojen tuntemusta ja valmiutta perehdyttää työntekijöitä. Ravintola-alan työkokemus on meille ehdoton plussa!- Hyviä vuorovaikutus- ja organisointitaitoja sekä hienotunteisuutta henkilöstöasioiden käsittelyssä.- Aikaisempi kokemus tiimin johtamisesta ja kokonaisuuden hallinnasta.Mitä saat meiltä?- Rempseän työtiimin, jossa saat kysyä, olla oma itsesi ja ratkoa asioita yhdessä.- Kokeneita, pitkään talossa olleita työkavereita sekä perehdytystä ja tukea työtehtäviisi.- Joustavan työajan ja pääsääntöisesti arkiaamuihin painottuvan työn. Mahdollisuuden tehdä satunnaisesti etätöitä.- Monipuolisen tehtävän jatkuvasti kasvavassa ravintolayrityksessä.- Mahdollisuuden kehittää ja ideoida toimintatapojamme sekä edetä urallasi.- Työn, jossa oman tekemisesi vaikutus näkyy ihmisten ja ravintoloiden arjessa.- Toimistomme sijaitsee Helsingin Pitäjänmäellä. Työskentelet sekä toimistolla että ravintoloissamme.Etsimme pitkäaikaista työkaveria ja toivomme, että viihdyt meillä pitkään. Olisitko sinä sopiva meidän HR-tiimiimme?Haluaisimme kuulla sinusta!Lähetä persoonallinen hakemuksesi ja CV palkkatoiveineen.Kerro meille, kuka olet, osaamisesi ja mikä sinua innostaa työssä Factoryn HR-tiimissä.Haku on avoinna toistaiseksi.Haastattelemme hakijoita jo hakuaikana ja täytämme paikan heti sopivan henkilön löydyttyä, joten lähetäthän hakemuksesi pian!

jobs.title: VVS-installatør søges til Hafnia Bad ApS
jobs.description:
VVS-montør / VVS-installatør til komplette badeværelsesprojekter - med mulighed for projektledelse

Virksomhed: Hafnia Bad

Stillingstype: Fuldtid

Tiltrædelse: Hurtigst muligt / efter aftale

Brænder du for høj håndværksmæssig kvalitet, gennemtænkte VVS-løsninger og flotte badeværelser? Hos Hafnia Bad har vi rygende travlt med at skabe kompromisløse badeværelsesdrømme for vores kunder. Derfor søger vi en dygtig og engageret VVS-profil, der vil have en central rolle på vores projekter.

Om jobbet

Som vores nye kollega får du ansvaret for at drive og udføre VVS-entreprisen på vores badeværelsesprojekter fra start til slut.

jobs.title: PA for direktøren på Voksenområdet i Ikast-Brande Kommune
jobs.description:
Har du lyst til at arbejde helt tæt på topledelsen af de store velfærdsområder i en udviklingsorienteret kommune? Er du god til at skabe overblik og holde styr på detaljerne – også i en travl hverdag? Er du imødekommende og god til at skabe relationer? Så er du måske vores nye medarbejder i Ikast-Brande Kommune.

Direktørområdet består af de tre afdelinger Socialafdelingen, Arbejdsmarked- og Borgerserviceafdelingen samt Sundheds- og Ældreafdelingen. I det daglige vil du skulle arbejde tæt sammen med kolleger i direktørområdets øvrige stabe og områder. Du refererer direkte til direktøren.

Om stillingen

Du får en bred berøringsflade i kommunen og et indgående kendskab til strategisk ledelse og styring på kommunalt toplederniveau. Dine opgaver bliver blandt andet, at:

  • primært understøtte direktørens daglige arbejde med kalenderstyring, mødekoordinering, prioritering af henvendelser og praktisk opfølgning
  • planlægge og koordinere møder, seminarer og andre ledelsesaktiviteter, herunder udarbejdelse af dagsordner, referater og opfølgning på aftaler 
  • betjene chefgruppen med dagsorden og referat til chefmøderne 
  • udarbejde beslutningsgrundlag, notater, præsentationer og kommunikation
  • udarbejde sagsfremstillinger til politiske udvalg samt kommunens direktion
  • koordinere beredskabsplanlægningen på Voksenområdet samt andre koordineringsopgaver

Din profil

Vi søger en kollega, der er nysgerrig, serviceminded og har blik for både detaljer og helheder. Du trives med at arbejde i et krydsfelt mellem administrative- og ledelsesunderstøttende opgaver. Du er proaktiv, god til at følge op og kan håndtere fortrolige oplysninger.

Derudover forventes det, at du

  • kan prioritere og bevare overblikket, når flere opgaver kræver din opmærksomhed.
  • kan kommunikere klart og præcist – både skriftligt og mundtligt.
  • arbejder selvstændigt og tager initiativ til at følge op.
  • har forståelse for arbejdet i en politisk styret organisation.

Din uddannelsesmæssige baggrund er ikke afgørende. Det vigtigste for os er, at du har en relevant uddannelse eller praktisk erfaring, der gør dig i stand til at lykkes i og trives med stillingen. Vi kunne eksempelvis forestille os, at du er kontoruddannet eller har en relevant videregående uddannelse på bachelor- eller kandidatniveau. Men måske er det en helt tredje baggrund, der gør, at du er den helt rette til stillingen. 

Vi tilbyder

  • Varierede opgaver og mange berøringsflader, og dermed en alsidig hverdag.
  • En organisation som møder hinanden med dialog, tillid og ansvarlighed.
  • En arbejdsplads med gode kolleger.

Løn- og ansættelsesforhold:

Løn og ansættelsesvilkår efter gældende overenskomst. Nuværende mødetid er som udgangspunkt kl. 07.30 alle ugens dage, og timetallet er 37 timer om ugen. Tiltrædelse snarest muligt eller forhåbentligt den. 1. januar 2027.

Ansættelsesprocessen:

Ansøgningsfristen er torsdag den 12. november.Første ansættelsessamtale afholdes mandag den 16. november 2026.Anden ansættelsessamtale afholdes onsdag den 18. november 2026.

Kandidater, der bliver indkaldt til anden samtale, vil blive bedt om at udfylde en personlighedsprofil.

På grund af høj mødeaktivitet i slutningen af november i direktørens kalender er ansættelsesprocessen kort. Vi håber ikke, at den korte frist vil afholde dig fra at søge stillingen. 

Der vil efter aftale blive indhentet referencer på den kandidat, vi ønsker at tilbyde jobbet. 

Spørgsmål vedrørende stillingen rettes til direktør for Voksenområdet Louise Berg på 21837636. Send gerne en SMS forud, så bliver du ringet op.

jobs.title: Permanent nursing positions in Jondal, Norway
jobs.description: On behalf of Ullensvang Municipality, we are recruiting nurses for permanent positions in municipal healthcare services in Jondal, Western Norway.You will work across both nursing home and home care services, giving you the opportunity to use a broad range of your nursing skills. You will follow patients over time, make independent clinical assessments and work closely with colleagues and other healthcare professionals.Jondal is a small community in the Hardanger region on Norway’s west coast, around 1 hour and 45 minutes from Bergen by car and ferry. Here, you will live by the Hardangerfjord, surrounded by mountains, with Folgefonna, one of Norway’s largest glaciers, just 19 kilometres away.Moving to another country is a big step, and we will support you throughout the process. Dignus Medical provides free Norwegian language training, assistance with Norwegian authorisation and practical support with relocation and settling into your new community.About the positionAs a nurse in Jondal, you will work with patients with different healthcare and care needs, both in a nursing home and in their own homes.The role gives you a high degree of professional responsibility and the opportunity to follow patients over time, while working closely with colleagues and other healthcare professionals.Your responsibilities will include:    Providing nursing care and following up patients    Clinical observation, assessment and documentation    Medication management and treatment    Providing care to patients in nursing homes and in their own homes    Making independent clinical assessments    Working closely with colleagues and other healthcare professionals    Communicating with relatives and other parts of the healthcare serviceWho are we looking for?We are looking for qualified nurses who are confident in their professional role, comfortable working independently and motivated to build a new life and career in Norway.You:    Hold a valid nursing licence from an EU/EEA country    Hold citizenship from an EU/EEA country    Speak English fluently and are highly motivated to learn Norwegian    Are willing to complete our free Norwegian language programme before starting work    Hold a valid driving licence    Work well both independently and as part of a team    Preferably have experience from community healthcare, nursing homes or home care servicesWe help you prepare for working in NorwayYou do not need to speak Norwegian when you apply. If you are selected for the position, Dignus Medical will guide you through the entire process of preparing for your move to Norway.We provide:    Free online Norwegian language training with a private teacher    Language training up to the required B2 level, including Norwegian for healthcare professionals    Assistance with your application for Norwegian nursing authorisation    Guidance with the documentation and administrative processes required before starting work    Help with finding accommodation and practical aspects of relocating to Norway    Personal follow-up before, during and after your moveThe language training and authorisation process take place before you start working, so you have time to prepare both professionally and practically for your new life in Norway.What you can expect in Jondal    A permanent position in the Norwegian municipal healthcare system    Varied work across nursing home and home care services    The opportunity to use a broad range of your nursing skills    Independent professional responsibility    Close cooperation with colleagues and other healthcare professionals    The opportunity to follow patients over time    Support with housing, relocation and practical arrangementsLife between the fjord, mountains and glacierJondal is located in Hardanger on Norway’s west coast, around 1 hour and 45 minutes from Bergen by car and ferry. It is a small community of around 400 people, situated directly by the Hardangerfjord and surrounded by mountains. Folgefonna, one of Norway’s largest glaciers, is only 19 kilometres away.Nature is part of everyday life here. After work, you can hike in the mountains, kayak or fish on the fjord, or simply enjoy the quiet surroundings. In winter, the area offers excellent opportunities for skiing and other outdoor activities.Despite its small size, Jondal has the essentials you need for everyday life, including a grocery store, places to eat and local cultural and leisure activities. If you are moving with your family, Jondal has both a kindergarten and a school for children from primary through lower secondary level, as well as a library, swimming pool and sports facilities. Odda is around 40 minutes away by car, while Bergen offers a larger city environment and an international airport.Interested in starting a new chapter in Norway?Feel free to get in touch for further information, or send us your application.

jobs.title: Qualified Cosmetician
jobs.description:
Full-Time Position | Copenhagen, Denmark

Employer: BBA Copenhagen – The Beauty Atelier

Workplace: Store Kongensgade 96, Copenhagen, Denmark

Employment type: Full-time, permanent

Working hours: 37 hours per week

Gross monthly salary: DKK 37,200

Start date: By agreement

Application deadline: 1st of January

About Us

BBA Copenhagen – The Beauty Atelier is a professional beauty salon located in Copenhagen, Denmark. We offer a wide range of beauty, skincare and personal care treatments, focusing on quality, professionalism and excellent customer service.

We are seeking a qualified and experienced Cosmetician / Beauty Therapist to join our team on a full-time basis.

The ideal candidate is passionate about the beauty industry, has practical experience in professional beauty treatments and is committed to providing high-quality services in a welcoming salon environment.

Key Responsibilities

- Perform professional facial and skincare treatments, including skin analysis and consultations.

- Provide waxing, threading and eyebrow-shaping services.

- Perform eyelash lifting, eyebrow lamination, tinting and other brow and lash treatments.

- Carry out manicures and pedicures according to professional qualifications.

- Assess clients' skincare needs and recommend suitable treatments and products.

- Provide professional consultations and appropriate aftercare advice.

- Maintain high standards of hygiene, sanitation and client safety.

- Prepare and maintain treatment rooms, equipment and beauty products.

- Manage client appointments, bookings and treatment records.

- Assist with inventory management and daily salon operations.

- Deliver excellent customer service and maintain positive client relationships.

- Work independently and collaborate effectively with other team members.

Qualifications and Experience

We are looking for candidates who have:

- A relevant diploma, certificate or professional qualification in cosmetology, beauty therapy or a related field.

- Practical experience working as a cosmetician, beautician or beauty therapist in a professional salon environment.

- Knowledge and practical skills in facial treatments, waxing, threading, eyebrow and eyelash treatments.

- Understanding of skincare products, treatment procedures and professional hygiene standards.

- Good communication and customer service skills.

- Strong organisational skills and attention to detail.

- The ability to work independently and as part of a team.

- A professional, reliable and client-focused approach.

What We Offer

- A permanent, full-time position of 37 hours per week.

- A gross monthly salary of DKK 37,200.

- A professional, friendly and supportive working environment.

- Opportunities for professional development and further training.

- A varied role involving skincare, beauty treatments and client consultations.

- Employment conditions in accordance with applicable Danish employment standards.

- Other bonuses.

Employment Conditions

The successful candidate will receive a written employment contract specifying salary, working hours, holiday entitlement, notice period and other applicable employment conditions.

The position is based at our salon in Copenhagen and requires physical attendance at the workplace.

How to Apply

Interested candidates are invited to submit:

- An updated CV.

- Copies of relevant professional qualifications or certificates.

- A short application describing their professional experience and suitability for the position.

Application email: info@bba-cph.com

Applications will be assessed based on relevant qualifications, professional experience and suitability for the position.

We welcome applications from all suitably qualified candidates.

jobs.title: Vi søger en sygeplejerske eller social- og sundhedsassistent (SSA) til Enfamilie ApS
jobs.description:
Vi søger en sygeplejerske eller social- og sundhedsassistent (SSA) til Enfamilie ApS

Brænder du for høj sundhedsfaglig kvalitet, medicinsikkerhed og arbejdet med mennesker, der har brug for særlig støtte og omsorg?

Hos Enfamilie ApS søger vi en engageret og fagligt stærk sygeplejerske eller social- og sundhedsassistent, som har lyst til at blive en del af vores team.

Stillingen indebærer skiftende vagter med arbejde hver anden weekend.

Tiltrædelse: 1. januar 2027 eller gerne før.

Om stillingen

Vi søger en medarbejder, der kan være med til at sikre en høj sundhedsfaglig standard i vores daglige arbejde.

Du får en central rolle i arbejdet med medicinhåndtering, sundhedsfaglig dokumentation og implementering samt efterlevelse af sundhedsfaglige instrukser.

Vi lægger stor vægt på, at vores sundhedsfaglige arbejde udføres systematisk, ansvarligt og i overensstemmelse med gældende lovgivning og retningslinjer fra Styrelsen for Patientsikkerhed.

Dine primære arbejdsopgaver

  • Sikker og korrekt medicinhåndtering, herunder dispensering, administration, opbevaring og dokumentation.

  • Sikre efterlevelse af gældende sundhedsfaglige instrukser og procedurer.

  • Medvirke til udarbejdelse, implementering og løbende opdatering af lokale sundhedsfaglige instrukser.

  • Arbejde med sundhedsfaglig dokumentation og journalføring i henhold til gældende regler.

  • Bidrage til forebyggelse af medicineringsfejl og håndtering af utilsigtede hændelser.

  • Understøtte kolleger i korrekt udførelse af delegerede sundhedsfaglige opgaver.

  • Samarbejde med læger, øvrige sundhedsfaglige samarbejdspartnere og kolleger.

  • Deltage aktivt i den daglige omsorg, støtte og pleje.

Vi forventer, at du

  • Er uddannet sygeplejerske eller social- og sundhedsassistent med dansk autorisation.

  • Har et solidt kendskab til medicinhåndtering og sundhedsfaglig dokumentation.

  • Har forståelse for gældende sundhedsfaglige krav, instrukser og patientsikkerhed.

  • Arbejder selvstændigt, struktureret og ansvarsbevidst.

  • Kan bevare overblikket og træffe fagligt velbegrundede beslutninger.

  • Har gode samarbejdsevner og bidrager positivt til et tværfagligt arbejdsmiljø.

  • Er fleksibel og indstillet på skiftende vagter samt arbejde hver anden weekend.

Vi tilbyder

  • En arbejdsplads, hvor faglighed, omsorg og kvalitet går hånd i hånd.

  • Mulighed for at få indflydelse på udviklingen af vores sundhedsfaglige praksis.

  • Et tæt samarbejde med engagerede kolleger.

  • En hverdag med både ansvar, variation og meningsfulde opgaver.

  • Mulighed for faglig sparring og udvikling.

Ansættelsesvilkår:

Arbejdstid: Skiftende vagter med arbejde hver anden weekend.

Tiltrædelse: 1. januar 2027 eller efter aftale, gerne tidligere.

Arbejdssted: Enfamilie ApS.

Løn og ansættelsesvilkår: Efter aftale og kvalifikationer.

Vil du være en del af Enfamilie ApS?

Vi søger en kollega, der har hjertet på rette sted, og som samtidig brænder for at sikre høj sundhedsfaglig kvalitet og patientsikkerhed.

Send din ansøgning og dit CV til: info@enfamilie.dk

Har du spørgsmål til stillingen? Kontakt Majbritt Jensen direktør, telefonnummer 22 85 98 33

Vi glæder os til at høre fra dig!

jobs.title: PhD Candidate in Machine Learning Approaches to Conservation Condition Needs of Historic Buildings
jobs.description:
This is NTNU

NTNU is a broad-based university with a technical-scientific profile and a focus in professional education. The university is located in three cities with headquarters in Trondheim.

At NTNU, 9,000 employees and 43,000 students work to create knowledge for a better world.

You will find more information about working at NTNU and the application process here.

   

Video: https://youtu.be/Xt-yHCN5QS0About the position

For a position as a PhD Candidate, the goal is a completed doctoral education up to an obtained doctoral degree.

We are looking for a PhD candidate for one of 13 PhD positions in Marie Sklodowska-Curie Action (MSCA) CHARM (Conservation of Heritage Architecture, buildings and sites by Resilient Methods: hydro-climate factors) project. The main objective of CHARM MSCA Doctoral Network project is to develop new sustainable conservation and restoration solutions, adapted to the current and future climate conditions, designed in a circular economy philosophy, having a low environmental footprint and high handprint. CHARM also responds to socio-economical requirements of wellbeing and proposes conservation/restoration solutions economically acceptable and respecting the cultural value of buildings.

CHARM proposes a holistic approach including:

  • Site observation and data collection
  • Data preparation to be used by AI, models, etc
  • Methods for understanding and modelling past and future degradation of architectural heritage
  • Sustainable conservation solutions to several observed problems
  • Assessment of the impact of architectural conservation on the environment and of the environment (past, present and future) on architectural heritage
  • Bidirectional interactions with society proposing risk management plans but also taking into account the society wills and needs

The vision of CHARM MSCA project is to educate young and talented scientists towards a combined high-level experimental and data driven approach for the early-stage accurate, precise detection of hydro-climate impact on cultural heritage, to answer to recruitment needs in time of climate change and natural hazards impact about research and innovation in the sector of cultural heritage conservation and restoration. 

CHARM network gathers excellent academic centers that have decennial experience in the field of risk assessment, adaptation and mitigation solutions to the climate change impact, conservation of cultural heritage and restoration, documented by scientific papers published in high impact-factor journals, and by previous EU funded research projects. CHARM puts together researchers from universities and research organisms, national and local organizations in charge of Cultural Heritage conservation, Small and Midsize Enterprises, industrial producer of building materials, and Non-Governmental Organization, from 9 European and 1 South American countries.

Description of DC2 PhD position

Project title: Understanding conservation condition and rehabilitation needs at district scale in time of energy saving and climate change via machine learning driven method

Topic in brief:

The aim is to implement an approach based on artificial intelligence (AI) in the form of CNN to automatically detect cracks and morphological indices in order to manage the large amount of data obtained from photogrammetry and earth observations images.

Objectives:

This doctoral project aims to develop deep learning neural networks to investigate data in available database (e.g., EU building stock observatory and other similar database) to:

  1. classify building stock at district scale more prone to decay based on buildings construction year, location, main constitutive material, exposure, use and
  2. to predict potential maintenance and restoration priority based on (i) and existing energy retrofit directive and/or risk maps 

Expected results:

(i)to build high-quality dataset highlighting the façade that is more prone to decay at district/city level from existing raw database; 

(ii) to apply deep learning neural networks (e.g., convolutional neural network) to perform semi-automatic decay pattern segmentation and associated mapping; 

(iii) to correlate the maintenance of buildings at district/city level with decay patterns/features at district scale to prioritize large scale intervention; and 

(iv) to optimize the maintenance activities by leveraging these correlations learned by machine-learning based approaches. 

Supervisory Committee:

  • Main supervisor: Full prof. Chiara Bertolin, Norwegian University of Science and Technology (NTNU), Department of Mechanical and Industrial Engineering (MTP) (Academic)
  • Co-supervisor: Associate prof. Chao Gao, Norwegian University of Science and Technology (NTNU), Department of Mechanical and Industrial Engineering (MTP) (Academic)
  • Mentor: Dr. Marie Louise Anker, Department Director at Nidaros Cathedral Restoration Works. (Non.Academic)

 

Planned secondments

SECONDMENT 1 - Prof. P. Fafalios (FORTH Foundation for Research and Technology – Hellas, Crete) M12, duration: 4 weeks, AI and ML algorithms,

SECONDMENT 2 - Prof. Carradò (CY Cergy Paris University) Karima El Ganaoui, ESTI Pau CY Tech, M24, duration: 4 weeks, AI materials

Duties of the position
  • Take part in the mandatory PhD research education programme
  • Develop a quantitative deep-learning-based framework to detect the micro-cracks and validate the developed framework
  • Define micro-scale indices to evaluate crack morphological characteristics and validate developed the indices
  • Classify the micro-morphologies and damages of undamage and damage materials and/or hazard prone or not buildings and landscape
  • Participate in other relevant research and dissemination activities through our international collaborators
  • Conduct and publish high-level research at peer-reviewed journals and international conferences
  • Carry on condition monitoring campaigns and surveys in situ
  • Write and defend a PhD thesis

Be prepared for changes to your work duties after employment.

Required selection criteria
  • You must have a relevant Master's degree in Computer Science, Physics, Mathematics, Statistics, Materials Engineering, Mechanical Engineering, Computer Engineering or equivalent. Your course of study must correspond to a five-year Norwegian course, where 120 credits have been obtained at master's level. Master students can apply, but the master's degree must be obtained and documented before starting the position.
  • You must have a strong academic background from your previous studies and have an average grade from your Master's degree study, or equivalent education, which is equal to B or better compared to NTNU's grading scale. If you do not have letter grades from previous studies, you must have an equally good academic foundation. If you have a weaker grade background, you maybe considered if you can document that you are particularly suitable for a PhD education.
  • You must meet the requirements for admission to the faculty's Doctoral Programme
  • Excellent written and oral English
  • Strong background in applying deep learning neural networks on image segmentation associated with materials and the built environment
  • Excellent programming skills in Python and Matlab

PLEASE NOTE: For detailed information about what the application must contain, see paragraph “About the application”.

The appointment is to be made in accordance with NTNUs guidelines for recruitment positions for general criteria for the position.

Preferred selection criteria
  • Experience in processing-imaging techniques (e.g. 3D Data Processing, point clouds, geospatial Analysis)
  • Knowledge and technical skills of condition monitoring, analytical damage functions and/or analytical methods/models
Personal characteristics

To complete a doctoral degree (PhD), it is important that you are able to: 

  • Strong interest and self-motivated attitude to explore scientific questions
  • Think and work independently
  • Team player with cooperative attitude
  • Good communication skills

Emphasis will be placed on personal qualities.

We offer
  • Opportunity to carry our cutting-edge research in the area of applying machine learning technique to detection, classification and prediction of material degradation and get multidisciplinary and multisectoral training by experts and experienced supervisors from academic world
  • Opportunity to publish your research findings in working team and participate the national and international conferences
  • Opportunity to stay at our academic partners at FORTH Foundation for Research and Technology – Hellas in Crete (Greece), and Cergy Paris University in Paris, France.
  • Opportunity to work in an international team and be part of a network of 13 PhD students
  • An exciting job with an important mission in society
  • Developing tasks in a strong and international professional environment
  • Career guidance and follow-up during the PhD period
  • Open and inclusive working environment with committed colleagues
  • Working capital that can be used to implement the project
  • Mentor programme as a new employee at NTNU
  • Favorable terms as a member of the Norwegian Public Service Pension Fund (SPK)
  • Free Norwegian language training at a basic level (A2)

As a PhD Candidate at NTNU, you will have access to employee benefits.

Diversity

Diversity is a strength, and at NTNU we aim to be an employer that reflects the diversity in society and that makes use of the potential of the population's collective skills. Our vision is Knowledge for a better world and our values ​​are creative, critical, constructive and respectful. We believe that an organization that is equal, diverse and gender-balanced is essential for us to achieve our goals. 

We strive to attract employees with different skills, life experiences and perspectives to contribute to even better problem solving of our societal mission in research and education. 

If you think this position is relevant and interesting, we encourage you to apply, regardless of gender, functional ability and cultural background, or whether you have been out of work for a period of time.

At NTNU we want to increase the proportion of women in scientific positions. We have a number of measures to promote equality.

Salary and conditions

In the position of PhD Candidate, code 1017, your gross salary will normally be NOK 580 000,- per annum depending on qualifications and seniority. A 2% statutory contribution to the State Pension Fund is deducted from the salary. 

The employment period is 3 years.

For employment as a PhD Candidate, it is a prerequisite that you gain admission to the PhD programme in Engineering within three months of your employment contract start date, and that you participate in an organized doctoral programme through out the period of employment.

The position is conditional on external funding from Marie Sklodowska-Curie Action (MSCA) for CHARM project.

As an employee at NTNU, it is important that you keep yourself up to date with academic and organizational changes and adapt to them.

For the necessary professional and social interaction, it is a prerequisite that you are physically present and available to the institution on a daily basis.

The appointment is carried out in accordance with the principles of the State Employees Act, and Export control (legislation that regulates the export of knowledge, technology and services). Candidates who, after assessment of the application and attachments, are considered to bein conflict with the criteria in the latter act, will not be able to be employed.

About the application

The attachments (including a description of your scientific work) must accompany the application as these documents form the basis of the application assessment. The documents must be in English.

Please note: the application will only be assessed on the basis of the information we have received by the application deadline. Therefore, make sure that your application clearly shows how your skills and experience meet the criteria described above. The application and all attachments must be sent electronically via Jobbnorge.no. If you are invited to an interview, you must bring certified copies of certificates and diplomas upon request.

The application must include:

  • Transcripts and diplomas for Bachelor's and Master's degrees
  • CV 
  • Copy of Master's thesis. If you have recently submitted your Master's thesis, you can attach a draft of the thesis. Documentation of a completed Master's degree must be presented before taking up the position.
  • Motivation letter justifying your interest and fit for the position
  • Possibly publications etc. other relevant research work
  • Possibly certificates
  • Names and contact information of three relevant referees

If all, or parts, of your education has been taken abroad, we also ask you to attach documentation of the scope and quality of your entire education, both Bachelor's and Master's education, in addition to other higher education. If your institution uses “diploma supplement” (normal for most European institutions), you must attach this. A description of the documentation required can also be found here. If you already have a statement from Norwegian Directorate for Higher Education and Skills (HK-dir), please attach this as well.

Joint work will be considered. If it is difficult to identify your contribution to joint work, you must attach a brief description of your participation.

When assessing the best qualified, we emphasize necessary qualifications such as education, experience and personal suitability. Motivation for the position, ambitions, and potential for research will also count when assessing the candidates.NTNU recognizes a wide range of academic contributions and has committed itself to The San Francisco Declaration on Research Assessment and CoARA (responsible assessment of research and recognition of a greater breadth of academic contributions in accordance with NTNU's social mission).

General information

A public list of applicants with name, age, job title and municipality of residence is prepared after the application deadline. If you wish to be exempt from entry on the public applicant list, this must be justified. Assessment will be made in accordance with current legislation. You will be notified if the exemption is not granted.

If you think this position looks interesting and in line with your qualifications, you are welcome to apply.

If you have any questions about the position, please contact Professor Chiara Bertolin, e-mail: chiara.bertolin@ntnu.no.

If you have any questions about the recruitment process, please contact HR Senior Consultant Hedda Winnberg, e-mail: hedda.winnberg@ntnu.no.

Application deadline: 26.11.2026

-----------------

For practical information about working at NTNU, please visit this webpage. 

The city of Trondheim is a modern European city with a rich cultural scene. Trondheim is the tech capital of Norway with a population of 200,000. The Norwegian welfare state, including healthcare, schools, kindergartens and overall equality, is probably the best of its kind in the world. Professional subsidized day-care for children is easily available. Furthermore, Trondheim offers great opportunities for education (including international schools) and possibilities to enjoy nature, culture and family life and has low crime rates and clean air quality.

You will take responsibility for your own tasks and work alongside your team to deliver safe, high-quality work.Your responsibilities will include:-Installing and replacing circuit breakers, disconnectors and other substation components-Carrying out cable work and working on earthing systems-Working on switchboards, electrical installations and dismantling tasks-Contributing to the construction, refurbishment and maintenance of high voltage installations-Carrying out quality assurance and maintaining documentationOver time, you will also share your knowledge by helping apprentices and new colleagues get to grips with their tasks.You bring solid high voltage experience and take responsibilityYou are a qualified electrician or have an equivalent electrical qualification, with at least three years of hands-on experience in high voltage work. You are familiar with the tasks described and comfortable working independently. You take initiative, recognise what needs doing and understand that safety is integral to every task.We are looking for someone who:-Works independently and takes a structured approach-Takes responsibility for the safety and quality of their work-Is proactive, well-presented and works well with others-Is physically fit and comfortable with hands-on work outdoors and at height-Holds a category B driving licence and can provide a criminal record certificateYou must be able to communicate clearly in English and have a valid work permit for Denmark.A company vehicle to take home and no on-call dutiesAt Bravida, you will join a team of skilled, dedicated technicians who take pride in their work.You will work daytime hours with no on-call duties, normally five days a week.
