jobs.title: Capacitaire / Référent du projet animalier (H/F)
jobs.description: Le Parc Animalier de Sainte-Croix entre dans une nouvelle étape de son histoire. Après 45 ans d'engagement pour le vivant, le parc a souhaité restructurer en profondeur son pôle animalier afin d'en faire un modèle de transmission, de conservation et de bien-être animal, fruit d'une nouvelle d'organisation. Depuis 2 ans nous restructurons le service avec un nouveau cadre managérial de proximité engagé et compétent, des équipes stables et un projet en construction.   Notre ambition est claire : Reconnecter toutes les générations au vivant, dans le respect des animaux et des écosystèmes, pour transformer le regard de nos visiteurs sur la nature. Dans ce cadre, nous recherchons un capacitaire capable d'accompagner cette transformation, non pas uniquement comme garant réglementaire, mais comme référent structurant d'un projet animalier ambitieux. Le projet :Le pôle animalier de Sainte-Croix a engagé un travail de restructuration autour de plusieurs priorités : - Clarifier les rôles et responsabilités de chacun - Renforcer l'autonomie des responsables de secteur et des équipes - Structurer les procédures, les circuits de décision et les validations - Faire monter les équipes en compétence - Développer une culture forte du bien-être animal - Mieux intégrer les projets d'élevage, de conservation et de réintroduction ; - Accompagner l'évolution des infrastructures et des enclos ; - Donner davantage de sens, de cadre et de fluidité au quotidien animalier. Ce travail s'inscrit dans la continuité de l'accompagnement mené avec Brice Lefaux, qui a permis de poser un diagnostic, d'identifier les axes de progrès et d'engager une nouvelle dynamique collective.  La mission :- être le garant du cadre réglementaire, sécuritaire et animalier du parc. - veiller à ce que les décisions prises soient conformes aux obligations liées à la détention et à la présentation au public d'animaux sauvages, tout en permettant à l'organisation de gagner en maturité et en autonomie.    Sous la responsabilité directe de la Direction du parc, vous rejoindrez le pôle animalier, une équipe pluridisciplinaire d'une trentaine de collaborateurs composée de vétérinaires, d'un chef de service, de managers de proximité et de soigneurs animaliers. Le poste ne comporte pas de missions de gestion administrative ni d'encadrement d'équipe.  Votre rôle est de poser le cadre, sécuriser les décisions importantes, transmettre votre expertise dans des réflexions collectives et accompagner la montée en compétence et responsabilité des équipes. Et notamment : - Faire partie du comité de direction avec votre expertise et un bon niveau d'autonomie. - Participer à la conception du Master Plan. Nous recherchons une personne capable de conjuguer exigence réglementaire, expertise zoologique et intelligence collective. Vous devrez accompagner Sainte-Croix dans la nouvelle étape du pôle animalier : être une équipe exemplaire, structurée, responsable et pleinement alignée avec la raison d'être du parc. Vous devrez également :- être titulaire du Certificat de capacité adapté aux espèces concernées. - justifier d'une solide expérience en parc zoologique. - posséder un bon niveau d'autonomie. - Très bonne connaissance du bien-être animal, de la sécurité et des obligations réglementaires. - Capacité à travailler de manière transverse avec une direction, une responsable zoologique, des responsables de secteur et des équipes terrain. - Goût pour la transmission, la structuration et l'accompagnement du changement. - Capacité à déléguer et à faire grandir les équipes. - Sensibilité forte aux enjeux de conservation, d'éducation et de reconnexion au vivant. Vous ne serez pas seulement le garant d'un cadre, vous serez l'un des artisans d'une nouvelle organisation au service des animaux, des équipes et de la mission du parc.

jobs.title: Communications Student Assistant – Partnerships, Advocacy and Communications Team
jobs.description:
About ICARS The International Centre for Antimicrobial Resistance Solutions (ICARS) is an independent international organisation established by the Danish Government to support low- and middle-income countries in developing evidence-based and context-appropriate solutions to antimicrobial resistance (AMR). Working across the One Health spectrum, ICARS collaborates with governments, research institutions and global organisations to bridge research, policy and implementation. About the role We are looking for a Student Assistant to join our Partnerships, Advocacy and Communications Team. This is a great opportunity for a student interested in digital communications, creative media, data management and global health and development. You’ll support our day-to-day activities and help communicate ICARS’ work on AMR in LMICs. We’re looking for someone with strong technical skills who also takes initiative to bring fresh ideas to the team. Alongside delivering assigned tasks, you will be encouraged to suggest improvements and take ownership of agreed activities, with support and feedback from colleagues. Key responsibilities Website management:
  • Maintain and update content on ICARS’ WordPress website, keeping it accurate, accessible and user-friendly.
  • Track website performance using analytics tools and suggest improvements based on the findings.
  • Proactively identify outdated content, gaps and opportunities to better showcase our work.
Graphic design & visual content:
  • Create engaging infographics, social media graphics and report layouts that align with ICARS’ brand.
  • Help develop templates and designs for reports and presentations, bringing fresh ideas for communicating complex information clearly.
  • Video editing & multimedia:
  • Edit videos for ICARS’ social media, presentations and events.
  • Support video production and identify opportunities to turn existing footage into useful, engaging content.
Social media support :
  • Support ICARS’ LinkedIn presence through content creation and community engagement.
  • Keep an eye on relevant conversations, project updates and sector developments, suggesting timely stories and opportunities for ICARS to contribute.
Internal communications support:
  • Maintain our internal SharePoint, including keeping our media library organised and up to date.
  • Support colleagues with designing clear, engaging PowerPoint slides and formatting Word documents.
Press Office and external communications support:
  • Assist with event promotion and Mailchimp newsletter creation.
  • Monitor our communications mailbox, respond to routine enquiries and coordinate with colleagues on requests from stakeholders, including regional and national press.
  • Flag relevant media and communications opportunities for the team to consider.
Data and stakeholder information management:
  • Support the team in entering and maintaining accurate, up-to-date data and contact information in ATLAS, our CRM system.
  • Other tasks related to deliverables of the Partnerships, Advocacy and Communications Team.
Desired profile We are seeking an organised and curious student who enjoys both developing ideas and getting things done in a pro-active and structured manner. You take the initiative to find information, ask useful questions and suggest practical next steps. You can work independently, recognise when to seek guidance and lead tasks through to completion, while keeping colleagues informed. You are comfortable working in a fast-paced environment where priorities can change quickly, and you bring strong digital fluency, technical skills and the ability to pick up new tools with ease. Required qualifications:
  • Currently studying for a Master’s degree in IT, Media Studies, Marketing, Graphic Design or a related field.
  • Proficiency in WordPress and basic website management.
  • Experience using MS Office, particularly Excel, Word and PowerPoint.
  • Experience with graphic design tools, such as Canva or Adobe Creative Suite.
  • Basic video editing skills, using Premiere Pro, Final Cut or similar software.
  • Strong organisational skills, working in a structured manner and with attention to detail.
  • Ability to prioritise and manage multiple tasks.
  • Ability to identify opportunities, propose ideas and take responsibility for delivering agreed tasks.
  • Strong written and verbal communication skills in perfect and fluent English, including the ability to adapt content for different audiences.
Preferred qualifications:
  • Knowledge of Google Analytics, or a willingness to learn.
  • Experience using CRM platforms (Dynamics 365)
  • Skills and interest in drafting technical and scientific communication material.
What we offer
  • Hands-on experience: Contribute to drafting communications material, external stakeholder management and partnerships, developing your skills through practical work and feedback.
  • Impact: Help communicate solutions to one of the world’s most critical global health and development challenges, with space to contribute your own ideas and see them put into practice.
  • Flexible working hours: Our working hours between 8 am and 5 pm with accommodation of your academic schedule.
  • International environment: Work alongside experts and colleagues from diverse backgrounds in a global organisation.
If you enjoy turning ideas into action and want to use your communications skills to support global health, we would love to hear from you! Terms of employment The position as student assistant will be covered by the terms of the collective agreement between The Danish Finance Ministry and the Organisation of Public Employees (OAO-S-Fællesoverenskomsten) and the organizational agreement between The Danish Finance Ministry and the Organisation for Salaried Employees HK/Stat (Organisationsaftale for kontorfunktionærer, laboranter og it-medarbejdere (HK)), according to chapter 6 in the agreement concerning hourly paid employees. The successful candidate is enrolled at graduate level in a Danish University with at around two years of studies remaining. They will predominantly work from the ICARS HQ office, based at the Statens Serum Institut in Copenhagen, Denmark. Application and recruitment process Press “apply for the position” and submit your CV along with a cover letter outlining your suitability for the role and motivation for applying. We would like to receive your application by 20 November 2026 and expect to conduct interviews 24-27 November 2026. For questions about the role, please contact Communications Officer Chloe Modvig-Cole (checo@icars-global.org) and for other questions about the position you may contact Head of Partnerships and Global Relations Theresa Hogenhaug (tcah@icars-global.org). We are committed to cultivating a fair and healthy environment, where everyone can be themselves and thrive. We are happy to discuss flexible working options for all roles. We work to ensure that our recruitment processes are as inclusive as possible to everyone. This includes adjusting for people who have a disability or long-term condition. We look forward to hearing from you!

jobs.title: Demonstratør: Et fleksibelt job, der passer ind i din hverdag
jobs.description:
Demonstratører / Demonstratricer søges til hele landet

Et fleksibelt job, der passer ind i din hverdag

Søger du et meningsfuldt og socialt job, der passer ind i netop din hverdag?

Hos IN-STORE søger vi kollegaer til en spændende stilling som demonstratør. Som demonstratør bliver du vores ansigt udadtil og er med til at skabe gode oplevelser for både kunder og butikker. Du uddeler smagsprøver, fortæller om produkterne og giver kunderne lyst til at prøve noget nyt. Her kommer din livserfaring og evne til at tale med mennesker dig til gode.

Uanset om du er pensionist, der ønsker at supplere din indkomst, selvstændig, der søger et fleksibelt bijob, eller noget helt tredje, kan dette være det perfekte match for dig. Du bliver vores ansigt udadtil og er med til at skabe gode oplevelser for både kunder og butikker. 

Dine opgaver indebærer:

  • Let tilberedning og uddeling af smagsprøver. 

  • Engagerende samtaler og salg af produkterne.

  • Opsætning af en pæn og indbydende stand.

  • Skabe en god relation til de butikker, du besøger.

Vi tilbyder et job, der passer til dig

Vi ved at fleksibilitet og frihed er vigtigt - derfor tilbyder vi: 

  • Frihed til at planlægge: Du bestemmer selv, hvor mange vagter du ønsker om måneden. Vores vagter er 6-8 timer ad gangen og spredt over hele ugen - fredage og lørdage er dog altid vores mest aktive dage. 

  • Social og aktiv arbejdsdag: Du bliver en del af et team af kollegaer, der ligesom dig selv, sætter pris på at holde sig aktiv og social.

  • Udstyr derhjemme: Du opbevarer dit udstyr hjemme og tager det med, når du skal på arbejde.

  • Kørsel i egen bil: Du får skattefri kørselsgodtgørelse efter gældende regler.

 

Hvem er du?

Vi forestiller os, at du er imødekommende, ansvarsfuld og glad for at tale med mennesker. Din livserfaring er en stor fordel, da du er god til at tale med alle slags mennesker og skabe tillid. Erfaring som demonstratør er ikke et krav. Det vigtigste er, at du har lyst til at præsentere produkter og give kunderne en god oplevelse.

Derudover ser vi gerne, at:

  • Du er god til at kommunikere og er god til at formidle et budskab.

  • Du er ansvarsfuld og mødestabil.

  • Du trives med at arbejde selvstændigt.

  • Du er fortrolig med IT (smartphone, e-mail) og har bil til rådighed. 

 

Sådan søger du jobbet:

Send os din ansøgning med CV og et vellignende billede af dig selv via vores hjemmeside www.in-store.dk.

Du er velkommen til at kontakte vores HR Koordinator, Emilie Braagaard, på tlf. 52 18 64 09 eller mail embra@in-store.dk, hvis du har spørgsmål til jobbet.

 

Vi glæder os til at høre fra dig!

jobs.title: Credit Union Member Service Officer (MSO)

jobs.title: Swedish speaking telesales agent (insurance sales)
jobs.description:
Do you like to challenge yourself and are you comfortable with some healthy competition?- Then you could be the one we are looking for to join our Sales Representative department at Nordiccom!Nordiccom is a Danish company located in Copenhagen. With offices in both Copenhagen, Malmö and Helsinki, our Swedish team is working hard and would love some new energetic colleagues joining them on their sales team, who’s responsible for selling insurances over the phone. We partner with banks and insurance companies, and we only sell to existing customers of our partners, so there is no cold calling.

We are looking for characteristic people with a flair for working with people over the phone and making sure the customers have a great experience every time.It doesn’t matter if you have knowledge of insurances prior to applying for this job. We will make sure to teach you everything you need to know, to be able to communicate the products.Qualities we highly value from you:

- An energetic personality with a “can do”-attitude, who knows how to smile through the phone

- Confidence and the ability to work as part of a team

- Good communication skills and the ability to connect with all kinds of different people

- A competitive and result-oriented mindset

- Fluent in Swedish (English language skills are also an advantage)

- Experience with telemarketing

It is important to us that our employees deliver the highest quality of service, which is why we provide thorough training, ensuring that you are ready to meet any challenges and deliver good results while feeling comfortable in your new role.

 

What you can expect from us:

- Guaranteed wage combined with attractive bonus & commission agreements and prizes

- A social working place in a comfortable & productive environment

- A multinational working environment with an informal tone and high job satisfaction

- Helpful and motivated colleagues

- Advantageous working hours and traffic connections near Copenhagen city

Who are we and what do we do?

Nordiccom ApS is a growing Nordic company located in the heart of Copenhagen and Helsinki. The companies we represent are major banking and insurance companies in Europe. With the entire Northern Europe market as our workplace, and the phone as our tool, we provide solutions for sales and customer service for a wide range of companies in the financial business. Therefore, we comply with the banks’ standards and code of conduct, so quality is ensured. In Nordiccom you will meet both Danes, Norwegians, Finns and Swedes. Nordiccom consists of about 150 employees divided into different teams. In Nordiccom, we emphasize professionalism, and it is important that we thrive when we are at work. Our goal is that we shape our employees for success. That they become skilled at their work and achieve good results. All training is practiced in your own language.

jobs.title: Substitute Housekeeper for Serviced-living Apartments
jobs.description:
***Must have the right to work in Denmark!***

Are you detail-oriented? Do you have a service mindset? And do you want to make a difference for our members? Maybe you are the one we are looking for in our team!

LifeX is seeking one or more substitute cleaning assistants/housekeepers for our Operations Team. This person will be responsible for the daily cleaning tasks of our co-living apartments in Copenhagen. This means taking replacement shifts when other housekeepers are sick, on vacation, and also during busy periods for us. There might be a possibility of fixed hours later on if performance is high quality.

LifeX is a service-living property manager offering fully-furnished, cleaned, and maintained apartments with the aim of making internationals feel 'at home anywhere in the world'. We operate in Denmark, Germany & Norway.

LifeX is for people who relocate because of work, as well as anyone who wants a flexible lifestyle with time to have fun with others as part of an international environment. This is why we want to provide the highest standard of our cleaning services.

Tasks:

  • General apartment cleaning in rooms, common areas, kitchens, and bathrooms, which includes: all surfaces, floors, window sills, desks, corners, laundry areas, and sinks.

  • Deep cleaning in different locations, including tasks such as descaling shower heads, cleaning ovens, electrical appliances, and unclogging drains in bathrooms.

  • Receive orders from online retailers and be present during technician visits.

  • Check out cleanings making sure that the room is spotless for the next person moving in, and checking for any damages or missing items.

  • General communication with the operations team and members.

We offer you:

  • Working hours on weekdays between 8-16.

  • A good working environment in an international team and vibe.

  • A varied job.

  • Salary by qualification.

Application and contact

Applications are received on an ongoing basis and the starting date is as soon as possible. Due to many applications, only applicants who fit the criterias will be called in for an interview. Feel free to contact the Housekeeping Supervisor, Justyna on justyna@joinlifex.com, for more information on the position.

We look forward to hearing from you.

jobs.title: Dygtig freelance mødebooker
jobs.description:
Freelance mødebooker søges til B2B-mødebooking

Har du solid erfaring med mødebooking og kold kanvas – og motiveres du af frihed, ansvar og resultater?

Hjælp til salg søger en dygtig og stabil freelance mødebooker til booking af kvalificerede B2B-møder for vores kunder.

Stillingen er for dig, der allerede ved, hvad der skal til for at komme igennem til den rette beslutningstager, skabe en god dialog og booke et relevant møde.

Arbejdet udføres hjemmefra, og du kan derfor befinde dig hvor som helst i Danmark eller resten af verden.

Om arbejdet

Du kommer til at arbejde med udgående telefonisk mødebooking for forskellige danske B2B-virksomheder.

Opgaverne vil typisk bestå af:

  • Telefonisk kontakt til potentielle erhvervskunder

  • Kold kanvas og dialog med relevante beslutningstagere

  • Præsentation af kundens løsning på en professionel og troværdig måde

  • Booking af kvalificerede møder

  • Løbende opfølgning og registrering af aktiviteter

  • Tæt dialog med Hjælp til salg omkring kvalitet, resultater og kundernes ønsker

Vi leder efter dig, der

  • Har dokumenteret erfaring med B2B-mødebooking, telefonsalg eller kold kanvas

  • Har eget CVR-nummer og arbejder som selvstændig freelancer

  • Er stabil, selvkørende og tager ansvar for dine opgaver

  • Kan arbejde struktureret og følge op på dine leads

  • Er god til at skabe tillid og føre en naturlig samtale

  • Taler og forstår dansk

  • Har en professionel telefonstemme og en god forretningsforståelse

  • Kan håndtere afvisninger uden at miste motivationen

  • Har de nødvendige rammer til at arbejde hjemmefra, herunder en stabil internetforbindelse og rolige omgivelser

Erfaring er et krav

Dette er ikke en oplæringsstilling.

Det er et krav, at du allerede har praktisk erfaring med mødebooking, kold kanvas eller opsøgende B2B-telefonsalg. Har du ikke denne erfaring, er stillingen desværre ikke det rette match.

Vi forventer ikke, at du kender alle vores kunder eller brancher på forhånd. Til gengæld forventer vi, at du kender håndværket, kan sætte dig ind i nye løsninger og hurtigt omsætte et manuskript til en troværdig samtale.

Vi tilbyder

  • Fleksibelt freelancearbejde hjemmefra

  • Mulighed for at arbejde fra hele verden

  • Aflønning pr. godkendt og kvalificeret møde

  • Forskellige B2B-kunder og brancher

  • Grundig introduktion til den enkelte kunde og opgave

  • Sparring, feedback og løbende dialog

  • Mulighed for et længerevarende samarbejde for den rette person

  • Frihed under ansvar og mulighed for selv at strukturere din arbejdsdag

Aflønning

Du aflønnes pr. booket møde, der lever op til den enkelte kundes aftalte kriterier.

Den konkrete pris pr. møde afhænger af opgaven og aftales inden opstart. Som freelancer fakturerer du Hjælp til salg fra dit eget CVR-nummer.

Om Hjælp til salg

Hjælp til salg har siden 2017 hjulpet danske virksomheder med professionel B2B-mødebooking.

Vi har fokus på møder med kvalitet. Derfor handler arbejdet ikke blot om at få en aftale i kalenderen, men om at booke relevante møder med de rette beslutningstagere og skabe et godt grundlag for kundens videre salgsdialog.

Vi lægger stor vægt på kvalitet, ærlighed, stabilitet og et professionelt samarbejde.

Sådan søger du

Send en kort ansøgning, hvor du beskriver:

  • Din erfaring med mødebooking og kold kanvas

  • Hvilke typer virksomheder eller brancher du tidligere har arbejdet med

  • Hvilke resultater du tidligere har skabt

  • Hvor mange timer du forventer at kunne arbejde om ugen

  • Hvornår du kan starte

  • Bekræftelse på, at du har eget CVR-nummer

Vedlæg gerne dit CV eller et link til din LinkedIn-profil.

Vi kontakter kun ansøgere, der har relevant erfaring og matcher kravene til stillingen.

Vi glæder os til at høre fra dig.

Hjælp til salgMøder med kvalitethjaelptilsalg.dk

jobs.title: Lead Game Programmer
jobs.description: Do you love designing clean game architecture, building multiplayer systems that run smoothly, and helping a team of programmers make the right technical decisions? Great! Let's talk.Triband is the award-winning studio behind the WHAT THE? comedy game series, played by millions worldwide. From our home in central Copenhagen, more than 60 wonderful humans are united by a simple mission: to make everyone laugh.We're building something unannounced, exciting, thoroughly goofy, and built to be played together online. We're now looking for a Lead Game Programmer to help building the underlying systems that make it all work, from the core architecture to the multiplayer tech that connects our players. You'll stay hands-on in the code and the Unity editor while helping the programming team make good technical decisions, stay aligned, and build systems that support creative experimentation. And just to be very clear: this is a technical leadership role, not a people-management position.Here's what that looks like day to dayIn collaboration with game designers, artists, and other programmers, you'll build new features and systems and continuously iterate on improvements. We all work in Unity with C#, with every team member hands-on in the editorYou'll set and communicate the project's technical direction, turning creative goals and production needs into clear technical prioritiesYou'll help the programming team make architectural decisions, align around shared patterns, and navigate trade-offs between long-term code health and short-term needsYou'll review and improve technical solutions, share best practices, and support other programmers without becoming a gatekeeper or bottleneckYou'll proactively identify technical risks, messy systems, and missing foundations, and take responsibility for addressing them at the right timeOverall, you'll make sure the project is technically healthy and maintain the codebase in a way that makes it easy for others to build onThis includes things like...Designing an architecture that allows for easy gameplay implementation and flexibilityImplementing and maintaining online features such as matchmaking, invites and friendsProfiling and improving network performance, bandwidth and latency, and making sure the game holds up on real-world connectionsBreaking down complex technical challenges, helping decide what to prioritise, and ensuring important decisions are understood by the people they affectStaying close to the actual game: writing production code, debugging difficult problems, and improving systems as the project evolvesYou're a great match ifYou have at least ten years of professional game development experience across multiple shipped games and different stages of development, including significant technical ownership or leadership on a projectYou have experience setting technical direction and helping a programming team make and implement architectural decisions, with strong judgment in balancing flexibility, maintainability, performance and the needs of a creative productionYou're highly proficient in C# and have deep knowledge of the Unity engine and editorYou've shipped at least one online multiplayer game, had real ownership of its networking/online systems, and have hands-on experience with a Unity multiplayer framework (e.g., Coherence)You communicate clearly and can explain technical decisions and trade-offs to programmers and non-programmers alikeNice to havesYou have experience shipping iOS and macOS apps, including hands-on integration of Apple platform services such as GameKit and the Game Controller framework using Xcode and SwiftExperience with backend services, dedicated servers or cloud hosting for online gamesInterest in multiplayer game design and social featuresExperience working with automated build pipelines such as JenkinsExperience building systemic or open-world gamesWhat always matters to us at TribandYou thrive in taking ownership of your area: you spot problems, seek advice when needed, and implement creative solutions that push projects forwardYou're motivated by collaboration, mutual respect, inclusiveness and creativity while actively contributing to sustaining that cultureYou believe games are made by teams, not rockstars and that great ideas can come from anyoneYou bring curiosity, generosity, and flexibility, along with strong opinions, especially when they come with reasoning, openness, and a willingness to actually test themYou love exploration and experimentation but don't get too precious when the evidence tells you you're wrongYou value a positive work environment and contribute to keeping the studio a fun and supportive place to bePracticalitiesWe work on-site at our cozy office in central Copenhagen.For this role we also consider people located outside of Denmark and provide financial (and moral!) support with visa application and relocation.We work a 37-hour work week, with core hours 10-15, and the freedom to start and finish anywhere between 7 and 18.Our working language is English.We offerSilly but ambitious projects, and the chance to work on and impact great games that reach millions of players.A playful and ambitious work environment where experimentation is encouraged.Friendly and kind colleagues who love making each other laugh as much as making games.A professional development budget to invest in your growth.Social activities like Friday bars, hobby nights, board game nights, team events, you name it.Daily lunch at a local restaurant just a walk across the lakes away, with plant-based options (and soft ice on Thursdays).Six weeks of vacation (five standard plus one extra on us).Paid parental leave at full salary for the periods covered by state reimbursement.Child's first sick day on us, no questions asked.Pension plan and private health insurance.Endless amounts of Faxe Kondi.

jobs.title: Experienced painters needed, Bergen
jobs.description:
Skilled Painters - Bergen

Skuteviken Personell AS is seeking skilled and independent painters for projects in Bergen and the surrounding area.

As a painter, you will work with both interior and exterior painting on renovation and new-build projects. Typical tasks include surface preparation such as filling, sanding, and smoothing of walls and ceilings, application of paint using roller, brush, and preferably spray equipment, as well as finishing work with a strong focus on quality and precision.

We are looking for painters who take pride in high-quality workmanship and can work efficiently both independently and as part of a team.

We offer:

  • Competitive salary: NOK 270 -290 per hour (depending on experience)

  • Permanent employment

  • Exciting and varied work tasks (both interior and exterior)

  • Free professional tools and work clothes

  • Housing in company apartments if needed

  • Supportive and service-oriented administration

Requirements:

  • Minimum 3 years' professional painting experience

  • Strong skills in both exterior and interior paintwork

  • Knowledge of Norwegian painting methods, especially interior groundwork and plastering

  • Ability to follow and understand technical instructions and building methods

  • Scandinavian or English language skills (professional competence is most important)

Personal qualities:

  • High work ethic

  • Reliable and punctual

  • Structured and able to plan the workday effectively

Interested?

Please send your CV and application as soon as possible. Applications are reviewed on an ongoing basis.

Om arbeidsgiveren:

Skuteviken Personell AS was established in 2008 and is one of the leading staffing and recruitment agencies on the west coast of Norway, Bergen. With solid experience from the construction industry, quality expertise and personalization, we solve our customers and employees' needs in a professional manner so that they choose us over and over again.

jobs.title: Customer Service Specialist, Efla – Porvoo
jobs.description: About the roleEfla Oy, part of the Ensto Group, is an international company based in Porvoo and specialized in airfield lighting solutions. The companys business has grown strongly in recent years, and we are now looking for a Customer Service Specialist to support Eflas increasing order volume, international customers and the smooth handling of orders from start to finish.In this role, you will not be working in traditional inbound or outbound customer service. Instead, you will be responsible especially for order handling, order deliveries, export documentation, invoicing and shipping documents. You will work in an important role between customers, sales, production, logistics and the internal customer service team.The role is well suited for someone with a background in business, logistics, international business or a similar field, who has strong English skills, good ability to work under pressure and a desire to develop in an international order delivery environment. Previous experience in order handling, customer service, export, logistics or ERP systems is considered an advantage, but the most important things are the right attitude, willingness to learn and the ability to take initiative.What we offerEfla offers you the opportunity to become part of an international, growing and hands-on company where you get to see the full order delivery chain as a whole.In this role, you will have the opportunity to develop your skills in areas such as:- international customer service- order handling and order management- export documentation and shipping documents- invoicing and the use of ERP systems- cooperation between production, logistics and sales- working with global customers and different culturesThis is a great opportunity for someone who wants to grow into specialist roles in customer service, supply chain, export, sales support or international business.Work tasksAs a Customer Service Specialist, you will be responsible for the smooth processing of customer orders and the progress of deliveries. In practice, your work begins once sales has agreed on the order with the customer. After that, you ensure that the order proceeds correctly in the systems, production, delivery and documentation.The role includes a lot of email communication with international customers, as well as internal communication with sales, production and logistics partners. Since the customers are international and the orders can vary significantly, the role requires a strong ability to understand the bigger picture, use common sense and solve situations case by case.- processing and managing customer orders from start to finish- monitoring and coordinating order deliveries- communicating with international customers, mainly by email- cooperating with the sales team, production, logistics and customer service team- preparing export documentation and shipping documents- handling invoicing-related tasks- using the ERP system and other internal systems- resolving questions related to deliveries, schedules and customer cases- solving different customer cases and order-related issuesWe are looking for you who hasWe are looking for a person who is interested in international customer service, order handling and supply chain coordination. You may be a recent graduate or at the beginning of your career, or you may already have previous experience in similar tasks.We hope you have:- fluent English skills, as customer communication is mainly in English- readiness to work mainly from the office in Porvoo- previous work experience in customer service, order handling, sales support, logistics, export, invoicing or supply chain-related tasks- ability to understand broader processes and move things forward in a structured way- a proactive and flexible working style- good problem-solving skills and practical thinking- ability to work in a busy and changing environment- good cooperation and communication skillsConsidered an advantage- Finnish language skills, as communication with production and local stakeholders may also take place in Finnish- experience with ERP systems- studies in business, logistics, international business or another relevant fieldTo succeed in this role, you are- proactive and hands-on- accurate and systematic- flexible and able to handle pressure- cooperative and open- curious and willing to learn- ready to ask questions, investigate and get things done- interested in an international working environmentYou do not need to know everything in advance. What matters more is that you want to learn, are willing to take initiative and can work in situations where all answers cannot be found from ready-made templates.Practical informationLocation: PorvooWorking hours: Full-timeEmployment type: Permanent employment through Academic WorkStart: As soon as possibleRemote work: Limited possibility for remote work after the onboarding period. The role requires a high level of presence at the Porvoo office, especially due to onboarding and close teamwork.We will proceed with suitable applicants as soon as they apply, so please submit your application as soon as possible.Our recruitment processThis recruitment process is handled by Academic Work and it is our clients wish that all questions regarding the position is directed to Academic Work.Our selection process is continuous and the advert may close before the recruitment process is completed if we have moved forward to the next phase. The process includes two tests: one personality test and one cognitive test. The tests are tools to find the right talent for the right position, to enable equality, diversity, and a fair process.

jobs.title: Early Childhood Education Teacher (recruitment from abroad, permanent position in public sector daycare))
jobs.description: Hello, Early Childhood Education Teachers! Are you interested in working in a public daycare in Finland, known for its high-quality education system? We offer a permanent full-time position, competitive salary, great employee benefits, free Finnish language training, apartment, relocation support, and a clear pathway to living and working in Finland. Whether you are an experienced Early Childhood Education Teacher or newly qualified, we at the City of Helsinki would be delighted to hear from you!In Finland, ECE teachers are highly trusted professionals. You have significant autonomy in planning pedagogical activities and are encouraged to use your professional expertise in everyday work. You support the holistic development of children aged 0-6 in an inclusive, child-centred environment. You work in a multi-professional team, sharing responsibility for childrens wellbeing and learning.In Finland, ECE is part of the national education system and follows the Educare model, integrating care, education and teaching (read more from the Finnish National Agency for Education: https://www.oph.fi/en/education-system/early-childhood-education-and-care-finland). In practice, this means that: Every moment is pedagogical Play is the foundation of learning Learning happens throughout the whole day Nature and outdoor environments are used yearround Childrens interests and questions guide learningYour core responsibilities: Plan, implement and assess play-based learning activities Lead your groups pedagogical work together with childcare nurses Observe and document childrens learning and development Create and update individual learning plans in collaboration with families Collaborate with colleagues and multidisciplinary professionals Design inspiring learning environments indoors and outdoorsOur daycare units' opening hours range between 6:15-17:30, depending on families needs. As a full-time teacher you work 38.25 hours per week Monday-Friday.We are looking for professionals who connect well with others and are open to learning and professional growth. You value teamwork and recognise that high-quality pedagogy is built together. You will enjoy this role if you want to fully use your pedagogical expertise and appreciate professional trust and autonomy. You are an advocate of play-based learning and see learning opportunities in everyday moments. As a professional you are reflective, curious and resilient.Qualification and other requirements to start the Finnish language course in February 2027: Right to work in Finland, for example, on the basis of EU/EEA citizenship At least Bachelors degree in Early Childhood Education Your qualification gives you the right to work as an Early Childhood Education Teacher for children aged 0-6 years in the country where the degree was obtained. At least level B2 in English language Willingness and ability to commit to learning Finnish language prior to employment contract and relocation. The working language in our daycares is Finnish. During the language course we test your language skill development regularly. Requirements to enter into a permanent employment contract in January 2028: Reaching target level B1 in Finnish language Decision from the Finnish National Agency of Education demonstrating eligibility to work as an ECE teacher in Finland Criminal record extract from the Legal Register Centre Proof that you do not have respiratory tuberculosis We can only enter into a permanent employment contract with you if you meet all the above requirements.We provide comprehensive support to make your relocation to Finland as smooth as possible: Assistance with degree recognition process Remote Finnish language training (10 months, part-time, 4x90min lessons every week + 4-8h/wk independent study, homework and assignments) which you can complete alongside your current employment Pre-departure training also includes practical information about working and living in Finland Support in registrations with Finnish authorities upon arrival (also for relocating family members) Assistance in finding an apartment. As a City of Helsinki employee, you can rent a City-owned apartment and no rental deposit is required.Language training and relocation schedule: Feb'27-Dec'27: Finnish language training remotely. Attendance and active participation is essential. Jan'28: Relocation to Finland and starting work.Salary and benefits: Starting salary: €3,298/mth +3-8% experience-based supplements for 5-10 yrs of relevant experience ePassi benefit: €550/year (sports, culture, wellbeing, commuting) Comprehensive private occupational health care Paid annual leave: 23-28 days + 5 extra days for qualified teachers Holiday bonus pay Watch our teachers who have already relocated share their experiences of pedagogical work, life in Finland, and the support they received in the relocation process: Álvaro and Eva: https://youtu.be/KhcaHeu-xLc Melissa: https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=6eyjJjnxRiY Yaiza: https://youtu.be/4IPA8d0pkI4We warmly welcome you to join a workplace that values your expertise and recognises the potential in both you and the children!Please note:(ENG) If you are already living in Finland and hold a degree in early childhood education obtained abroad, please do not apply through this path. Instead, explore our other employment opportunities at www.helsinkirekry.fi and https://www.hel.fi/en/open-jobs/for-education-professionals or contact us at rekry.kasko@hel.fi.(FIN) Jos asut jo Suomessa ja sinulla on ulkomailla suoritettu varhaiskasvatuksen tutkinto, älä hae tähän polkuun. jobs.title: Experienced forklift driver for cold storage production
jobs.description:
Are you comfortable working at -20°C and have strong forklift skills?

We are currently looking for an experienced and reliable forklift driver to drive the forklift in a cold storage production, handling fresh and frozen poultry products.

You will be working in a storage facility with temperatures around -20°C, and it is important that you are comfortable working in a cold environment throughout your shift. We are looking for someone who thrives in these conditions and understands the importance of maintaining both safety and efficiency while working in cold temperatures.

The warehouse has narrow aisles and limited operating space, making forklift experience essential. Precision, awareness, and safe operation are critical to success in this role.

Your Responsibilities

  • Receiving fresh poultry products from production

  • Transporting fresh products into the freezer for freezing

  • Moving frozen products throughout the warehouse using a forklift

  • Preparing products for shipment and distribution

  • Handling shipping documents, labels, and product identification

  • Ensuring correct traceability and documentation

  • Maintaining order and cleanliness throughout the freezer warehouse

  • Assisting with daily warehouse and logistics operations

  • Following all food safety, quality, and safety procedures

We Are Looking For Someone Who

  • Holds a valid forklift certificate/license

  • Has solid forklift driving experience from warehouse, logistics, or production companies.

  • Is comfortable working in temperatures of approximately -20°C

  • Thrives in a cold working environment and can maintain a high level of performance throughout the day

  • Has experience operating forklifts in narrow aisles and confined spaces

  • Understands the importance of safe and accurate forklift operation

  • Works independently and takes responsibility for assigned tasks

  • Is structured, quality-conscious, and reliable

  • Has experience working with shipping documents, labels, and warehouse procedures

  • Takes pride in keeping the warehouse organized and efficient

Working Hours

  • Monday to Thursday: Start at 08:35 AM and work until all scheduled tasks are completed

  • Every 6th & 7th Friday: Start at 08:35 AM

  • 37 hours a week, overtime should be expected.

We Offer

  • A stable full-time position in a growing company

  • Long-term employment opportunities

  • A professional and supportive working environment

  • An important role within the warehouse and logistics operation

  • Salary based on qualifications and experience

  • Immediate start for the right candidate

Location: Horsens, orsensDenmarkStart Date: As soon as possibleEmployment Type: Full-TimeSalary: Based on qualifications and experience

jobs.description:

We are currently looking for reliable and motivated employees to join a well-established fish production company. This is an excellent opportunity to become part of an international workplace where teamwork, quality, and food safety are highly valued.

Your daily tasks may include:

  • Quality control and inspection of products

  • Weighing, packing, and labeling finished products

  • Cleaning and sanitizing production areas and equipment

  • Assisting with various other production-related tasks as needed

Working Hours

Full-time position, 37 hours per week. Overtime may occur during busy periods.

Day Shift: 06:55 - 15:09Morning Shift: 05:55 - 14:09

Please note that there is a 1-hour self-paid break each day.

We are looking for candidates who:

  • Speak and understand English

  • Are physically fit and comfortable performing standing and repetitive work

jobs.title: Servicekoordinator til telte.nu – med ansvar for kvalitet og bemanding
jobs.description:
Kan du skabe overblik, fordele opgaver og sikre, at kvaliteten er i orden? Og trives du med en hverdag, hvor du både koordinerer og selv tager fat? Så er du måske vores nye servicekoordinator hos telte.nu.

Vi søger en struktureret og engageret kollega, der kan tage ansvar for den daglige koordinering i vores serviceafdeling. Du bliver central i at sikre, at medarbejdere, materialer og opgaver hænger sammen, så vi leverer et godt resultat til kunden.

Dine opgaver

Du planlægger dagens arbejde, følger op på opgaverne og hjælper med at få det hele til at fungere i praksis. Dine opgaver omfatter blandt andet:

  • Planlægning og bemanding: Du fordeler medarbejdere og opgaver, så de rette folk er på de rette pladser.

  • Kvalitetskontrol: Du kontrollerer pladser og teltopsætninger og følger op på, at arbejdet lever op til vores standarder.

  • Klargøring og materialer: Du sikrer, at rengøring og kontrol bliver udført grundigt, og at de rigtige materialer bliver leveret.

  • Løbende koordinering: Du tilpasser planen, når behovene ændrer sig, og sørger for, at teamet ved, hvad der skal ske.

  • Praktisk arbejde: Du giver en hånd med på tværs af telte.nu, når der er brug for det.

Hvem er du?

Du sætter en ære i, at udstyret er rent og kontrolleret, at bemandingen er på plads, og at opgaverne bliver fulgt til dørs.

Vi forestiller os, at du:

  • Arbejder struktureret og bevarer overblikket, også når der er travlt.

  • Kommunikerer tydeligt og kan sætte retning for dagens opgaver.

  • Har øje for detaljerne og følger op, når noget skal rettes.

  • Tager ansvar og finder løsninger sammen med dine kolleger.

  • Trives med at kombinere koordinering med praktiske opgaver.

Erfaring med koordinering, drift, logistik eller lignende opgaver er relevant. Vi vil også gerne høre, hvordan du har skabt overblik og sikret kvalitet i andre sammenhænge.

En vigtig rolle i hverdagen

Hos telte.nu får du en rolle tæt på både teamet og den daglige drift. Din indsats har direkte betydning for, at kollegerne kan løse deres opgaver, og at kunderne får en god oplevelse.

Lyder det som noget for dig?

Send os din ansøgning og dit CV, og fortæl, hvorfor du vil være servicekoordinator hos telte.nu. Vi glæder os til at høre fra dig.

jobs.title: Er du den rolige nattevagt, der skaber nærvær og tryghed? Botilbuddet Vedstedvej søger en vågen nattevagt
jobs.description:
Er du den rolige nattevagt, der skaber nærvær og tryghed? Botilbuddet Vedstedvej søger en vågen nattevagtHyldgaard & Larsen Sjælland ApS

Er du den nattevagt, der kan bringe ro, tryghed og nærvær ind i natten? Brænder du for at skabe de bedste betingelser for trivsel, tryghed og udvikling for mennesker med socialpsykiatriske udfordringer?

Vi søger en vågen nattevagt til fastansættelse i 7-7 vagtrul til Botilbuddet Vedstedvej. Botilbuddet Vedstedvej er en del af Hyldgaard & Larsen Sjælland, og er et mindre socialpsykiatrisk botilbud, hvor der bor i alt 4 borgere.

Om stillingen:

Stillingen indebærer en helt særlig rolle, hvor du er med til at skabe ro, tryghed, stabilitet og nærvær for mennesker med socialpsykiatriske udfordringer, når mørket falder på. Borgerne kan til tider have et højt stressniveau, hvor de har behov for at blive rummet og støttet af et roligt nervesystem i en pædagogisk og professionel kontekst.

Du vil indgå i et fast team omkring det pædagogiske arbejde med borgerne. Alle medarbejdere indgår på lige fod i dagligdagen, og er en vigtig del af den faglige indsats, hvorfor samarbejde, sparring og fælles udvikling vægtes højt.

Vi lægger stor vægt på at skabe en god arbejdsplads, hvor alle føler sig velkomne og værdsatte. Vores kultur er præget af medmenneskelighed, samarbejde og engagement. Vi brænder for at arbejde med mennesker og tror på, at vores fælles indsats og samarbejde er nøglen til vores succes.

Hvem er du?

·       Du er uddannet pædagog eller socialrådgiver - eller anden relevant socialfaglig uddannelsesbaggrund på bachelorniveau.

·       Du er rolig, ansvarsbevidst og har hjertet på rette sted.

·       Du evner at være til stede, også i de stille stunder, og du forstår, at natten kan være et tidspunkt, hvor behovene er anderledes, men lige så vigtige.

·       Du ser mennesket bag diagnosen og ved, hvor stor betydning dét at “være der” kan have.

·       Du har kendskab til metoden LA2.

Vi tilbyder:

·       En spændende arbejdsplads med mulighed for personlig og faglig udvikling.

·       Et dedikeret og tværfagligt team, hvor samarbejde og refleksion er i fokus.

·       Fast supervision og personalemøder samt gode muligheder for løbende kompetenceudvikling.

·       Temadage og kurser i vores faglige metoder og tilgange.

Løn og ansættelsesforhold:

Du ansættes i en fast stilling i et 7-7 vagtrul, hvor du arbejder 7 vagter efterfulgt af 7 fridage. Tiltrædelse snarest muligt, og samtaler afholdes løbende. Stillingen lønnes efter kvalifikationer og kompetencer.

Yderligere oplysninger om stillingen kan indhentes ved henvendelse til tilbudsleder Mehrdad Zamani, tlf. 40 40 39 24 og mail mez@h-l.dk.

Vi glæder os til at modtage din ansøgning og CV på mail mez@h-l.dk.

Om Hyldgaard & Larsen Sjælland

Hyldgaard & Larsen Sjælland er en del af Hyldgaard & Larsen, som samarbejder tæt med kommuner om fleksible sociale løsninger for nogle af landets mest udsatte borgere. Vi er specialiserede i vedholdende pædagogiske indsatser til mennesker med komplekse psykiske, adfærdsmæssige, sociale og sundhedsmæssige udfordringer. Vores tilgang bygger på ro, relationer, faglighed og respekt for det enkelte menneskes behov, ressourcer og livssituation.

jobs.description:
Servicemedarbejder med håndværksmæssig baggrund

Hyldgaard & Larsen Sjælland ApS

 

Har du lyst til en varieret arbejdsdag med mange forskellige typer opgaver? Kan du arbejde selvstændigt og tage ansvar for det, du går i gang med? Og trives du i en hverdag, hvor tingene ikke altid er ens, men hvor kvaliteten altid er i orden? Så er det måske dig, vi leder efter.

 

Vi søger en servicemedarbejder med stærke håndværksmæssige kompetencer og en håndværksmæssig baggrund, som har lyst til at blive en del af et mindre team med en uformel tone og et stærkt samarbejde.

Vi forestiller os, at du har en håndværksmæssig baggrund eller relevant erfaring, arbejder selvstændigt og tager ansvar for dine opgaver. Du trives i et mindre team, bidrager til det gode samarbejde og kan begå dig i en hverdag med beboere med forskellige udfordringer. Du møder mennesker med ro og respekt, er fleksibel i din tilgang til opgaverne og har en naturlig sans for kvalitet og ordentlighed i det, du laver. ·       En alsidig hverdag, hvor ikke to dage er ens

·       Firmabil til rådighed i arbejdstiden

·       En grundig introduktion, så du kommer godt fra start

·       Der stilles arbejdsbil med værktøj til rådighed

Du vil primært varetage opgaver i vores afdelinger primært på Vestegnen Sjælland, men du kan også forvente at hjælpe i vores øvrige afdelinger, når der er behov.

jobs.title: Onboarding Enablement Manager, APAC
jobs.description:
WHO WE ARE

Notion is the collaborative AI workspace where teams and agents think together https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=vkpYpWfEK5s. We're building one place where your knowledge, projects, meetings, and AI tools live side by side, so work is faster, clearer, and less fragmented. Millions of individuals, small teams, and large companies run their work on Notion.



Notinos (our employees) are customer zero in bringing this future of work to life. We care about craft, building things that last, and the belief that great work is still fundamentally human. Our goal isn’t to ship the next feature. Each and every team of Notinos is working to set the standard for how humans work together in the AI era. From building a business’s system of record to making and managing AI agents to automating away the busy work, we care deeply about giving our customers more time for their life’s work.




ABOUT THE ROLE

We are looking for a Onboarding Enablement Manager, APAC to play a key role in enhancing our sales productivity in our APAC region. This role will design, deliver, and continuously improve sales onboarding for our new hires. You will work closely with sales leadership, enablement, and product marketing to ensure our field salesforce is equipped with the skills, tools, and knowledge needed to achieve revenue targets and drive customer success.

 


WHAT YOU'LL ACHIEVE

 - Lead APAC Sales & Success onboarding by facilitating Notion’s Sales Bootcamp for new hires across the region

 - Own the APAC Onboarding Calendar end-to-end, ensuring a consistent, well-sequenced new-hire experience

 - Establish a clear communication cadence with APAC frontline leaders, setting expectations and ensuring visibility into each new hire’s onboarding plan and progress

 - Partner with APAC Sales Leadership, Enablement and Revenue Operations to iterate on and deliver high-impact live sessions with clear objectives and strong SME alignment that is aligned to the global program and tailored for regional nuances (Korea, Japan, and APACx)

 - Operationalize the pre-work, certifications, and continued learning path so assignments land at the right time and reinforce on-the-job performance

 - Measure onboarding effectiveness through qualitative inputs (e.g., surveys), and translate insights into clear recommendations and iteration plans

 - Create engaging, multimodal learning experiences (AI-assisted content, short-form video, podcasts, and activity-based materials) that help sellers succeed in their segment and reach their full potential with Notion

 - Embed and reinforce Notion’s culture, product value, and customer-first mindset across all field enablement programs

 


SKILLS YOU'LL NEED TO BRING

 - 4+ years of SaaS sales experience
   
   - Including:
     
     - 2+ years full cycle selling

 - Demonstrate agency to lead enablement within team

 - Strong executive presence, with excellent written and verbal communication skills and stakeholder management abilities

 - Clear understanding of B2B sales cycles, strategies, and buyers—ideally product-led growth, sales-led growth journeys, and enterprise sales

 - Proficiency and ability to coach proven sales methodologies, including MEDDPICC, core sales competencies, and Command of the Message with practicality

 - Self-motivated problem solver who excels in ambiguous situations and takes complete ownership of projects

 - Creative thinker able to build engaging, outcome-focused content that drives behavioral change

 - Coaching mindset with high empathy for new hires and current sellers, driving effective change by challenging perspectives and focusing the team on value-based conversations

 - Proactive by nature, takes decisive action when identifying skill gaps or risks that could impact the success of enablement initiatives

 - Culture carrier, with a strong ability and desire to roll up their sleeves and make an impact in a high-growth environment

 - Fluency in Japanese and business-level in English

 


NICE TO HAVES:

 - Fluency in Korean
   
   #LI-Onsite




A NOTE ON AI

You don’t need deep AI expertise for every role, but we do expect every Notino to be intellectually curious, drawn to tinkering and discovery, and excited to use AI as a real collaborator in their work. For some roles, AI fluency is a core requirement — when that’s the case, we'll say so explicitly in the qualifications. People who thrive here don’t treat AI as a novelty. They use it to think better, and make their work easier for others to build on.




EQUAL OPPORTUNITY & ACCOMMODATIONS

We hire talented people from a wide range of backgrounds. If you’re excited about this role but don’t meet every bullet, we still encourage you to apply. Notion is an equal opportunity employer and does not discriminate on the basis of any legally protected characteristic. Consistent with applicable law, we will consider for employment qualified applicants with arrest and conviction records. Notion provides reasonable accommodations during the application process; if you need one, please let your recruiter know.



Notion is proud to be an equal opportunity employer. We do not discriminate in hiring or any employment decision based on race, color, religion, national origin, age, sex (including pregnancy, childbirth, or related medical conditions), marital status, ancestry, physical or mental disability, genetic information, veteran status, gender identity or expression, sexual orientation, or other applicable legally protected characteristic. Notion considers qualified applicants with criminal histories, consistent with applicable federal, state and local law. Notion is also committed to providing reasonable accommodations for qualified individuals with disabilities and disabled veterans in our job application procedures. If you need assistance or an accommodation due to a disability, please let your recruiter know.

jobs.title: Quality Assurance Engineer (m/f)
jobs.description:
Quality Assurance Engineer

About Luxtrust

We are a multicultural and forward-thinking qualiﬁed Trust Services Provider based in Capellen, Luxembourg, with over 140 professionals and actively expanding our business internationally. We provide state-of-the-art on on-boarding, digital identities, strong authentication and security services, and qualiﬁed electronic signatures, all bundled into integrated digital documents & identity management solutions.

As a Trusted Partner, we prioritize building long-lasting relationships with our international clients and stakeholders, based on trust and integrity. We strive to be a Committed Partner, dedicating ourselves to delivering exceptional performance and showing steadfast commitment to make a positive impact. As a Visionary Scout, we are constantly seeking out new opportunities for growth and innovation, always staying ahead of the curve in our industry.

Join us in our mission to drive innovation and co-create a better future!

We are currently looking for a motivated and driven Quality Assurance Engineer (m/f/x) under a permanent contract.

Summary

In the development of our projects, the Quality Assurance Engineer is the key person who ensures that the service produced is built following the requirements, with a high level of quality. That person is in charge of the quality of the product delivered to customers.
 
Missions of the role

Documentation:

-          Create QA documentation to describe processes
-          Update existing documentation or create new ones to document test findings

Agility:

-          Participate in Agile ceremonies
-          Understand and deliver on the product goals during sprints.
-          May lead Agile ceremonies

 Manual testing:

-          Create and documents manual test scenarios following specific guidelines
-          Continuously update manual test scenarios to ensure that all features are properly covered whenever a new use case arises
-          Ensure each feature is manually tested
-          Organize and execute testing activities on all environments.
-          Corner cases testing approach is expected for manual tests

Automatic testing:

-          Create automatic test scenarios following specific guidelines
-          Continuously update automatic test scenarios to ensure that all features are properly covered whenever a new use case arises
-          Develop test cases using guidelines (framework, languages…)
-          Corner cases testing approach is expected for automatic tests
-          Performance testing (stress tests…)
-          Security testing

Test strategy:

-          Contribute to the test strategy of the product
-          Design and develop:
o   Test plans
o   Test cases & Test data
o   Test execution
-          Maintain application coverage up to KPI standards.
-          Come up with new ideas regarding processes, tools etc. to improve the test strategy of the product

Test reporting & release process:

-          Provide reporting for all automatic tests, all manual tests, all non-regression tests performed on a new version
-          Perform smoke tests post release deployment
-          Provide Go/NoGo release status to the Tech Lead and Product Owner

Bug management:

-          Confirm bugs raised by third parties after thorough tests
-          Help define impacts of bugs with the help of stakeholders (BA, PO…) to classify the urgency of the fix

Product knowledge:

-          Complete knowledge of the solution is expected
-          Can deep-dive into the product and all features of the applications maintained by the affected functional team.

Team interaction & support:

-          Work closely with Customer Success team to confirm issues and provide quick support
-          Daily interaction with functional team (Product Owner, Developers, Business Analysts)
 
Required skills

Qualifications / diploma(s): bachelor's or master's degree in engineering or computer sciences or equivalent experience.

Experience:

-         Experience in Scrum methodology
-         Experience using JIRA / Confluence is an asset
-         Intermediate SQL level
-         Previous experience testing PKI/Banking/Mobile/Web applications
-         Experienced in QA with ISEB/ISTQB certification or similar experience
-         Experience in test design, risk management, defect management with a strong background in security
-         Solid knowledge of manual and automated software testing
-         Experience writing test documentation

Languages: French and English fluent. Any other language is an asset.

Technical / Specific skills:

-         Expected to be able to liaise with developers and assess their test automated scripts
-         Comfortable working in a fast paced Agile environment
-         Analytical mindset
-         Proactive and positive attitude with good Team-spirit
-         Good interpersonal relations and communications skills (written and oral)
-         Good time management and priority setting skills
-         Good at corner cases tests methodology
-          Ability to write or understand Bash, HTML/XML, SQL, JavaScript<>TypeScript, Java
-         Hands-on experience testing on the main software platforms: Web, Windows, Linux, iOS, OSX, Android
-         Familiarity with the following technical stacks used in our Quality Assurance processes: Selenium, Playwright, Postman, Rest Assured and BDD Framework /Page Object Framework
-         Corner case testing mindset
-         Automation expertise

Core competencies at LuxTrust:

-          Performance
-          Client service mindset

Our company is committed to fair recruitment, based on the skills of each candidate, regardless of gender nationality, sexual orientation, religion, or any other discriminatory criterion.
Please note that in order to comply with our regulatory requirements an extract of the criminal record is requested upon entry into service.

jobs.title: Senior Staff Infrastructure & Security Engineer
jobs.description:
ABOUT CIVILGRID

CivilGrid is the trusted civil design platform powering affordable infrastructure renewal and growth. We give utilities, civil engineers, and municipalities a single, collaborative source of truth for what's underground so teams can plan, design, and build faster, smarter, and safer.

Our platform consolidates utility records, geotechnical and environmental data, paving moratoriums, and jurisdictional requirements directly from 3,000+ utilities, agencies, and municipalities with full chain-of-custody documentation. Teams at PG&E, Mark Thomas, and dozens of leading engineering firms use CivilGrid to cut research time by up to 88%, reduce project costs, prevent dig-ins, and accelerate delivery on the projects that keep communities running.

We're a venture-backed Series A startup tackling a $4.7T US infrastructure market that has been underserved by software for decades. Founded by industry insiders, each with 10+ years in utilities and civil engineering, we move fast, ship work that matters, and stay close to the customers and field teams we build for.

WHY THIS ROLE

We're looking for a Security & Infrastructure Engineer to own our security posture and assist in supporting our cloud platform and reliability as we scale into large utilities and civil engineering firms. You'll take over and grow our security program, working across engineering, IT, and leadership. The role is on the Systems team that spans DevOps, SRE, and security. Your focus is security but you will contribute across the team.

This role reports to the Head of Engineering. It is a hybrid role with expectations that you are working from our Boston, MA office at least 3 days per week if hired.

WHAT YOU'LL DO

  • Partner with engineering to embed reliability and security into the SDLC and infrastructure decisions

  • Run our security program: SOC 2 readiness and audits, vendor reviews, access controls, endpoint security, and threat modeling

  • Define and enforce policies for identity, secrets, data handling, and production access across the company

  • Lead incident response for both security events, and some reliability events, from detection through resolution and follow-up

  • Harden and monitor our GIS servers (Windows Server) alongside our AWS platform

  • Build and maintain our Trust Center, and lead security reviews with customers

  • Contribute to our AWS environment end to end: VPC architecture, ECS, RDS, secrets management, IAM, networking, and cost optimization

  • Contribute to improving reliability practices: SLOs, observability, alerting, on-call rotation, runbooks, and blameless post-incident reviews

  • The tech:

    • AWS ECS, Postgres on RDS managed with CDK

    • GitHub, Datadog, Slack, Notion, Drata

WHAT YOU'LL BRING

  • At least 5-8 years of experience across product security, platform security, or security engineering, with hands-on experience with DevOps or SRE of production AWS infrastructure

  • Experience running or supporting a SOC 2 program, including evidence collection, control design, and auditor coordination

  • Deep working knowledge of AWS (VPC, ECS, RDS, IAM, Secrets Manager, CloudWatch) and infrastructure-as-code (Terraform, CDK, or equivalent)

  • Experience running vulnerability management, from scanner findings and outside reports to fixes shipped

  • Track record of improving reliability in production: defining SLOs, building observability, running on-call, and leading post-incident reviews

  • Startup ready: autonomous, moves fast, takes initiative without being asked

  • Strong verbal and written communication, able to articulate ideas clearly and collaborate effectively

BONUS POINTS

  • Experience supporting B2B products sold into regulated industries (utilities, energy, public sector)

HOW WE WORK

We're a small, but rapidly growing team that ships. Expect direct feedback, real ownership from day one, and proximity to customers â huge utilities, public agencies, and engineering firms whose work depends on what we build. We default to in-person collaboration where it matters and remote-friendly flexibility otherwise. We hire people who care deeply about their craft and the communities our customers serve.

COMPENSATION & BENEFITS

The base salary range for this role is $137,318 - $192,960.

Base salary is only one part of your total compensation package at CivilGrid, which also includes meaningful early-stage equity, comprehensive benefits, and the opportunity to shape a category-defining company. The base salary range listed above may encompass various levels and/or geographic locations; final offers are determined based on the candidate's experience, skills, level, and work location.

In addition to base and equity, we offer:

  • Company-funded medical, dental, and vision insurance â including medical plans at no cost to the employee

  • FSA (health and dependent care)

  • Unlimited PTO and a culture that expects you to actually use it

  • 401(k) plan

  • Flexible, remote-friendly work environment

  • A high-trust team, real ownership, and the chance to do the most meaningful work of your career

EQUAL EMPLOYMENT OPPORTUNITY

CivilGrid is an equal opportunity employer. We celebrate diversity and are committed to creating an inclusive environment for all employees and applicants. We do not discriminate on the basis of race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, national origin, age, disability, genetic information, marital status, veteran status, pregnancy, or any other characteristic protected by federal, state, or local law. Employment decisions at CivilGrid are based on business needs, job requirements, and individual qualifications. If you require a reasonable accommodation to participate in the application or interview process, please contact us â we're happy to help.

jobs.description:
WHO WE ARE

Notion is the collaborative AI workspace where teams and agents think together https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=vkpYpWfEK5s. We're building one place where your knowledge, projects, meetings, and AI tools live side by side, so work is faster, clearer, and less fragmented. Millions of individuals, small teams, and large companies run their work on Notion.



Notinos (our employees) are customer zero in bringing this future of work to life. We care about craft, building things that last, and the belief that great work is still fundamentally human. Our goal isn’t to ship the next feature. Each and every team of Notinos is working to set the standard for how humans work together in the AI era. From building a business’s system of record to making and managing AI agents to automating away the busy work, we care deeply about giving our customers more time for their life’s work.




ABOUT THE ROLE:

Notion’s mission is to help everyone build beautiful tools for their life’s work. Notion's Growth Engineers make the everyone part of that happen with a combination of creativity and data to unlock business growth. This team accelerates the value Notion provides to an increasing audience of users. We are owners of the ins and outs of our business, using a blend of data, qualitative research, and product intuition to drive business growth.

This role can be based in either San Francisco or New York City. We work from our offices on Mondays, Tuesdays and Thursdays (our Anchor Days) because we do our best thinking and building together in person. We’re looking for someone who’s excited to work alongside the team during those days. 




WHAT YOU'LL ACHIEVE:

 - Build technical foundations that help the broader team and coding agents experiment, build and ship more.

 - Drive technical and product vision as an engineering leader within the org, building alignment with other eng teams and cross functionally, bringing clarity to the roadmap.

 - Deliver experiments end-to-end, from ideation to analysis, that balance the dimensions of product and the business appropriately.

 - Get to know the Notion customer to understand key points in the customer journey and uncover insights that will drive activation and engagement




SKILLS YOU'LL NEED TO BRING: 

 - Finding the problems worth solving: You don't wait to be handed a roadmap. You dig into growth data, customer research, and the codebase to find the highest-leverage opportunities, then make the case for them and drive alignment on what to pursue.

 - Data and experimentation as a practice: You have Growth Engineering experience at another company, and you've built experimentation into how a team works: defining success criteria, running A/B tests, and turning results into decisions others follow.

 - Shipping polished user interfaces: You build fast, well-crafted web experiences with React and modern web technologies, and you know what it takes to keep them working as usage grows.

 - Building with AI: You build AI systems that keeps producing after you step away: coding agent workflows that can take on engineering work with the guardrails that let them run effectively. You know how to build systems for agents and treat the system as the deliverable, improving it continuously for accelerated impact.

 - Raising the bar for others: You mentor engineers of all tenures, guide them on and technical designs, and share your expertise so it scales past you. Multiple engineers have grown by working with you.

 - Pragmatism and impact-orientation: You care about business impact and prioritize projects accordingly. You're not just going after cool stuff, you understand the balance between craft, speed, and the bottom line.

 - Putting users first: You think critically about the implications of what you're building, and how it shapes real people's lives. You understand that reach comes with responsibility for our impact, good and bad.




NICE TO HAVES:

 - 10+ years of experience

 - A history of strong cross-functional collaboration with marketing, sales, and/or other non-technical teams

 - You've heard of computing pioneers like Ada Lovelace, Douglas Engelbart, Alan Kay, and others, and understand why we're big fans of their work.

FLAME STRAIGHTENING SPECIALIST – STEEL STRUCTURES TMT d.o.o. Čakovec is looking for an experienced and responsible Flame Straightening Specialist to join our production team. Work Location: Lepoglava, Croatia Job Responsibilities

  • Straightening metal components and welded steel structures using controlled heating with gas torches.
  • Correcting distortions and deformations caused by welding and other manufacturing processes.
  • Performing manual and mechanical straightening using appropriate tools, fixtures, and hydraulic presses.
  • Checking straightness, dimensions, and tolerances according to technical drawings and specifications.
  • Independently determining heating locations, sequences, and intensity to achieve the required geometry of steel structures.
  • Ensuring high-quality workmanship and compliance with workplace safety standards.
Requirements
  • Proven experience in flame straightening (thermal straightening) of metal components and steel structures.
  • Knowledge of techniques for correcting welding-induced distortions.
  • Ability to read and interpret technical drawings.
  • Ability to work independently with precision, reliability, and responsibility.
  • Previous experience in the metalworking or steel fabrication industry.
What We Offer
  • Stable employment in an established manufacturing company.
  • Accomodation
  • Food allowance
  • Regular and reliable salary payments.
  • Professional and well-equipped production environment.
  • Opportunities for long-term employment and professional development.
  • All necessary tools, equipment, and protective gear provided.

APPLY NOW! If you have experience in flame straightening, heat straightening, or correcting distortions in welded steel structures and are looking for a stable, long-term position, we invite you to join our team at TMT d.o.o. Join our team in Lepoglava, Croatia!
