jobs.title: Senior Electrical Engineer, High Voltage (GIS); Location: DK - Esbjerg
jobs.description:
Are you a seasoned HV engineer with extensive GIS expertise? Do you understand what it takes to specify the right GIS solution and navigate the trade-offs between performance, reliability, cost, footprint and delivery schedules? Can you translate customer requirements into practical, value-driven solutions? Then join our team and help shape the projects that are driving the global transition towards renewable energy!Your position In your new position, you will be a key contributor to our major tender projects, collaborating closely with a team of experienced engineers to translate customer requirements into robust and scalable offerings. Drawing on your expertise in high-voltage GIS solutions, you will help shape technical decisions, collaborate with strategic suppliers, and strengthen our value proposition.Beyond tender activities, you will contribute to the continuous development of our HV competencies, product portfolio, and ways of working, helping strengthen our technical foundation for future growth.You will join our Product Line Management (PLM) Solution Engineering team, a multidisciplinary group collaborating with customers, suppliers and colleagues across the organization.As part of PLM, you will contribute to our ambition of making offshore substations more modular, standardized, and repeatable.You will help define not only the solutions we deliver today, but also the solutions we bring to market tomorrow.Building on our strong offshore substation capabilities, we are also exploring opportunities within onshore substations. Experience with onshore transmission systems, including EHV GIS/AIS, grid transformers, reactive compensation, harmonic filtering or grid connection equipment, will therefore be considered an advantage and may provide opportunities to contribute beyond our offshore portfolio.Working in an international and collaborative environment, you will help transform proven engineering concepts into repeatable products that support the continued growth of renewable energy worldwide.The position is full-time and includes approximately 10-30 travel days per year. We place a high value on flexibility, and most travel can be planned to align with both business requirements and personal preferences."We have built a leading position within offshore substations, and PLM plays a key role in ensuring that we maintain and strengthen that position. By developing scalable solutions, standardizing our products, and challenging established ways of working, we make sure that we are ready to meet the demands of both today’s and tomorrow’s energy markets. We currently support projects across Europe, the UK, North America, and Asia, but our ambition is simple: to be ready wherever the next opportunity emerges."– Jannick Elmbæk Olsen, Director, Product Line ManagementYour tasks & responsibilitiesAs our new Senior High Voltage Engineer, you will play a key role in the development, positioning, and continuous improvement of the products and solutions offered within our offshore substation product line. Working closely with customers, suppliers, procurement, and our project execution teams, you will help shape solutions that remain competitive, scalable, and aligned with future market demands.Your tasks will include:
  • Support tender activities by defining and evaluating 66 kV and 230/275 kV GIS solutions.
  • Translate customer needs, market trends, and supplier capabilities into competitive product offerings.
  • Optimize solutions with respect to performance, reliability, footprint, cost, and lead time.
  • Develop and maintain the GIS product roadmap in line with future market requirements and emerging technologies.
  • Collaborate with Procurement and strategic suppliers to strengthen competitiveness and drive cost optimization.
  • Contribute to the standardization and modularization of our GIS product portfolio.
  • Ensure a seamless handover of as-sold solutions to our EPC engineering teams.
Your profile & qualifications To succeed in this role, you are an experienced High Voltage Engineer with extensive GIS expertise and a passion for developing competitive solutions for the renewable energy industry.We imagine that you:
  • Hold a degree in Electrical Engineering or a related technical discipline.
  • Have extensive experience with medium- and high-voltage GIS systems, including 66 kV array systems and 230/275 kV transmission-level applications, from offshore wind, utilities, transmission, manufacturing, or EPC projects.
  • Experience with offshore GIS applications, technology qualification, or emerging SF6-free switchgear technologies is considered an advantage.
  • Understand the technical and commercial drivers behind GIS selection, including performance, cost, footprint, weight, and lead time.
  • Are comfortable working with customers, suppliers, and internal stakeholders to balance technical and commercial requirements.
  • Have a strategic mindset and enjoy translating market needs into scalable product offerings.
  • Communicate clearly in English and can translate complex technical topics into sound business decisions.
  • Thrive in a collaborative and international environment and enjoy working across disciplines and cultures.
  • If you also bring experience or exposure to onshore substations, grid connections, or related high-voltage systems, we would be interested to hear about it.
Welcome to Semco Maritime At Semco Maritime, we create change. For people. For projects. And for the global energy sector. With us, you will join a community of over 2,300 of the most dedicated thinkers and doers in the energy industry who are driving real change and making their own personal mark on the global energy landscape. While everyone knows why the energy transition is vital, we are concerned with the journey. How to get there. By providing the answers needed to make change real. Because we believe that global energy ambitions can only be realized through hard work and clever pragmatic solutions. This is what we do. This is what we invite you to participate in. Safety is at the core of everything we do, and we are committed to protecting our people, partners, and the planet as we work towards a sustainable energy future. So yes, working for us will change the energy sector – and may well change you too.  We know that our people are our greatest strength. We strive to build an inclusive workplace where everyone can be themselves, contribute their perspectives, and feel part of the team. We welcome applicants from all backgrounds and believe that diverse teams help us find better solutions and move the energy transition forward.   Care to join the movement? Change. With us. Semco Maritime is an international engineering and contracting company with 2,300 employees and 40 years of dedication rooted in both the conventional energy sector and the offshore wind industry. This puts us in a unique position to bridge today's and tomorrow’s solutions, constantly seeking clever and pragmatic ways to realise global energy ambitions. We do this through comprehensive project management across all phases of energy projects together with world-leading partners across the globe.

•         Har teknisk forståelse og interesse for kvalitetssikring.

Quality Assurance Employee Wanted at Firesafe Danmark A/S

Do you have an eye for detail, a strong technical understanding, and a passion for ensuring high quality workmanship on construction sites?

Firesafe Danmark A/S is looking to recruit two Quality Assurance Employees to strengthen our quality assurance team within passive fire protection and insulation works.

In this role, you will combine on-site quality inspections with technical follow-up and documentation. You will work closely with installers, project managers, and other members of the project team to ensure that installations meet the required quality standards.

Key Responsibilities

•         Conduct regular QA/QC inspections of passive fire protection and insulation works on-site.

•         Verify that installations comply with approved drawings, installation instructions, project specifications, and applicable requirements.

•         Identify non-conformities and follow up on corrective actions to ensure proper close-out.

•         Prepare and maintain quality documentation, inspection records, and reports, including the registration and follow-up of quality-related issues in Dalux and BIM models.

•         Provide technical guidance to installers on approved installation methods and demonstrate correct workmanship when required.

•         Coordinate with the project team regarding technical clarifications, site activities, and quality-related matters.

About You

We are looking for a responsible, structured, and solution-oriented individual with strong attention to detail. You are comfortable working both on construction sites and in a site office, and you can communicate effectively with different trades and project stakeholders.

We expect you to:

•         Have a good technical understanding and a strong interest in quality assurance and quality control.

•         Be able to read and interpret construction drawings and technical documentation.

•         Work independently, systematically, and take ownership of your tasks.

•         Communicate effectively in English or Danish, both verbally and in writing.

•         Be comfortable using digital tools for inspections and quality documentation.

•         Be confident in guiding installers and following up on the quality of completed work.

 

It would be an advantage if you have:

•         Previous experience in QA/QC, quality inspections, or construction site supervision.

•         Knowledge of passive fire protection, insulation, or similar construction activities.

•         Experience working with Dalux and BIM.

•         Hands-on construction site experience, including providing technical guidance to installers.

•         Good Danish language skills and knowledge of additional languages.

A specific educational background is not required. We value relevant practical experience, technical understanding, and the right attitude.

What We Offer

•         A permanent, full-time position with a minimum of 37 working hours per week.

•         Start date as soon as possible or by agreement.

•         Competitive salary based on qualifications and experience, including pension and other employment benefits in accordance with the applicable collective agreement and employment contract.

•         Company phone and the possibility of a company vehicle, depending on project requirements.

•         A varied workday combining on-site inspections with office-based QA/QC activities.

•         A supportive and informal working environment with opportunities for professional development.

About Firesafe Danmark A/S

Firesafe Danmark A/S specialises in passive fire protection and related technical services within the construction industry.

Our work contributes to protecting people, buildings, and assets by ensuring that fire protection systems are correctly installed, inspected, and documented in accordance with project specifications and applicable requirements.

You will become part of a team where quality, teamwork, and accountability are at the core of our daily operations.

How to Apply

Interested in joining our team?

Please submit your CV along with a short description of your motivation for applying to info@firesafe.dk

If you have any questions about the position, feel free to contact Søren Christiansen soeren.christiansen@firesafe.dk for further information.

We look forward to hearing from you!

jobs.title: Freelance Copywriter
jobs.description:
CT Marketing Agency is seeking skilled Freelance Copywriters to write high-quality, SEO-driven content for eCommerce and lead generation websites. This is a freelance, project-based writing role.

 

The ideal candidate has excellent English writing skills, strong research ability, and experience writing content that follows detailed, client-specific guidelines. Projects commonly include category pages, product descriptions, blog posts, SEO landing pages, and website copy.

 

About the Role

Our client base is constantly evolving, and writers may create content across a wide range of industries, including:

  • Fashion, including mass-market and luxury brands
  • Skincare and beauty
  • Tech and software
  • Finance and investing
  • Law, including family law, divorce, and product liability
  • Education
  • Home improvement
  • Automobiles and motorcycles
  • Health and wellness
  • Medical and clinical fields
  • Digital marketing
  • SEO, PR, advertising, and marketing

Writers with experience in highly specialized industries such as tech, finance, law, health, medical, SEO, PR, advertising, or marketing are strongly encouraged to apply.

Responsibilities
  • Write clear, engaging, SEO-friendly content for eCommerce and lead generation websites
  • Create category pages, product descriptions, blog posts, landing pages, and website copy
  • Research client industries, products, services, audiences, and competitors
  • Follow detailed client guidelines and adapt to different brand voices
  • Blend SEO best practices with brand priorities and conversion-focused writing
  • Complete assignments by deadline and communicate professionally with the team

Qualifications
  • Excellent English writing, grammar, editing, and proofreading skills
  • 2 to 4 years of professional, non-academic writing experience preferred
  • Strong understanding of SEO writing best practices
  • Ability to research unfamiliar industries and technical topics
  • Ability to write creative, engaging, accurate, and ROI-focused content
  • Portfolio featuring published work preferred
  • Experience in specialized industries strongly preferred

Compensation

Writers are paid on a per-word basis. Rates are assessed according to our KPI rubric.

Initial compensation is up to $0.06 per word, with $0.034 per word being the most typical rate

This equals approximately $30 or $17 per 500-word page

After 400 live pages, the top rate increases to $0.064 per word, with $0.038 per word being the most typical rate

After 800 live pages, the top rate increases to $0.07 per word, with $0.044 per word being the most typical rate

 

Application Process

Candidates should be prepared to provide a portfolio featuring published work. Once an offer is extended, writers will complete a brief training course.

• Overall coordination and operational organization of the kitchen

We review applications continuously and look forward to hearing from you — and hopefully welcoming you to the India Spice family.

jobs.title: Support Engineer I (FC, Weekend Shift)
jobs.description:
Replit is the agentic software creation platform that enables anyone to build applications using natural language. With millions of users worldwide, Replit is democratizing software development by removing traditional barriers to application creation.


As a Support Engineer you are at the forefront of helping those developers create. In a given day you’ll help folks with all sorts of things ranging from general Replit usage questions, identifying and debugging issues on the platform and helping to build and maintain the tools we use. We use tools like Zendesk, Linear, Slack, and Replit itself to get the job done. We also value solving the problems we can ourselves. We have a number of tools we build and maintain ourselves.



You will work on a small, global team of support specialists and engineers united by Replit's mission to make the next billion software creators. Together, you'll ensure developers worldwide have the support they need to bring their ideas to life.




IN THIS ROLE YOU WILL:

 - Work directly with Replit customers via support tickets to solve technical product issues, bugs, and provide technical guidance while meeting daily ticket volume and resolution time targets.

 - Collaborate with the rest of the Support team in telling the story of our users to the rest of Replit.

 - Directly contribute to and maintain the Support team's Knowledge Base.

 - Support customer-facing communications for outages and incidents and swiftly report ongoing bugs for Eng to triage and fix.




REQUIRED SKILLS AND EXPERIENCE:

 - Prior experience in software development or relevant technical support experience

 - Proven ability to work efficiently in fast-paced, high-volume support environments with strict productivity metrics.

 - Strong time management and ticket triage skills with comfort in performance tracking and regular reporting.

 - Excellent communication skills with initiative to ask questions when encountered with the unknown.

 - Experience with support tools and ticketing systems (e.g. Zendesk)




NICE TO HAVE:

 - Has used Replit in the last 3 to 6 months.

 - Experience working with IDEs, terminals, or other common developer tools.

 - Experience with AI tools (Claude, ChatGPT, etc.)




WHAT WE VALUE:

 - Problem-solving mindset: Ability to approach complex operational challenges systematically and devise effective solutions

 - Self-directed and autonomous: Capable of working independently while collaborating effectively with cross-functional teams

 - Strong communication skills: Ability to explain complex technical concepts to both technical and non-technical audiences

 - Continuous learning: Passion for staying current with industry best practices and new technologies

 - Focus on automation: Strong belief in automating repetitive tasks and building self-healing systems



This is a full-time role that can be held from our Foster City, CA office. The schedule follows a Saturday through Wednesday work week, with an in-office requirement on Mondays and Wednesdays.



Full-Time Employee Benefits Include:

💰 Competitive Salary & Equity

💹 401(k) Program with a 4% match (US Only)

⚕️ Health, Dental, Vision and Life Insurance

🩼 Short Term and Long Term Disability

🚼 Paid Parental, Medical, Caregiver Leave

🏝 Flexible Time Off (FTO) + Holidays

🚗 Commuter Benefits  (In-Office & US Only)

📱 Monthly Wellness Stipend

🧑‍💻 Autonomous Work Environment

🖥 In Office Set-Up Reimbursement (In-Office Only)

🚀 Quarterly Team Gatherings

☕ In Office Amenities (In-Office Only)

 - Customer Leadership: You will serve as the key extension of your team for high-stakes customer engagements (both internally and externally), such as business reviews.

 


SKILLS YOU'LL NEED TO BRING:

Facade Insulation Workers – Vejle, Denmark

The job

We are looking for 3 experienced facade insulation workers for a construction project in Vejle, Denmark.

The work will mainly involve external facade insulation from scaffolding

You should have relevant experience from facade work, insulation, construction or carpentry. Experience with facade insulation systems is an advantage but not a demand

Your tasks may include:

  • Installing external insulation on facades

  • Cutting and fitting insulation boards

  • Working from scaffolding

  • Preparing facade surfaces

  • Installing reinforcement mesh and profiles

  • Applying base coat/render

  • Finishing and preparing the facade for the final surface

  • Following drawings and instructions on site

  • Working safely and professionally as part of a team

We are looking for candidates who:

  • Have practical experience in construction, facade work, insulation or carpentry

  • Preferably have previous experience with external facade insulation

  • Are able to work accurately and independently

  • Can follow instructions and work according to Danish safety standards

  • Can communicate in English well enough to understand work and safety instructions

  • Are reliable and willing to work continuously throughout the project

Working conditions

  • Start: 9 november 2026

  • Working hours: 37 hours per week

  • Normal working day starts at 07:00

  • No rotation – you will work continuously in Denmark

  • Project runs until 22 January 2027 with possible extension

 

Location

7100 Vejle, Denmark

If you are an experienced construction worker with a background in facade insulation, facade work, carpentry, masonry or similar, we would like to hear from you.

Apply now and tell us about your experience with facade insulation and construction work.

For further information contact Niels Søbye tel. +4527797214 mail; niso@moment.dk

jobs.title: HR Country Manager Denmark
jobs.description: Every day, we get opportunities to make a positive impact - on our colleagues, partners, customers, and society. Together, we're pioneering the solutions of the future and unlocking the full potential of precious resources. Trusted to act on initiative, we challenge conventional thinking to develop world-leading technologies that inspire progress in vital areas, including energy, food, water, and shipping.   As we push forward, the innovative, open spirit that fuels our 140-year-old start-up culture and rapid growth also drives our personal growth. So, as we shape a more resourceful, less wasteful world, we build our careers too.  About the job As HR Country Manager, you will be supporting Alfa Laval's Scaling for Future direction, with a focus on Denmark, with 2000 employees and five Danish legal entities. The role in this form is newly established, giving you a fantastic opportunity to influence the position and make it your own!  The position supports several types of organizations in Denmark and Scandinavia, such as sales companies, factories, shared services, business units, and product groups. The key priority will be to ensure HR alignment across the legal entities and compliance with Danish legislation and collective agreements. You will contribute to harmonizing people policies and practices and as a trusted partner, you will support and inspire management by proactively driving organizational, leadership, and competence development.  You will act as:     HR Country Manager for Denmark, ensuring alignment, compliance, and consistent HR practices across all five legal entities across four sites - Søborg, Kolding, Aalborg and Nakskov.     HR Representative in the Danish Country Council, coordinating national HR topics and providing a consolidated HR view to business leaders in the country council     HR Business Partner for Søborg Site Services and the HR Shared Services Scandinavia organization.     Local HR responsibility for the Søborg site, including Site Management, the Works Council, the Work Environment Council, and the Crisis Management Team.     The one responsible for overall country-level approach to unions, including ensuring alignment in union relationships, works council cooperation and collective agreement governance and also provide guidance together with HR Shared Services on employee relations areas.  Operational responsibilities:    Plan and drive national HR focus areas for the five Danish entities aligned with the business strategy and People Strategy.     Develop and implement people policies, processes, routines, guidelines, tools and analytics.     Ensure country-wide consistency for benefits frameworks, allowances, principles, policies.     Coordinate the salary budget and review process in Denmark together with the Employee Relations team in HR Shared Services     Drive, support and inspire management in organizational, leadership, and competence development.     Coordinate local HR activities at the Søborg site, including collaboration with employee representatives and relevant councils.  Travel is part of the job, mainly to our various sites in Denmark, but you will also have a few travel days a year within Europe. You will be part of the Danish Country Council management team as well as part of the Søborg Site Management team. You report to Per Lund Hansen, a manager who will give you freedom and mandate to perform at your best. You will also have a dotted line to our VP Total Rewards and HR Shared Services, Gabriella Nagy Olofsson.  Who you are You are an experienced and confident HR professional, who is ready to take on the role as a trusted sparring partner for managers and leaders. You bring a genuine interest in understanding the business and getting to know our people. To succeed we see you as a strong communicator able to create engagement, participation, and clarity. You are people-oriented and build good solid relationships and have the know-how in leading through others. You make decisions with overall perspective and consider the needs of the entire organization.  Requirements:     Solid experience from a similar role within a larger international matrix organization and a strong background in country-level HR governance.     In-depth knowledge of Danish labour law, industrial relations, negotiations and collective agreements.     Experience in leading and coordinating change work, developing and implementing HR processes, routines, and guidelines.     Good ability to work in HR systems     Excellent communication skills in Danish and English and the ability to formulate clear and well-structured routines, guidelines, and strategic documents.     Completed university education in HR of at least 180 ECTS credits, or an equivalent education deemed relevant by the employer.     Driving license. We do not accept applications via email, due to the General Data Protection Regulation (GDPR). Please send your application no later than November 18, 2026. We will remove the job advert from our website as soon as we have found the right candidate, so don't wait too long!  While we typically welcome applicants from all locations, for this particular role, we are prioritizing candidates who are currently residing close to our office in Søborg, Denmark. We care about diversity, inclusion, and equity in our recruitment processes. We also believe behavioral traits can provide important insights into a candidate's fit to a role. To help us achieve this we apply Pymetrics assessments, and upon application you will be invited to play the assessment games.  As part of Alfa Laval's commitment to a safe and healthy workplace, we conduct background checks on final candidates for this role, and alcohol and drug testing is applied during the pre‑employment process.  #LI-CL1

jobs.title: Senior Sales Manager for Renewables Service, Location: DK - Esbjerg, DK - Copenhagen, DK - Aarhus
jobs.description:
Do you have a passion for building strategic customer relationships and turning complex opportunities into long-term business success? Are you motivated by helping accelerate the energy transition through offshore wind solutions? If so, this could be your next career opportunity. At Semco Maritime, we are looking for an experienced Senior Sales Manager to strengthen our Renewables Service business. You will play a key role in developing strategic sales opportunities, supporting key customer relationships, and securing service contracts for offshore wind assets in selected international markets. Your position As our new Senior Sales Manager, you will have end-to-end commercial ownership of strategic sales opportunities within the Renewables Division. Working closely with customers, partners, and internal stakeholders, you will lead the external commercial journey from early opportunity identification and qualification through tender management, contract negotiation, award, and handover to project execution. At Semco Maritime safety is a core value, and in this role, you will contribute to maintaining and promoting a strong safety culture while delivering innovative solutions. Above all, your work will make a real change for the global energy sector. You will be accountable for building and converting a strong pipeline of strategic opportunities into profitable contracts while developing long-term relationships with selected key customers. You will shape winning commercial strategies based on customer needs, market dynamics, and Semco’s capabilities, and ensure that commercial priorities are aligned across relevant functions.You will contribute to defining our commercial focus for selected customers and market segments, helping ensure that we invest our efforts where Semco Maritime has the strongest position to win. Your success will be measured by your ability to build strategic customer relationships, develop high-quality pipeline and convert complex opportunities into sustainable and profitable business.Your place of work will be at our Global HQ located in Esbjerg, our office located in Copenhagen or our future office in Aarhus. The position is full-time, and you can expect to up to 30 travel days per year. Your tasks & responsibilities As our new Senior Sales Manager, you will take ownership of strategic sales opportunities throughout the entire commercial lifecycle.Working closely with customers, partners, and internal stakeholders, you will develop winning strategies, build strong commercial relationships, and identify growth opportunities across existing and new accounts. You will play a central role in shaping account strategies, developing customer-focused value propositions, and ensuring that commercial solutions are aligned with both customer needs and operational capabilities.In addition, you will represent Semco Maritime in customer interactions and industry forums, contribute valuable market insights, and help strengthen our commercial processes and best practices across the organisation.Your tasks will include but are not limited to: 
  • Driving strategic sales opportunities from qualification through contract award and handover.
  • Developing and executing winning strategies for key tenders and commercial opportunities.
  • Building and maintaining strong relationships with strategic customers and supporting key account development.
  • Leading customer negotiations in collaboration with technical, operational, legal, procurement, and finance stakeholders.
  • Identifying and pursuing business growth opportunities, including cross-selling, upselling, and framework agreements.
  • Ensuring high-quality commercial proposals, risk assessments, and governance approvals.
  • Promoting a strong culture of safety, quality, compliance, and integrity in all commercial activities.
Your profile & qualifications We are looking for a commercially driven professional who thrives in a customer-focused environment and has a proven track record of managing complex sales opportunities - preferably from the wind industry. To succeed in this role, we imagine that you: 
  • Have significant experience with complex B2B sales, opportunity and tender management, contract negotiations, and the development of winning strategies for strategic sales opportunities.
  • Bring experience from offshore wind, renewable energy, maritime, technical service, or related industries.
  • Have a strong understanding of customer decision processes, competitive positioning, value creation, and commercial risk management.
  • Have experience with key account management, account planning, and building long-term customer relationships.
  • Are comfortable coordinating cross-functional sales and bid activities involving multiple stakeholders.
  • Possess strong communication, presentation, and negotiation skills and work in a structured, proactive, and results-oriented manner.
  • Communicate fluently in English, both verbally and in writing, and are willing to travel as part of the role. 
Welcome to Semco MaritimeAt Semco Maritime, we create change. For people. For projects. And for the global energy sector. With us, you will join a community of over 2,300 of the most dedicated thinkers and doers in the energy industry who are driving real change and making their own personal mark on the global energy landscape.While everyone knows why the energy transition is vital, we are concerned with the journey. How to get there. By providing the answers needed to make change real. Because we believe that global energy ambitions can only be realized through hard work and clever pragmatic solutions. This is what we do. This is what we invite you to participate in.Safety is at the core of everything we do, and we are committed to protecting our people, partners, and the planet as we work towards a sustainable energy future.So yes, working for us will change the energy sector – and may well change you too. We know that our people are our greatest strength. We strive to build an inclusive workplace where everyone can be themselves, contribute their perspectives, and feel part of the team. We welcome applicants from all backgrounds and believe that diverse teams help us find better solutions and move the energy transition forward.  Care to join the movement?Change. With us.Semco Maritime is an international engineering and contracting company with 2,300 employees and 40 years of dedication rooted in both the conventional energy sector and the offshore wind industry. This puts us in a unique position to bridge today's and tomorrow’s solutions, constantly seeking clever and pragmatic ways to realise global energy ambitions. We do this through comprehensive project management across all phases of energy projects together with world-leading partners across the globe.

jobs.title: Warehouse work for peak season in Ringsted
jobs.description:
Ready for peak season? Join our warehouse team in Ringsted!

Black Friday is just around the corner – and we’re gearing up for our busiest time of the year!

At HumanizeR, we’re looking for energetic and reliable warehouse workers to join our logistics team in Ringsted as peak season kicks off. With Black Friday marking the start of an intense period, we need extra hands to keep thousands of parcels moving and ensure deliveries get where they need to be.

Looking for extra work, a flexible schedule, or a chance to get your foot in the door? This could be the perfect opportunity!

What will you be doing?

You’ll be part of a hardworking team keeping the logistics operation running smoothly. Your tasks will include:

  • Sorting parcels and preparing shipments.
  • Loading and unloading trailers.
  • Helping keep the flow of parcels moving during our busiest season.

No previous warehouse experience is required, training will be provided.

Choose your shift
  • Afternoon shifts: 14:00–22:00 or 16:00–22:00
  • Night shifts: 23:00–06:00

Please note that end times may vary slightly depending on the daily workload.

Why join HumanizeR?
  • Flexible work: Choose when and where you want to work, depending on available shifts and assignments.
  • Earn extra money: Perfect if you’re studying or looking to boost your income ahead of the holidays.
  • Get valuable experience: Develop your skills in a fast-paced logistics environment.
  • Opportunities for the future: Show us what you can do and you may have the chance to move into a permanent position.
  • Great benefits: Including pension and holiday pay.
Who are we looking for?

We’re looking for people who:

  • Are reliable, motivated, and ready to get stuck in.
  • Bring positive energy and enjoy being part of a team.
  • Are comfortable working independently when needed.
  • Are physically fit and able to handle tasks involving heavy lifting.

Previous warehouse experience is a plus, but not a requirement. Your attitude and willingness to learn matter most!

Be part of the Black Friday rush!

Peak season is approaching fast, and we’re getting ready for the busiest time of the year. Join the HumanizeR team in Ringsted, gain valuable experience, and earn extra money while helping keep Denmark’s parcels moving.

Ready to get started? Apply today and join us for peak season!

jobs.title: Night Shift In the Inbound department at Imerco!
jobs.description:
Are you a night owl looking for a temporary warehouse job where you can earn money and gain valuable experience? Do you enjoy practical, hands-on work and prefer working at night? Then this could be the perfect opportunity for you!

We are looking for motivated and reliable warehouse employees to join the inbound department at Imerco, one of Scandinavia’s largest merchandise companies. As we head into the busy Black Friday and Christmas season, we need dedicated night shift workers to help ensure that incoming goods are received and handled efficiently.

The job

Your working hours will be from 23:00 to 07:00, Monday to Friday. The job starts in week 45 or 46 and includes training shifts. It is important that you are available to start during these weeks and can work through to the end of December.

It will be approximately full-time from November. This is a great opportunity to earn extra money while gaining valuable warehouse experience.

Your tasks in the inbound department include:

  • Receiving incoming shipments

  • Opening, lifting, and moving boxes

  • Unloading pallets

  • Working with the Autostore

We are looking for candidates who enjoy working at night and can stay focused and productive throughout their shifts. You should be comfortable with physical work, routine tasks, and a busy warehouse environment.

Additionally, we expect you to:

  • Have experience working in a warehouse – experience with an Autostore is an advantage

  • Be comfortable working night shifts from 23:00 to 07:00

  • Prefer practical, hands-on, and structured work

  • Be physically fit and able to stay active throughout the shift

  • Be reliable, punctual, and able to work independently

  • Communicate well in either English or Danish

We offer valuable warehouse experience during the busy Black Friday and Christmas season, along with the opportunity to earn money during the winter period. You will become part of a friendly and supportive team, where tasks are clearly defined and workflows are well structured.

Working hours, salary and location

  • Working hours: Monday to Friday, 23:00–07:00

  • Start: Week 41, including two consecutive training shifts

  • Employment period: Through the end of December

  • Salary: DKK 156.34 per hour, including Fritvalgskonto

  • An ekstra 35 kr/hour when working the night shift

The warehouse is located in Vallensbæk, with good bus connections, nearby train stations, and free parking available.

Ready to join the night shift team?Apply today! We conduct recruitment on an ongoing basis and look forward to hearing from you.

jobs.title: Software Engineer Infrastructure
jobs.description:
Software Engineer, Infrastructure

Hybrid in Palo Alto (Mon / Wed / Thurs) Â· $185Kâ$215K base + meaningful early-stage equity + full benefits

Â 

About Sodalis

Specialty pharmacy is where the most complex and expensive drugs reach the most in-need patients, and it still runs on faxes, phone tag, and manual data entry. Patients wait weeks for therapies that can't wait.

Sodalis is building AI agents that run those operations end to end: reading and validating prescriptions, handling phone calls, and moving prescriptions through eligibility and fulfillment. The ambition goes beyond that. We want to be the rails every specialty prescription runs on, and the first system to perform clinical review at the standard of a pharmacist.

We're already in production, processing tens of thousands of prescriptions a week. Backed by Gradient Ventures (Google's AI fund), and founded by veterans of Apple's Applied ML, Included Health, and Avella Specialty Pharmacy (scaled to $1.5B+ before its acquisition by OptumRx).

Â 

The Opportunity

Everything we run today is cloud-based, and so are the pharmacy management systems we integrate with. But most of the specialty pharmacy market runs on-prem. To reach it, our system has to run on the pharmacy's systems instead of ours. Whether that's the full stack on-site or a hybrid split with our cloud is one of the first decisions you'd make. That's the problem you'd own.
We've never shipped an on-prem deployment, so there's no pattern to follow. You'll decide how our architecture gets packaged and deployed into environments we don't control, what has to change in our current infrastructure to make that possible, and how we maintain and see into those deployments once they're live.

We don't yet know what these environments look like in detail. Some pharmacies may have restricted outbound access, legacy hardware, or IT teams that can't give us a login; others may be more open. Part of the job is going in with our customer, finding out what's actually there, and designing something that works across the range.
You'll start with our AI pharmacy tech product, rolling out with a committed customer, so you build against a real deployment instead of a hypothetical one. You'd work directly with the founders and the early engineering team on the architecture.

What you'll do

  • Decide how our architecture runs in a pharmacy's environment, starting with the AI pharmacy tech product: full stack on-site, a hybrid split with our cloud, or something in between.

  • Adapt our current infrastructure and build the packaging and deployment path that installs and updates Sodalis at each pharmacy.

  • Own those deployments over time: upgrades, rollbacks, and observability into health and failures without being on site.

  • Go in with our customer and pharmacy IT teams to learn what their environments actually allow, and design for the range.

  • Partner with the founders and early engineering team on architecture.

What we're looking for

  • 5+ years in infrastructure or platform engineering.

  • You've taken an AWS-native stack and made it run on Kubernetes or similar in environments you don't operate, including stateful services.

  • You've shipped and maintained software running in environments you don't control: on-prem, customer-hosted, edge, or embedded.

  • You've kept a fleet of remote installs updated, observable, and recoverable without being able to log into them.

  • You've set the first pattern for something in a startup and are comfortable with ambiguity.

  • You'll spend time with pharmacy IT teams and need to understand their constraints firsthand. No healthcare background required.

How we work

We're a handful of people going all in on a problem we think is worth it, holding a high bar and shipping work that reaches real patients. It's intense, and it isn't for everyone. We want people who want to build something that matters, alongside others who care as much as they do. If that's you, we should talk.

jobs.title: Partner Operations Manager
jobs.description:
About Mecka AI

Mecka AI is building the data infrastructure layer for robotics and embodied AI.
We design and operate global systems for data capture, data labeling, and hardware-enabled workflows used by leading AI labs and robotics companies to train and validate humanoid and embodied AI systems.
We work closely with frontier robotics teams to bridge real-world data, simulation, learning-based systems, and deployed hardware.

About the Role

Signing a capture partner is the start of the work. Getting that partner to steady, high-quality output takes onboarding, training, hardware, support, and reporting, and every step has to run on time.

As Partnership Operations Manager, you will own that path for our regional partnership leads so they can focus on finding and signing partners. This is a new function, so you will set the standards and tooling yourself and make them repeatable across regions.

What You Will Do

  • Deal support: Prepare proposals and agreements from approved templates and keep a clean record of every partnerâs rates, volumes, and term dates.

  • Onboarding: Set partners up on the platform, issue devices and accounts, and train their teams on capture standards so they reach full output quickly.

  • Hardware: Manage device allocation, tracking, replacements, and returns with our hardware and logistics teams, and keep inventory records accurate.

  • Partner support: Be the first point of contact for partners, and run the support channel to clear service levels. Resolve problems yourself or route them to product, engineering, or finance before capture is disrupted, and pass on what partners need from the platform and devices.

  • Performance and reporting: Monitor daily performance and quality across partners, including recorded, approved, and deliverable hours, recording counts, and QA rejection rates. Act when numbers slip, and raise anything commercial with the partnerâs regional lead. Keep scorecards, business reviews, and the data behind them current.

  • Payments: Own partner payments and reconciliation, making sure hours are approved correctly and paid accurately and on time.

  • Playbook: Build and improve the processes, checklists, and tools that keep partner operations running as the network grows.

What You Bring

  • Experience: 3 to 5+ years in partner or vendor operations, supply or merchant onboarding, business operations, program or project management, or account management, ideally at a high-growth marketplace, delivery, or BPO company.

  • Execution: A record of running many partner launches at once across time zones, with clear process and tight follow-up.

  • Organization: Highly organized and detail-focused, able to manage many partners and tasks at once without letting things slip.

  • AI fluency: You use AI tools in your day-to-day work to pull and analyze data, draft partner communications, and streamline your own processes.

  • Problem solving: A practical problem-solver who stays calm under pressure and sees problems through to resolution.

  • Relationships: Strong interpersonal skills. You work well with both partners and internal teams.

  • Agency: A high degree of initiative and comfort with ambiguity. This is an early and unstructured role, so you will set your own priorities, work without an established playbook, and build processes where none yet exists.

Even better if you have

  • Industry: Background in data collection, AI training data, or BPO services.

  • Field deployment: Experience with device deployment and inventory tracking across partner sites.

  • Multi-country: Experience running partner operations across several countries and time zones.

  • Languages: Working fluency in one or more of our regionsâ main business languages, alongside professional English.

If you don't check every box above but believe you can do the job, we encourage you to apply â we're looking for capability and trajectory, not a perfect checklist match.

We strive to create an inclusive work environment for all; we welcome applicants from all backgrounds and are committed to providing equal opportunities. Should you require any accommodations during the recruitment process, we will partner with you to meet your needs.

jobs.title: Scientific Account Executive
jobs.description:
Adaptyv is building an automated lab that lets AI agents run biology experiments.

We're entering the era of agentic science where AI models can now design novel proteins, propose hypotheses, and iterate on experimental results. But they can't run the experiments themselves - that's still a manual, months-long process. We're building the infrastructure that gives AI agents access to the physical world.

We are one of the fastest growing biotech companies, trusted by leading biopharmas, frontier AI labs, and the techbio companies pushing the field forward. This is a rare chance to help advance some of the most important work happening in biotech today.

Our automated lab is powered by a deep software + hardware stack: lab instruments worth millions of USD reverse-engineered into API-controllable hardware, dozens of devices orchestrated through complex workflows, full observability on everything that happens in the lab, processing pipelines for messy physical-world data, and AI systems that troubleshoot production results and accelerate assay development.

Weâre growing rapidly and are hiring for talented people to scale and support the massive demand for AI-driven wet lab experimentation.

About the role

This is a hybrid sales and customer success role for someone with real scientific depth. You'll be the primary point of contact for customers â from first conversation through ongoing engagement. That means understanding what a protein design team is actually trying to achieve, helping them pick the right assays, making sure their experiments are set up correctly, and translating results back into language that's useful for their programs.

The day-to-day:

  • Running technical sales calls where you discuss binding kinetics, expression systems, and assay design, not just pricing

  • Onboarding new customers and helping them design their first experiments on the platform

  • Monitoring ongoing accounts, flagging issues early, and proactively suggesting next steps based on their results

  • Working with the biology team to troubleshoot when a customer's experiment doesn't go as expected

  • Identifying expansion opportunities within existing accounts â new targets, new assay types, larger campaigns

You won't be handed a script. You'll need to understand the science well enough to earn trust from PhD-level protein engineers and CSOs, while also being commercially sharp enough to close deals and grow accounts.

Responsibilities

  • Own the full customer lifecycle: prospecting, technical sales conversations, deal closing, onboarding, and ongoing account management.

  • Serve as the technical point of contact for customers. Understand their protein engineering goals and recommend the right experiments (binding, expression, thermostability, enzyme activity).

  • Understand and explain our assay capabilities in depth: BLI, SPR, cell-free expression, and emerging assay types. Know when each is appropriate and what the data means.

  • Work closely with the biology team to ensure experiments are designed correctly and results are communicated clearly.

  • Build and maintain a pipeline of commercial opportunities across customer segments: AI-driven protein design companies, biotech startups, pharma R&D teams, and academic labs.

  • Develop proposals and quotes tailored to customer needs, from small pilot experiments to large-scale data generation campaigns.

  • Represent Adaptyv at conferences and industry events. Be able to have deep technical conversations at the booth, not just hand out brochures.

  • Feed customer insights back to the product and biology teams: what assays are people asking for, what's missing, where are we losing deals.

What we're looking for

  • Scientific background in protein engineering, biochemistry, biophysics, or a related field. You should be comfortable discussing binding kinetics (KD, kon, koff), expression systems, and assay design without needing to look things up.

  • Experience in a customer-facing technical role: field application scientist, technical sales, scientific account management, or similar. CRO or biotech vendor experience is a strong plus.

  • Commercially driven. You care about revenue, pipeline, and closing deals, not just having interesting scientific conversations.

  • Strong communicator who can adapt to the audience: detailed and technical with a scientist, concise and business-focused with a VP.

  • Self-starter who can manage their own pipeline and priorities without heavy oversight.

  • Genuine interest in AI-driven protein design and the companies working in this space. You follow what's happening in the field.

Application deadline

We are reviewing applicants on a rolling basis.

jobs.title: Executive Operations Partner - EPD (Executive Assistant)
jobs.description:
WHO WE ARE

Notion is the collaborative AI workspace where teams and agents think together https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=vkpYpWfEK5s. We're building one place where your knowledge, projects, meetings, and AI tools live side by side, so work is faster, clearer, and less fragmented. Millions of individuals, small teams, and large companies run their work on Notion.



Notinos (our employees) are customer zero in bringing this future of work to life. We care about craft, building things that last, and the belief that great work is still fundamentally human. Our goal isn’t to ship the next feature. Each and every team of Notinos is working to set the standard for how humans work together in the AI era. From building a business’s system of record to making and managing AI agents to automating away the busy work, we care deeply about giving our customers more time for their life’s work.




ABOUT THE ROLE:

Our Executive Operations team work closely with Notion’s leadership, serving as trusted advisors, collaborators, and problem-solvers. We focus on amplifying the impact of our executives by anticipating needs, streamlining operations, and building systems that keep leaders focused on the highest leverage work. We’re deeply connected to Notion’s mission and values, and we take pride in creating an environment of collaboration, clarity, and authenticity. Our team thrives on strong relationships, operational excellence, and a shared commitment to building tools that empower people to think and work together more effectively.

This role calls for someone who is proactive, adaptable, and deeply organized. Someone who can balance complex scheduling, drive cross-functional coordination, and bring clarity to fast moving priorities. This person will support 2 leaders in our Engineering and Product orgs. Our ideal candidate thrives in dynamic environments, operates independently, and consistently finds ways to improve workflows and communication. You’ll be a key partner in making sure our leaders and the company as a whole can move quickly while staying aligned. 

 

This role is based in our San Francisco office. We work from our offices on Mondays, Tuesdays and Thursdays (our Anchor Days) because we do our best thinking and building together in person. We’re looking for someone who’s excited to work alongside the team during those days. 




WHAT YOU'LL ACHIEVE:

 - Organizational support: Partner with Engineering and Product leaders on running the day-to-day of an efficient, high-velocity, and fun organization

 - Calendar management: Prioritize and coordinate the teams’ operating calendar, ensuring time is spent in a way that's most leveraged to achieve our business objectives

 - Meeting aficionado: Organize, attend, and track meeting notes and action items, with an eye on making every interaction productive and warm

 - Travel planner: Flights, hotels, transportation, dining, etc. A strong attention to detail here is valued

 - Expense management: Manages expense reports for the executives you support

 - Culture carrier and community builder: Craft fun & engaging team offsite experiences, celebrate birthdays and anniversaries, new family members, and promotions to ensure employees continue to feel connected and recognized




SKILLS YOU'LL NEED TO BRING: 

 - 5+ years of Executive Operations experience at fast-growing companies, ideally with experience with technical teams.

 - Organized and detail-oriented: Strong attention to detail, able to stay calm under pressure, a quick thinker, create order of out chaos

 - Effective communicator: Ability to communicate the priorities of leadership within Notion, whether it is by written, verbal, or group communication

 - Event planning: Experience organizing team events with hundreds of people, as well as multi-day events with smaller groups of people, such as an executive offsite

 - EQ: Love connecting with employees, and have proven ability to build relationships and bring warmth to all levels of the organization

 - Discreet: Demonstrated ability to maintain complete confidentiality on all business matters




NICE TO HAVES:

 - You're a Notion evangelist! You love the product, and already use it in your daily life

The compensation offered for this role will be based on multiple factors such as location, the role’s scope and complexity, and the candidate’s experience and expertise, and may vary from the range provided below. For roles based in San Francisco, the estimated base salary range for this role is $165,000 - $190,000.

They use it to think better, and make their work easier for others to build on.

jobs.description:
WHO WE ARE

Notion is the collaborative AI workspace where teams and agents think together https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=vkpYpWfEK5s. We're building one place where your knowledge, projects, meetings, and AI tools live side by side, so work is faster, clearer, and less fragmented. Millions of individuals, small teams, and large companies run their work on Notion.



Notinos (our employees) are customer zero in bringing this future of work to life. We care about craft, building things that last, and the belief that great work is still fundamentally human. Our goal isn’t to ship the next feature. Each and every team of Notinos is working to set the standard for how humans work together in the AI era. From building a business’s system of record to making and managing AI agents to automating away the busy work, we care deeply about giving our customers more time for their life’s work.




ABOUT THE ROLE

Notion is rebuilding its go-to-market motion around a workflow-first, builder-led model—and the BDR is at the front of it. As a Business Development Rep, you'll be the force that turns the right accounts into the right conversations. You'll partner closely with Solutions Consultants to identify and target companies that are ready to rethink how they work—and your job is to get them in the room. This isn't generic pipeline work: you're qualifying for workflow-first, build-ready opportunities that set SCs up to win. If you're competitive, curious, and energized by outbound that actually means something, this is the role for you.

 


WHAT YOU'LL ACHIEVE

 - Generate qualified, workflow-first pipeline by identifying and targeting high-potential accounts in your assigned book, partnering with your sellers on account and outbound strategy

 - Run multi-channel outbound campaigns—email, phone, LinkedIn, and events—to create urgency and secure first meetings with the right decision-makers

 - Conduct initial qualification to ensure meetings handed to sellers are "ready to build," not just "ready to talk"—validating ICP, intent, and workflow fit before the handoff

 - Document and deliver clean handoff packets in Salesforce with ICP signals, pain points, workflow hypothesis, and stakeholder context so sellers can hit the ground running

 - Leverage GTM System tooling and intent data to sharpen targeting, prioritize accounts by signal strength, and increase the quality and consistency of your outbound motion

 


SKILLS YOU'LL NEED TO BRING

 - Business fluency in English and Polish

 - Proven track record in outbound pipeline generation, with hands-on experience in cold prospecting across phone, email, and social channels

 - Strong written and verbal communication skills with the ability to craft compelling, persona-specific outreach that earns a response

 - Sharp qualification instincts—able to quickly assess ICP fit, identify urgency, and set solutions condsultants up for high-quality first conversations

 - Passion for AI/ML and understanding of API-first or consumption-based business models

 - High-activity mindset with the discipline to prioritize based on signal and data, not just volume

 - You don't need to be an AI expert, but you're curious and willing to adopt AI tools to work smarter and deliver better results.

 


NICE TO HAVES

 - Experience with Salesforce, Outreach, or similar GTM tooling

 - Familiarity with Notion as a product or prior experience selling productivity, collaboration, or workflow software

 - Background in a high-velocity, metric-driven outbound environment with clear pipeline targets




Notion is committed to providing highly competitive cash compensation, equity, and benefits. The compensation offered for this role will be based on multiple factors such as location, the role's scope and complexity, and the candidate's experience and expertise, and may vary from the range provided below. The estimated on target earnings (including base salary and on target incentive pay) for this role is €70,000 per year.

 - Contribute directly to NRR with predictable renewal and expansion pipeline and proactive product adoption for your book of business

 - Define and maintain mutual success plans that proactively guide customers through their AI Transformation and demonstrate ROI to executive-level stakeholders with periodic business reviews

 - Identify opportunities to engage Services for customers with complex or technical implementation needs and partner closely with the Services team throughout delivery to ensure successful outcomes and value delivered

 - Help build and deliver OA programs that generate customer and business outcomes across Notion’s install base.

 - Set the bar for product and AI fluency across the team and ensure your team masters Notion’s product and maintains an expert-level knowledge of the AI ecosystem.




SKILLS YOU'LL NEED TO BRING: 

 - Experience driving customer adoption, value realization, renewals, or expansion within a B2B software environment

 - Strong customer-facing discovery instincts, with the ability to understand business problems, map workflows, and translate goals into practical implementation plans

 - Technical fluency and presence as a trusted advisor—while you won't be building for your customers, you should be capable of co-design, configuring, and troubleshooting Notion workspaces and workflows

 - Commercial awareness and the ability to partner with account owners on renewal risk, expansion potential, and account strategy

 - Ability to design and help customers build workflows that drive usage based consumption, connecting adoption patterns to measurable commercial outcomes

 - Strong program and stakeholder management skills, with the ability to manage success plans, timelines, risks, and customer commitments across a book of accounts

 - You operate with agency, urgency, and customer empathy, bringing structure to ambiguous problems and helping teams move from ideas to working systems

 - You’re obsessed with AI, constantly building with the newest tools and learning new ways of working

 - Fluent in German & English




NICE TO HAVES:

 - Prior experience in customer success, solutions consulting, implementation, technical account management, or post-sales strategy for productivity, collaboration, or workflow software

 - Experience working with flat, at-risk, or complex renewal accounts and helping customers return to a clear value path

 - Experience partnering in a shared account ownership model with sales, solutions, support, or implementation teams

 - Experience designing repeatable customer programs, playbooks, or interventions that improve retention, expansion, and adoption at scale

CAI is a professional services company established in 1996 that has grown year over year to nearly 750 people worldwide. For Life Sciences and Mission Critical industries that need to deliver critical solutions in high-stakes environments, we provide accelerated operational readiness and unparalleled performance at the highest standard through our rigorous approach, field-tested processes, and elite expertise developed over 30 years.

Our approach is simple because our purpose informs everything we do:â¯

We serve each otherâ¯â¯

At CAI, we believe in a relentless dedication to excellence, pushing boundaries, and surpassing expectations. From the beginning, weâve challenged ourselves to do what others wouldnât. Not just setting industry standards but redefining them entirely. We are bold in our thinking and creative in our approach. We operate at the intersection of wisdom and technology and thrive when they come together with humanity. For us, operational readiness isnât simply a goal. Itâs a way of life. Because tomorrow demands to be at the forefront of today. We do this through tireless effort, precision, efficiency, and an unwavering belief that there is always room for advancement. Weâre not interested in how it used to be done. Weâre obsessed with how it will be done.

 

We are seeking an experienced Recruiter to join our People Solutions Team and support our Life Sciences hiring in the Asia Pacific region. In this role, you will focus on sourcing, attracting, and hiring top talent for engineering roles within the life sciences and biotechnology spaces. The ideal candidate has experience recruiting in fast-paced, high-demand industries and understands the unique requirements of biotech environments. This role is a one year contract position. 

 

Key Responsibilities:

  • Manage full-cycle recruitment across APAC (sourcing, screening, interviewing, offer negotiation, and onboarding support) with an emphasis in recruiting and hiring in Australia
  • Partner with hiring managers in Life Sciences and Data Center teams to understand workforce needs and develop effective hiring strategies
  • Source niche talent for roles such as:
    • Biotech manufacturing (process engineers, validation engineers, QA/QC, MSAT, etc.)
    • Data center commissioning (Cx engineers, MEP specialists, commissioning managers, etc.)
  • Build and maintain strong pipelines of passive candidates using job boards, LinkedIn, referrals, and market mapping
  • Develop regional market intelligence on talent availability, salary benchmarks, and competitor activity
  • Ensure a high-quality candidate experience across all touchpoints
  • Coordinate interviews across multiple time zones and stakeholders
  • Maintain accurate data in the applicant tracking system (ATS) and generate recruiting reports
  • Support employer branding and diversity hiring initiatives across APAC

 

Qualifications:

  • 3â7+ years of recruiting experience, preferably in technical or engineering hiring
  • Proven experience recruiting in at least one of the following:
    • Life Sciences / Biotech Manufacturing
    • Data Center / Mission Critical Infrastructure
  • Experience supporting hiring across Australia and APAC regions (e.g., Singapore, Australia, Japan, South Korea, India, etc.)
  • Strong sourcing skills with experience identifying hard-to-find talent
  • Ability to manage multiple requisitions in a fast-paced environment
  • Excellent communication and stakeholder management skills
  • Familiarity with the ATS system Lever and recruiting tools (e.g., LinkedIn Recruiter)

Preferred Qualifications:

  • Experience recruiting for commissioning or validation roles
  • Understanding of GMP environments and/or mission-critical facility operations
  • Experience working in a global or matrixed organization
  • Ability to work flexible hours to support multiple time zones

jobs.title: AWS Cloud Solutions Architect
jobs.description:
As a Senior AWS Cloud Solutions Architect, you will be the technical lead on our most complex engagements, from assessment and mobilization to large-scale migration and modernization. You will report to an Engineering Manager based in Europe and lead distributed teams of US- and Budapest-based engineers. You will also work closely with colleagues in our AI/ML and Application Development practices.



What you'll be doing:

  • Lead the technical delivery of complex, high-impact migration and modernization engagements, including AWS Migration Acceleration Program (MAP) assessments and mobilization.

  • Lead technical discovery and design multi-service, cloud-native AWS architectures that turn business goals into scalable blueprints.

  • Technically lead teams of 1â4 engineers, and manage the technical roadmap of 2â3 engagements in parallel.

  • Own technical design decisions within project scope. Resolve technical disagreements and handle scope conversations with clients professionally.

  • Represent Client in customers sessions, including executive-level conversations and joint sessions with AWS stakeholders.

  • Spend around 25% of your time on pre-sales: discovery, solution design and co-selling with AWS account teams in North America.

  • Resolve high-risk technical blockers and escalations, including critical production incidents.

  • Adapt to changing delivery expectations and keep engagements on track under uncertainty.

  • Build architectural guardrails, reusable frameworks and components that raise quality across the practice.

  • Coach engineers and share knowledge through internal sessions, workshops, whitepapers and technical evangelism.

  • Be the go-to expert in one or more domains, such as MSSQL Server, PostgreSQL, EKS, VMware, data, security or networking.

  • Help shape our technical offerings and accelerators in line with market and AWS trends.



What you bring:

jobs.title: Head of Corporate Affairs
jobs.description:
Replit is the agentic software creation platform that enables anyone to build applications using natural language. With millions of users worldwide, Replit is democratizing software development by removing traditional barriers to application creation.


Replit is changing who gets to build software. As an agentic software creation platform, Replit lets anyone, from individual creators to teams inside the world’s largest companies, turn natural language into applications, internal tools, dashboards, and websites that solve real problems.

We are looking for a Head of Corporate Affairs - Strategy & Growth to help lead Replit’s next chapter of enterprise expansion, strategic relationship building, and institutional engagement.

This is a senior, commercially minded role for a strategic, hands-on leader who can turn relationships across government and industry into real opportunities for Replit. As Replit grows from a beloved developer platform into a defining company in AI and enterprise transformation, you will build the relationships and pathways that accelerate adoption across the public and private sectors.

The role sits at the intersection of corporate affairs, business development, public sector strategy, and enterprise growth. It is not a traditional government relations role focused on policy, access, or reputation. You will build a repeatable, measurable approach to turning senior-level engagement into qualified pipeline, adoption, and long-term value, working closely with the President of Public Sector and Corporate Affairs, the executive team, and sales and go-to-market leaders.

 


ROLE

 - Lead the growth strategy for Corporate Affairs, turning senior-level relationships across government and industry into revenue opportunities and pipeline.

 - Identify target accounts across government and industry, and prioritize building C-suite relationships that accelerate enterprise adoption.

 - Partner with business development, sales, and go-to-market leaders to align outreach, create pathways into target organizations, and convert executive engagement into qualified opportunities.

 - Develop repeatable playbooks for executive engagement and institutional partnerships, establishing a scalable relationship-to-revenue motion.

 - Build the operating cadence, metrics, and reporting to measure Corporate Affairs’ contribution to pipeline development, enterprise growth, and adoption.

 - Represent Replit in senior-level meetings, industry forums, and government engagements to strengthen strategic relationships and advance business opportunities.



QUALIFICATIONS

 - BA/BS degree or equivalent practical experience.

 - 10+ years of experience in corporate affairs, strategic partnerships, business development, public sector strategy, enterprise sales, government relations, government, or related fields.

 - Experience building or significantly expanding a relationship-driven growth, partnerships, or business development function at a fast-growing technology company or similarly complex organization.

 - Strong understanding of enterprise and public sector go-to-market motions, including how procurement, stakeholder alignment, and internal champions influence adoption.

 - Strong executive presence and communication skills, with credibility among C-suite leaders, government officials, and technical stakeholders.

 - Ability to translate complex technical products and AI capabilities into clear business value.

 - A creative, resourceful, “do more with less” mindset, with the ability to build new programs without an established playbook.

 - Passion for Replit’s mission and for AI-powered software creation expanding who can build software.



This is a full-time role that can be held from our Foster City, CA office. The role has an in-office requirement of Monday, Wednesday, and Friday.

jobs.title: Country Manager Canada
jobs.description:
Hello. Weâre Polaroid. An iconic brand, built by passionate people

Polaroid was founded in 1937 by one of the 20th centuryâs most influential innovators, Edwin Land, whose philosophy was: âDonât undertake a project unless it is manifestly important and nearly impossible.â

In 2008, Polaroid produced its last pack of instant film. But a group of passionate fans refused to let instant photography disappear. What started as The Impossible Project grew into a mission to preserve and reinvent analogue photography for a new generation. More than a decade later, that same startup acquired the Polaroid brand and continues to shape its future today.

At Polaroid, we create products and experiences that spark emotion, fuel creativity, and bring people closer together. At the intersection of art and technology, we believe in the power of analogue moments and genuine human connection in an increasingly digital world.

The Role

As the Country Manager, Canada - you will play a pivotal role in managing and expanding our footprint with National Retailers and Independents alike. We are looking for an experienced account manager that has excellent business and execution skills to deliver profitable customer plans and market share growth. In addition to channel and operational management responsibilities, this role will also collaborate with internal stakeholders from sales operations, finance, demand planning, product management, and marketing.

Key Responsibilities:

  • Canada Market Leadership: Serve as the commercial lead for Polaroid in Canada, owning the Canadian wholesale plan and accountability for revenue and market growth. Be the in-market face of the business and the primary point of leadership for the Canadian commercial team and stakeholders.

  • National Account Ownership: Act as the strategic lead for all national wholesale accounts, ensuring long-term scalability, commercial profitability, and a premium Polaroid brand presence across every brick-and-mortar and digital retail touchpoint.

  • Account Partnership: Build and hold trusted relationships with the most senior buyers, merchants, and decision-makers across national accounts. Lead joint business planning and negotiate mutually beneficial terms that create sustainable, multi-year growth.

  • Team & Cross-Functional Leadership: Lead and coordinate the Canadian commercial plan, including setting priorities and coaching supporting team members. Partner closely with US-based planning, finance, retail marketing, and product teams.

  • Forecasting, Demand Planning & SKU Transition: Translate market data into actionable inventory strategies. Lead seasonal forecasting and rolling monthly projections and manage SKU EOL transitions to protect sell-through. Track consumer trends and identify opportunities to capitalize or course-correct.

  • Sell-Through & Brand Activation: Shift the focus from sell-in to sell-through. Partner with retail marketing and activation teams to execute high-impact programs, elevate in-store positioning and shelf execution, and consistently use retail assets to drive account performance.

  • Brand Ambassador & Product Evangelism: Act as the face of Polaroid by demonstrating our world-class products at trade shows, training events, and major national account meetings.

What You'll Need to Succeed

  • Experience: Demonstrable progressive, high-impact sales and account management experience within a consumer goods, consumer electronics, or premium hardware retail environment, including experience leading a market, a team, or a portfolio with meaningful autonomy. A proven track record of managing multi-million-dollar national retail portfolios is essential.

  • Canadian Retailer Depth: Deep familiarity with the Canadian retail landscape and established senior-level relationships across major national chains.

  • Commercial & Analytical Literacy: Strong command of retail math, inventory pipelines, pricing elasticity, and promotional mechanics. Comfortable evaluating complex financial models and partnering closely with finance and operations leaders.

  • Strategic Influence: Excellent stakeholder management and communication skills, with a proven track record of influencing external executive leadership and aligning internal cross-functional teams around a shared growth vision.

  • Self-Directed Leadership: Able to operate as the senior Polaroid presence in-market: setting direction and making decisions while staying tightly connected to the North American strategy.

AI in our hiring process

Our recruitment team reviews every application, including your CV. We may use AI-assisted technology to support the initial review process and help our recruiters work more efficiently. Your application is always reviewed by a recruiter and all our hiring decisions are made by people. Learn more in our Privacy Policy: https://www.polaroid.com/legal/careers-job-applicant-privacy-policy

Â 

Our Approach to AI

At Polaroid we believe two things can be true at once: technology can help us move forward, while human creativity, craft, judgement and real-world connection matter more than ever.

Since our beginning, we've embraced technology to create meaningful human experiences. Today that means exploring new tools, including AI, with curiosity and care, using them where they help us work better and build a stronger business, while staying true to what defines our brand.
